title: Egg-white omelette with mushrooms, spinach and large tomato salad
instructions: Sauté mushrooms and spinach in the oil.
Pour egg whites over; set for 4 minutes.
Dress tomato and cucumber with vinegar and basil into a large salad.

title: Watermelon skyr bowl with mint
instructions: Dice the watermelon.
Spoon skyr into a bowl; top with melon.
Finish with mint, lime and hemp seeds.

title: Miso breakfast soup with tofu, spinach and egg
instructions: Heat stock; stir in miso.
Simmer tofu and wakame for 3 minutes.
Swirl in the egg; wilt spinach; finish with spring onion.

title: Strawberry rhubarb compote with quark
instructions: Stew rhubarb and strawberries with lemon for 8 minutes.
Cool; stir in cinnamon.
Spoon over quark; top with hemp seeds.

title: Tomato zucchini egg-white scramble with crispbread
instructions: Sauté zucchini and tomato in oil for 5 minutes.
Add egg whites and scramble softly.
Serve with chives and crispbread.

title: Papaya lime quark with kiwi
instructions: Dice papaya and kiwi.
Stir quark with lime.
Top with fruit and hemp seeds.

title: Cabbage soup with chicken and tomatoes
instructions: Sauté onion and carrots in oil.
Simmer cabbage, tomatoes, stock and chicken for 25 minutes.
Finish with parsley.

title: Spaghetti squash with tomato chicken sauce
instructions: Halve squash; bake at 200 °C for 30 minutes; scrape strands.
Fry chicken and zucchini; simmer tomatoes and garlic 10 minutes.
Spoon sauce over squash; finish with basil.

title: Large chef salad with turkey, egg and yoghurt dressing
instructions: Hard-boil the egg; slice the turkey.
Put lettuce, tomato and cucumber in a large bowl.
Mix yoghurt with mustard and lemon; dress the salad.

title: Cod vegetable stew with tomatoes and fennel
instructions: Sauté fennel and zucchini in oil.
Simmer tomatoes and stock for 10 minutes.
Poach cod 6 minutes; finish with dill.

title: Chicken fennel skillet with tomatoes and cauliflower rice
instructions: Grate cauliflower; steam 5 minutes.
Pan-fry chicken and fennel in oil for 8 minutes.
Add tomatoes; serve over cauliflower rice with lemon and parsley.

title: Zucchini tomato soup with prawns
instructions: Sauté zucchini, tomato and garlic; simmer with stock 12 minutes.
Blend the soup roughly.
Poach prawns 3 minutes; finish with basil.

title: Broccoli spinach soup with cottage cheese
instructions: Sauté onion; simmer broccoli and stock 12 minutes.
Wilt in spinach; blend.
Serve with cottage cheese and lemon.

title: Turkey breast with sheet-pan vegetables and yoghurt dip
instructions: Roast vegetables with oil on a tray at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Pan-fry turkey 4 minutes per side.
Mix yoghurt with herbs and lemon; serve alongside.

title: Shirataki vegetable wok with prawns
instructions: Rinse shirataki; boil 2 minutes.
Wok vegetables and prawns with ginger in sesame oil for 6 minutes.
Toss with noodles and soy sauce.

title: Pollock tomato zucchini skillet with basil
instructions: Sauté zucchini and garlic in oil.
Add tomatoes; simmer 5 minutes; poach pollock 6 minutes.
Finish with basil and lemon.

title: Tomato pepper soup with beans and chicken
instructions: Sauté pepper; simmer tomatoes and stock 12 minutes.
Blend; simmer beans and diced chicken 8 minutes.
Finish with basil.

title: Cucumber radish salad with tofu and sesame
instructions: Slice cucumber and radish thinly.
Dice tofu; fry in sesame oil.
Dress with soy, vinegar, sesame and spring onion.

title: Pointed cabbage turkey stew with caraway
instructions: Brown turkey and carrots in oil.
Braise cabbage with stock and caraway for 20 minutes.
Finish with yoghurt.

title: Hot and sour soup with tofu and mushrooms
instructions: Simmer stock with mushrooms, bamboo, soy and chilli for 8 minutes.
Add tofu; swirl in egg white.
Finish with vinegar, sesame oil and spring onion.

title: Pumpkin zucchini goulash with turkey
instructions: Brown turkey and onion in oil.
Braise pumpkin, zucchini, tomatoes and paprika for 20 minutes.
Season and serve.

title: Autumn salad with chicken, pear, red cabbage and walnuts
instructions: Pan-fry chicken 4 minutes per side; slice.
Combine red cabbage, pear and lamb's lettuce.
Dress with vinegar, oil and walnuts; top with chicken.

title: Savoy cabbage carrot stew with chicken
instructions: Brown the chicken in oil.
Braise cabbage, carrots and stock for 20 minutes.
Finish with thyme.

title: Tomato soup with chicken meatballs
instructions: Mince chicken; form meatballs with oats.
Simmer tomatoes, zucchini and stock 10 minutes.
Poach meatballs 8 minutes; finish with basil.

title: Beef vegetable skillet with pepper and sugar snaps
instructions: Slice beef; sear in oil; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables and ginger for 6 minutes.
Return beef with soy sauce.

title: Chinese cabbage salad with prawns and mandarins
instructions: Pan-fry prawns in sesame oil for 3 minutes.
Combine Chinese cabbage and mandarin.
Dress with vinegar, sesame and spring onion; top with prawns.

title: Ratatouille soup with white beans
instructions: Sauté vegetables in oil for 8 minutes.
Simmer stock and beans for 15 minutes.
Finish with basil.

title: Boiled beef soup with vegetables
instructions: Simmer beef in stock for 30 minutes.
Add vegetables; cook 15 minutes more.
Slice the beef; serve in the soup with parsley.

title: Chłodnik – cold beetroot soup with egg
instructions: Cook and grate beetroot; mix with stock and yoghurt; chill.
Hard-boil egg; dice cucumber and radishes.
Assemble; finish with dill and lemon.

title: Hake in a vegetable parcel with lemon and dill
instructions: Lay vegetables on baking paper; place fish on top.
Drizzle with oil, lemon and dill; seal the parcel.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.

title: Green bean tomato skillet with chicken and feta
instructions: Brown chicken in oil; set aside.
Braise beans and tomatoes for 12 minutes.
Return chicken; top with feta and oregano.

title: Zucchini tomato stew with lentils and basil
instructions: Sauté garlic; add zucchini and tomatoes.
Simmer lentils and stock for 20 minutes.
Finish with basil.

title: Cucumber melon salad with prawns and mint
instructions: Pan-fry prawns in oil for 3 minutes.
Dice cucumber and melon.
Dress with lime and mint; top with prawns.

title: Pan-fried tofu with zucchini and carrot noodles
instructions: Spiralize zucchini and carrots into noodles.
Fry tofu crisp in sesame oil.
Wok vegetable noodles and ginger 3 minutes; finish with soy and sesame.

title: Cucumber kohlrabi salad with skyr dill dressing
instructions: Cut cucumber and kohlrabi into matchsticks.
Mix skyr with dill and lemon.
Toss the salad with the dressing.

title: Tomato salad with light mozzarella and rocket
instructions: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella.
Arrange with rocket.
Drizzle with oil, balsamic and basil.

title: Roasted cauliflower florets with pepper and yoghurt dip
instructions: Roast cauliflower and pepper with oil and cumin at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Mix yoghurt with lemon and parsley.
Serve with cucumber sticks and the dip.

title: Red cabbage apple salad with yoghurt and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Finely slice red cabbage and apple.
Fold in yoghurt and vinegar.
Top with pumpkin seeds.

title: Kiwi melon salad with cottage cheese
instructions: Dice kiwi and melon.
Plate with cottage cheese.
Finish with mint and lime.

title: Strawberry skyr cold bowl
instructions: Blend half the strawberries; stir into skyr.
Top with remaining strawberries.
Finish with mint, lime and hemp seeds.

title: Ali Nazik (minced lamb on smoky aubergine yoghurt cream)
instructions: Roast the aubergine in the oven or over a gas flame for 20 minutes until the skin is charred. Peel and finely chop the flesh.
Mix the aubergine purée with the yoghurt, crushed garlic and a little salt and spread it on a plate.
Fry the minced lamb in the olive oil for 6 minutes until crumbly, season with salt and pepper and spoon over the cream. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Çiğ börek (Tatar pan-fried pastries with minced beef) and salad
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour, water and a pinch of salt into a smooth dough and rest it for 10 minutes.
Mix the minced beef with finely grated onion, salt and pepper.
Roll the dough out thinly, cut into circles, fill with the mince, fold into half-moons and press the edges firmly.
Fry the pastries in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side until golden. Serve with salad, tomato and parsley.

title: Çiğ köfte (bulgur walnut köfte) with iceberg lettuce and pomegranate
instructions: Pour 60 ml hot water over the fine bulgur and leave to soak for 10 minutes.
Finely chop the walnuts and knead vigorously with the bulgur, tomato paste, olive oil, lemon juice and spices for 5 minutes.
Knead in the spring onion and parsley and shape small oblong köfte.
Place the köfte in iceberg lettuce leaves and sprinkle with pomegranate seeds.

title: Şakşuka (aubergine and pepper in tomato sauce) with wholemeal pita
instructions: Dice the aubergine and pepper and fry in the olive oil for 10 minutes until golden.
Add the passata and chopped garlic and simmer for 8 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Sprinkle with parsley while lukewarm and serve with toasted wholemeal pita.

title: Haydari (yoghurt mint meze) with cucumber and carrot sticks
instructions: Stir the yoghurt with finely chopped mint, crushed garlic, lemon juice and cumin until smooth.
Spoon into a small bowl and drizzle with the olive oil.
Cut the cucumber and carrots into sticks and serve alongside for dipping.

title: Air fryer sigara böreği (cheese cigar pastries) with tomato salad
instructions: Cut the yufka into triangles. Mix the grated kashar with chopped mint.
Place the filling on the wide edge, fold in the sides and roll into thin cigars. Brush with the olive oil.
Bake in the air fryer at 190 °C for 8 minutes until golden.
Slice the tomatoes and red onion, sprinkle with sumac and serve with the börek.

title: Su böreği (water börek with spinach and white cheese)
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour, water, egg and a pinch of salt into a firm dough and divide into 3 portions.
Roll the sheets out thinly and cook each in boiling salted water for 1 minute, then rinse in cold water.
Wilt the spinach, squeeze out and mix with the crumbled white cheese and chives.
Layer the sheets and filling in an oiled dish, brush with olive oil and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes until golden.

title: Ispanaklı kol böreği (spinach, white cheese and chive coiled börek)
instructions: Wash the spinach, wilt briefly, squeeze out well and chop.
Mix with the crumbled white cheese, chives, salt and pepper.
Brush the strudel pastry thinly with olive oil, lay the filling along it, roll up and coil into a dish.
Bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes until golden and serve with tomato slices.

title: Midye dolma (stuffed mussels with spiced rice and pine nuts)
instructions: Finely dice the onion and sweat in the olive oil for 5 minutes until translucent. Briefly toast the pine nuts with it.
Add the rice, spices and 80 ml water, cover and leave to swell for 10 minutes. Fold in the herbs.
Open the cleaned mussels slightly, fill with the rice, close and pack tightly into a pot.
Steam covered with a little water for 20 minutes. Allow to cool and serve with lemon juice.

title: Hamsili pilav (Black Sea rice with anchovies, dill and spring onions)
instructions: Wash the rice and par-cook for 10 minutes with 90 ml water, the olive oil, dill and spring onions.
Line a small dish with half the anchovies in a fan, skin side out.
Fill in the rice, cover with the remaining anchovies and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Turn out onto a plate and drizzle with lemon juice.

title: Balık ekmek (sea bass in wholemeal flatbread with cabbage onion salad)
instructions: Very finely shred the white cabbage, slice the red onion into rings and mix with lemon juice, sumac and salt.
Salt the sea bass and fry in the olive oil skin side down for 4 minutes, then 1 minute on the other side.
Briefly warm the flatbread in the pan, fill with the fish and cabbage salad and serve immediately.

title: Bamya (okra tomato stew with lamb) and bulgur
instructions: Dice the lamb and brown in the olive oil with the diced onion for 6 minutes.
Add the passata and 150 ml water and braise for 25 minutes.
Trim the okra, drizzle with lemon juice, add and cook gently for another 12 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook the bulgur in 80 ml water for 12 minutes and serve with the stew.

title: Barbunya pilaki (borlotti beans in olive oil with lemon and parsley)
instructions: Dice the onion, carrot and garlic and sweat in the olive oil for 6 minutes.
Add the diced tomato, borlotti beans and 100 ml water and simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Leave to cool, season with lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve with plenty of parsley.

title: Gavurdağı salad (walnut tomato salad with sumac and pomegranate molasses)
instructions: Cut the tomatoes into very small cubes. Finely chop the spring onion and parsley.
Roughly chop the walnuts and mix everything in a bowl.
Whisk the olive oil, pomegranate molasses, lemon juice and sumac, pour over and serve immediately.

title: Biber dolması (peppers stuffed with herb rice, raisins and pine nuts)
instructions: Par-cook the brown rice in 120 ml water for 20 minutes.
Dice the onion and sweat in the olive oil with the pine nuts for 5 minutes. Mix in the rice, raisins, herbs, salt and pepper.
Hollow out the peppers, fill, stand upright in a pot and cook covered with 100 ml water for 25 minutes.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve lukewarm or cold with a dollop of yoghurt.

title: Kabak dolması (courgettes stuffed with minced beef, rice and dill)
instructions: Cut the courgettes into 6 cm pieces and hollow them out with a spoon.
Mix the minced beef with the rice, finely chopped onion, dill, salt and pepper and fill the courgettes.
Stand upright in a pot, add the olive oil and 150 ml water and cook gently, covered, for 35 minutes.
Serve with a dollop of yoghurt.

title: Air fryer paçanga böreği (yufka rolls with beef pastirma and cheese)
instructions: Cut the yufka into rectangles. Cut the pastirma into strips and grate the kashar.
Place the pastirma and kashar on the pastry, fold in the sides, roll up tightly and brush with olive oil.
Bake in the air fryer at 190 °C for 8 minutes until crisp and serve with cucumber and tomato.

title: Sac kavurma (beef from the iron griddle with peppers and tomatoes)
instructions: Cut the beef into small cubes. Dice the pepper, tomatoes and onion as well.
Heat a cast-iron pan until very hot, add the olive oil and sear the meat for 5 minutes.
Fry the onion and pepper with it for 4 minutes, add the tomatoes and fry for another 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with parsley and serve in the pan.

title: Testi kebabı (lamb and vegetables from the clay pot) with bulgur
instructions: Dice the lamb, aubergine, pepper, tomato and onion and mix with the olive oil, salt and pepper.
Fill into a soaked clay pot, seal with foil and cook in the oven at 200 °C for 75 minutes.
Cook the bulgur in 80 ml water for 12 minutes.
Open the clay pot at the table and serve the stew with the bulgur.

title: Terbiyeli sulu köfte (beef meatballs in lemon egg yolk sauce) with carrots
instructions: Knead the minced beef with salt and pepper, shape small balls and roll in the wholemeal flour.
Dice the carrots, sweat in the olive oil for 3 minutes, add 400 ml water and bring to the boil.
Add the meatballs and simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Whisk the egg yolk, yoghurt and lemon juice, temper with a little hot broth, stir in and do not boil again. Serve with parsley.

title: İnegöl köfte with white bean piyaz and grilled peppers
instructions: Knead the minced beef with grated onion, parsley, salt and pepper and shape 8 oblong köfte.
Fry the köfte and peppers in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side until well browned.
Mix the white beans with lemon juice, the remaining olive oil and sumac into a piyaz and serve with the köfte.

title: Kaygana (Black Sea herb omelette with dill and chives)
instructions: Beat the eggs with chopped dill, chives, salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan and pour in the egg mixture.
Let it set over medium heat for 3 minutes, fold and serve immediately.

title: Pastırmalı yumurta (fried eggs with beef pastirma, tomato and pepper)
instructions: Slice the tomato and pepper and sauté in the olive oil for 4 minutes.
Add the pastirma to the pan and warm for 1 minute.
Crack the eggs on top and cook for 3 minutes until the whites are set. Serve immediately.

title: Boyoz from Izmir with boiled egg, white cheese and olives
instructions: Warm the boyoz in the oven at 180 °C for 6 minutes until flaky and hot.
Boil the egg for 9 minutes, rinse in cold water and halve.
Cut the tomatoes and cucumber and arrange on a plate with the yoghurt, olives, white cheese and parsley. Serve with the boyoz and egg.

title: Karides güveç (prawns with tomato, pepper and cheese from the clay pot)
instructions: Dice the pepper and tomato and sauté in the olive oil with the garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the prawns, season with salt and pepper and cook for 3 minutes.
Fill into a small clay dish, sprinkle with kashar and bake at 220 °C for 8 minutes until the cheese melts golden. Serve with parsley.

title: Air fryer calamari with tarator sauce and leaf salad
instructions: Blend the walnuts, wholemeal bread, garlic, 6 g olive oil and lemon juice into a coarse tarator sauce and season with salt.
Pat the squid dry and toss with 4 g olive oil, salt and pepper.
Cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 8 minutes until the edges are lightly browned. Serve with the tarator and leaf salad.

title: Palamut izgara (grilled bonito) with rocket and red onions
instructions: Salt the bonito fillet and rub with 5 g olive oil.
Grill for 3 minutes per side on a hot grill or in a grill pan until the skin is crisp.
Toss the rocket and red onion slices with the remaining olive oil and lemon juice and place beside the fish.

title: Fava (yellow split pea purée with dill, onion and olive oil) and vegetable sticks
instructions: Cook the yellow split peas with the onion and 250 ml water for 30 minutes until soft, then purée finely.
Stir in the olive oil, lemon juice, dill, salt and finely chopped capers and spoon into a bowl.
Cut the carrots and cucumber into sticks and serve alongside.

title: Arnavut ciğeri (cubed chicken livers with sumac onions) and salad
instructions: Pat the chicken livers dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Sear in the hot olive oil for 4 minutes until browned outside and just pink inside. Season with salt.
Slice the red onion into thin rings and mix with sumac and parsley. Serve the livers with the onions, salad and lemon juice.

title: Yuvarlama (yoghurt soup with chickpeas, meatballs and mint)
instructions: Shape the minced beef with salt into 12 very small meatballs and roll in the wholemeal flour.
Bring the water to the boil and simmer the meatballs and chickpeas gently for 12 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt smooth with a little hot broth, add to the pot and do not boil again. Season with olive oil, mint, salt and pepper.

title: Beyti kebab (minced lamb roll in flatbread with tomato sauce and yoghurt)
instructions: Knead the minced lamb with salt, pepper and chopped parsley and shape into an oblong roll.
Fry in a pan with 3 g olive oil on all sides for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Simmer the passata with the garlic and remaining olive oil for 5 minutes and season with salt.
Wrap the roll in the warmed pita, cut into pieces and serve with the tomato sauce, yoghurt and tomato slices.

title: Adana kebab from beef with grilled vegetables and sumac onions
instructions: Knead the minced beef firmly with salt, pul biber and a little ice water and shape around a flat skewer or into a flat roll.
Grill for 4 minutes per side on a hot grill or in a grill pan. Grill the pepper and tomato beside it for 5 minutes.
Slice the red onion into rings, mix with sumac and serve with the kebab and grilled vegetables.

title: Tavuk şiş with tomato bulgur salad and grilled peppers
instructions: Cut the chicken into 3 cm cubes, toss with 4 g olive oil, salt and pepper and thread onto skewers.
Soak the bulgur in 80 ml boiling water for 15 minutes. Dice the tomato, cucumber and herbs and fold in with lemon juice and the remaining oil.
Grill the chicken skewers and peppers for 5 minutes per side and serve with the bulgur salad.

title: Pazı kavurması (sautéed chard) with yoghurt and wholemeal pita
instructions: Wash the chard and cut the stalks and leaves separately into strips.
Sweat the stalks in the olive oil with the garlic for 4 minutes, add the leaves and wilt for 5 minutes. Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
Serve with a dollop of yoghurt and toasted wholemeal pita.

title: Ege ot kavurması (Aegean wild greens in olive oil) with lemon and wholemeal flatbread
instructions: Wash the greens, remove tough stems and roughly chop.
Sweat in the olive oil with the garlic for 8 minutes until soft and glossy. Season with salt and lemon juice.
Serve lukewarm with lemon wedges and the wholemeal flatbread.

title: Fırın sütlaç (baked rice pudding with cinnamon and hazelnuts)
instructions: Cook the rice in the milk over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring, until the rice is soft and the milk is creamy. Stir in the sugar.
Pour into an ovenproof dish and bake at 220 °C for 15 minutes until the top has brown spots.
Roughly chop the hazelnuts, toast them in a dry pan and sprinkle over the lukewarm pudding with cinnamon.

title: Tavuk göğsü (chicken milk pudding) with cinnamon and pomegranate
instructions: Poach the chicken breast in a little water for 15 minutes until soft, then shred extremely finely until no fibres remain.
Cook the milk with the cornflour and sugar, stirring, for 8 minutes until thick, then stir in the chicken.
Pour into a mould, chill and serve with cinnamon and pomegranate seeds.

title: İncir dolması (baked figs with walnut filling and yoghurt)
instructions: Cut a cross in the top of each fig without cutting all the way through, and open them slightly.
Roughly chop the walnuts, mix with cinnamon and fill into the figs. Drizzle with olive oil.
Bake at 190 °C for 15 minutes until the figs are soft and lightly caramelized. Serve with yoghurt.

title: Irmik helvası light (semolina helva with pine nuts and cinnamon)
instructions: Melt the butter, toast the pine nuts for 2 minutes until golden, add the semolina and toast, stirring, for 5 minutes until it smells nutty.
Heat the milk and sugar, pour onto the semolina and thicken for 3 minutes, stirring.
Leave to swell, covered, for 5 minutes, turn out into a mould and dust with cinnamon.

title: Güllaç (rice wafers with milk, pomegranate and walnuts)
instructions: Heat the milk with the sugar until the sugar has dissolved, then leave to cool slightly.
Dip the rice wafer sheets one by one briefly in the milk and layer them in a shallow dish.
Roughly chop the walnuts and scatter them between the layers. Chill, cut into pieces and serve with pomegranate seeds.

title: Kazandibi (lightly caramelized milk pudding) with cinnamon
instructions: Melt the butter in a non-stick pan, sprinkle in 5 g sugar and lightly caramelize over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Whisk the whole milk, cornflour and remaining sugar until smooth, pour into the pan and cook, stirring, for 8 minutes until thick.
Leave to cool, roll up so that the browned side is on top and serve with cinnamon.

title: Künefe light with pistachios and orange blossom yoghurt
ingredients: Orange blossom water, a little sugar
instructions: Pull the kadaif apart and mix with the melted butter.
Press half into a small dish, lay the mozzarella on top, cover with the remaining kadaif and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes until golden.
Stir the yoghurt with the orange blossom water and sugar. Sprinkle the künefe with chopped pistachios and serve with the yoghurt.

title: Air fryer lokma with lemon syrup and pistachios
instructions: Mix the flour, yoghurt, olive oil, water, baking powder and a little yeast into a thick batter and rest for 10 minutes.
Use two teaspoons to place small balls in the air fryer basket and bake at 190 °C for 10 minutes until golden.
Boil the sugar with the lemon juice into a thin syrup, toss the warm lokma in it and sprinkle with chopped pistachios.

title: Bouillabaisse with saffron, fennel and wholemeal croutons
instructions: Slice the fennel into strips and sweat in the olive oil for 5 minutes. Add the diced tomato, saffron, herbs and water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Cut the sea bass and cod into pieces, add to the soup with the mussels and poach gently for 6 minutes.
Dice the wholemeal bread and toast in a dry pan until crisp.
Season the soup with lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve with the croutons.

title: Soupe au pistou with summer vegetables, white beans and basil oil
instructions: Dice the carrot, courgette and tomato and cut the green beans into pieces.
Bring the vegetables to the boil with the water and simmer for 15 minutes. Add the white beans and cook for 5 minutes.
Pound the basil, garlic and olive oil into a pistou. Season the soup with salt and pepper and serve with the pistou.

title: Bœuf bourguignon with carrots, mushrooms and parsley potatoes
instructions: Cut the beef into large cubes and brown well in the olive oil for 6 minutes. Briefly fry the onion and tomato paste with it.
Deglaze with the alcohol-free red wine and water, add the carrots and braise gently, covered, for 90 minutes.
Quarter the mushrooms and add them for the last 15 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes, toss in parsley and serve with the stew.

title: Poulet basquaise with peppers, tomato, Espelette pepper and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice in 120 ml water for 25 minutes.
Cut the chicken into pieces and brown in the olive oil for 5 minutes. Remove.
Sweat the onion, garlic and pepper strips for 6 minutes, add the tomato, return the chicken and braise for 12 minutes. Season with Espelette pepper and serve with the rice.

title: Coq au vin blanc with mushrooms, shallots and green beans
instructions: Cut the chicken into large pieces and brown in the olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the shallots and mushrooms, fry for 4 minutes, deglaze with the alcohol-free white wine and braise, covered, for 15 minutes.
Cook the green beans in salted water for 6 minutes. Season with herbs, salt and pepper and serve together.

title: Brandade de morue with leaf salad and lemon
instructions: Soak the salt cod for at least 24 hours, changing the water several times.
Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes. Poach the cod in the milk with the garlic for 8 minutes.
Flake the fish and coarsely mash with the potatoes, olive oil and a little of the poaching milk. Season with pepper.
Brown briefly under the grill and serve with oak leaf lettuce, parsley and lemon juice.

title: Plaice fines herbes with lemon and leaf spinach
instructions: Season the plaice fillets with salt and pepper and fry in 5 g olive oil for 2 minutes per side.
Wilt the spinach in the remaining oil for 2 minutes and season with salt.
Finely chop the herbs, mix with the lemon juice and spoon over the fish. Serve on the spinach.

title: Pipérade with poached eggs and wholemeal bread
instructions: Cut the pepper into strips and the onion into rings and sweat in the olive oil for 10 minutes until soft.
Add the diced tomato and Espelette pepper and cook down for 8 minutes.
Poach the eggs in simmering water for 4 minutes, place on the pipérade and serve with wholemeal bread.

title: Pan bagnat with tuna, egg, olives and wholemeal ciabatta
instructions: Boil the egg for 9 minutes, peel and slice.
Split the ciabatta, drizzle both halves with olive oil and layer with lettuce, tomato, cucumber, tuna, egg and olives.
Season with lemon juice, salt and pepper, close, press firmly and leave to rest for 10 minutes.

title: Provençal vegetable quiche with courgette, tomato and goat cheese
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour, olive oil, water and a pinch of salt into a dough, roll out thinly and line a small tin.
Slice the courgette and tomato and layer them alternately on the pastry.
Beat the egg with the herbs, salt and pepper, pour over and sprinkle with crumbled goat cheese.
Bake at 190 °C for 35 minutes until the filling has set and the edge is golden.

title: Gratin dauphinois light with herb salad
instructions: Peel the potatoes and slice them 3 mm thin.
Heat the milk with the garlic, nutmeg and pepper and par-cook the potatoes in it for 8 minutes.
Layer in a dish and bake at 180 °C for 35 minutes until golden.
Dress the herb salad with olive oil and lemon juice and serve with the gratin.

title: Salade lyonnaise with poached egg and fried king oyster mushrooms
instructions: Slice the king oyster mushrooms and fry in 4 g olive oil for 5 minutes until golden. Season with salt.
Dice the wholemeal bread and toast into croutons in a dry pan.
Poach the egg in simmering vinegar water for 4 minutes.
Dress the lamb's lettuce with the remaining oil, vinegar and spring onion, top with the mushrooms and croutons, place the egg on top and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Grand aïoli with steamed cod, potatoes and vegetables
instructions: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes. Boil the egg for 9 minutes.
Steam the cod, carrot and green beans for 8 minutes.
Crush the garlic with salt, slowly stir in the olive oil and mix with the lemon juice into an aïoli.
Arrange the fish, vegetables, potatoes and halved egg on a platter and serve with the aïoli.

title: Salade de chèvre chaud with lamb's lettuce, walnuts and honey
instructions: Slice the wholemeal bread, top with goat cheese and bake at 220 °C for 5 minutes until the cheese softens.
Dress the lamb's lettuce, tomato and cucumber with the olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Place the cheese toasts on the salad, drizzle with honey and sprinkle with toasted walnuts.

title: Poulet à la moutarde with carrots, beans and herb potatoes
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and fry in the olive oil for 5 minutes per side.
Stir the mustard with 50 ml water, add to the pan and reduce for 3 minutes until the sauce coats the meat.
Cook the carrots, beans and potatoes in salted water for 12 minutes, toss with the herbs and serve with the chicken.

title: Tarte tatin with crème fraîche
instructions: Melt the sugar with the butter in a small ovenproof pan for 4 minutes into a light caramel.
Peel and quarter the apples, pack them tightly into the caramel and cook for 8 minutes.
Lay the pastry on top, tuck in the edges and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes until golden.
Rest briefly, turn out onto a plate and serve with crème fraîche.

title: Île flottante with berries
instructions: Beat the egg whites until stiff, fold in 8 g sugar and poach spoonfuls in barely simmering milk for 3 minutes, turn, cook 2 minutes more and lift out.
Stir the remaining milk with the egg yolk and remaining sugar over a water bath for 5 minutes until the sauce coats the spoon.
Pour the sauce into a bowl, place the meringues on top and garnish with berries.

title: Galette bretonne with spinach, egg and Gruyère
instructions: Mix the buckwheat flour, water and a pinch of salt into a thin batter and rest for 5 minutes.
Heat 3 g olive oil in a pan, spread the batter thinly and cook for 2 minutes until golden.

Wilt the spinach in the remaining oil for 2 minutes. Place in the centre of the galette, crack an egg on top, grate the Gruyère over it and cover for 3 minutes until set. Serve with tomato and chives.

title: Tarte au citron light with berries and yoghurt
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour, butter, 4 g sugar and water into a dough, line a small tin and pre-bake at 180 °C for 12 minutes.
Stir the lemon juice, remaining sugar and egg over a water bath for 6 minutes until creamy, pour onto the base and chill for 15 minutes.
Top with yoghurt and berries and serve.

title: Buckwheat porridge with roasted plums and hazelnuts
instructions: Cook the buckwheat in the milk for 15 minutes until soft, stirring occasionally.
Halve the plums and roast in a dry pan for 5 minutes until they release juice.
Roughly chop the hazelnuts and toast in a dry pan. Serve the porridge with the plums, nuts and cinnamon.

title: Millet coconut porridge with mango and lime
instructions: Cook the millet with the coconut milk and water for 15 minutes until soft.
Dice the mango.
Spoon the porridge into a bowl, top with the mango and drizzle with lime juice.

title: Quinoa breakfast porridge with pear, cinnamon and pecans
instructions: Rinse the quinoa thoroughly and cook in the milk for 15 minutes until soft.
Cut the pear into wedges and roast in a dry pan for 4 minutes.
Roughly chop the pecans and toast in a dry pan. Serve the porridge with the pear, nuts and cinnamon.

title: Tofu scramble with chives, tomato and wholemeal toast
instructions: Crumble the tofu roughly with your hands.
Fry in the olive oil for 5 minutes, stir in turmeric, kala namak and pepper, and add diced tomato and chives in the last minute.
Toast the wholemeal bread and serve with the tofu.

title: Smoked trout open sandwich on pumpernickel with horseradish quark
instructions: Stir the quark with the horseradish and dill until smooth.
Spread this on the pumpernickel and top with pieces of smoked trout.
Top with cucumber slices and a little more dill and serve.

title: Green shakshuka with kale, feta and coriander
instructions: Roughly chop the kale and wilt in the olive oil with the garlic for 6 minutes. Add the diced tomato.
Make a well, slide in the whole egg and the egg white, cover and cook for 4 minutes until set.
Sprinkle with crumbled feta, coriander and lemon juice and serve with wholemeal bread.

title: Matcha overnight oats with kiwi and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Stir the oats, milk and matcha in a jar until smooth.
Cover and leave to soak in the fridge for at least 6 hours or overnight.
Slice the kiwi, place on the oats and sprinkle with pumpkin seeds.

title: Polenta slices with mushroom ragout and thyme
instructions: Rain the polenta into boiling water, stirring, and cook for 8 minutes until firm. Pour into a small tin and leave to set for 15 minutes.
Slice the porcini and fry in 5 g olive oil with the thyme for 6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Slice the polenta, fry in the remaining oil for 2 minutes per side until golden and serve with the mushroom ragout and parsley.

title: Ricotta hotcakes with roasted rhubarb and pistachios
instructions: Cut the rhubarb into 3 cm pieces, toss with 4 g honey and roast at 200 °C for 12 minutes.
Mix the ricotta, egg, wholemeal flour and remaining honey into a batter.
Cook small hotcakes in the rapeseed oil for 2 minutes per side until golden. Serve with the rhubarb and chopped pistachios.

title: Lor cheese with pekmez, toasted pumpkin seeds and pear
instructions: Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Spoon the lor cheese into a bowl and drizzle with pekmez and olive oil.
Cut the pear into wedges and serve with the seeds.

title: Quark oat pancakes with blueberry compote
instructions: Grind the oats finely, mix with the quark, egg and 3 g honey into a batter and rest for 5 minutes.
Cook the blueberries with the remaining honey for 4 minutes until they burst.
Cook small pancakes in the rapeseed oil for 2 minutes per side until golden and serve with the compote.

title: Avocado lentil toast with lemon and chilli
instructions: Cook the lentils in 200 ml water for 20 minutes until just tender and drain.
Mash the avocado, mix with lemon juice, chilli, olive oil and salt, then fold in the lentils and hemp seeds.
Toast the wholemeal bread, spread the mixture on top and serve immediately.

title: Eggs Benedict with turkey slices, spinach and yoghurt hollandaise
instructions: Toast the wholemeal roll and wilt the spinach in a dry pan for 2 minutes.
Poach the eggs in simmering water for 4 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt, egg yolk, melted butter and lemon juice over a water bath for 2 minutes into a pale sauce.
Top the roll with turkey slices and spinach, place the poached eggs on top and coat with the sauce.

title: Cottage cheese bowl with roasted grapes, walnuts and thyme
instructions: Roast the grapes on a tray at 200 °C for 8 minutes until they just burst.
Roughly chop the walnuts and toast in a dry pan for 2 minutes.
Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl, top with the grapes and nuts and sprinkle with thyme.

title: Wild garlic omelette with goat cheese and radishes
instructions: Roughly chop the wild garlic. Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and stir in the wild garlic.
Melt the butter in a pan, let the eggs set for 3 minutes, crumble the goat cheese over them and fold.
Serve with sliced radishes.

title: Chia coconut pudding with passion fruit and mango
instructions: Mix the chia seeds with the yoghurt and desiccated coconut and leave to swell for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Dice the mango, halve the passion fruit and scoop out the pulp.
Spoon the pudding into a bowl, top with the fruit and drizzle very lightly with olive oil.

title: Teff pear porridge with cocoa and hazelnuts
instructions: Cook the teff in the milk for 15 minutes, stirring, into a creamy porridge. Stir in the cocoa.
Cut the pear into wedges. Roughly chop the hazelnuts and toast in a dry pan.
Serve the porridge with the pear and hazelnuts.

title: Rye porridge with berries and flaxseed
instructions: Cook the rye flakes in the milk for 12 minutes until soft.
Stir in the flaxseed and leave to swell for 2 minutes.
Top with the berries and serve.

title: Roasted tempeh breakfast with mushrooms, spinach and tomato
instructions: Slice the tempeh 1 cm thick.
Fry in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side until golden, adding the mushrooms for the last 3 minutes.
Sauté the spinach and diced tomato with it for 2 minutes, season with pepper and paprika and serve.

title: Lactose-free quark with strawberries, hemp seeds and maple syrup
instructions: Quarter the strawberries.
Spoon the lactose-free quark into a bowl and arrange the strawberries on top.
Scatter the hemp seeds and drizzle the maple syrup over it and eat immediately.

title: Jerusalem artichoke rösti with fried egg and herbs
instructions: Coarsely grate the Jerusalem artichokes, mix with salt, pepper and half the herbs and squeeze out firmly.
Shape into a flat rösti in a pan with 8 g olive oil and fry for 5 minutes per side until golden.
Fry an egg in the remaining oil, place it on the rösti and serve with tomato slices and the remaining herbs.

title: Protein porridge with skyr, raspberries and flaxseed
instructions: Cook the oats in the milk for 8 minutes into a creamy porridge.
Stir in the flaxseed and leave to swell for 2 minutes.
Take off the heat, fold in the skyr and serve with raspberries.

title: Air fryer zucchini chips with herb yoghurt dip
instructions: Slice the courgettes 3 mm thin, toss with olive oil, paprika and pepper.
Cook in the air fryer at 180 °C for 15 minutes, shaking in between, until the chips are crisp at the edges.
Stir the skyr with the herbs and serve as a dip with the warm chips.

title: Edamame with chilli lime and sesame
instructions: Blanch the edamame in boiling water for 4 minutes and drain.
While still hot, toss with lime juice, chilli and sesame.
Spoon into a bowl and eat immediately.

title: Air fryer chickpeas with ras el hanout and cucumber sticks
instructions: Drain the chickpeas well, pat dry and toss with olive oil and ras el hanout.
Roast in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes until crisp, shaking in between.
Cut the cucumber into sticks, drizzle with lemon juice and serve with the warm chickpeas.

title: Baked dates with goat cheese and pistachios
instructions: Slit the dates lengthways and fill with goat cheese.
Top with chopped pistachios and olive oil and bake at 180 °C for 8 minutes until the cheese softens.
Serve with a tomato cucumber salad and parsley.

title: White bean rosemary dip with fennel sticks
instructions: Coarsely purée the white beans with the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, rosemary and pepper.
Spoon into a small bowl.
Cut the fennel into sticks and serve alongside for dipping.

title: Air fryer feta filo triangles with sesame and cucumber salad
instructions: Cut the filo into strips, place a little feta on each, fold into triangles, brush with olive oil and sprinkle with sesame.
Bake in the air fryer at 190 °C for 8 minutes until golden.
Slice the cucumber, mix with dill and lemon juice and serve with the triangles.

title: Smoked trout rillettes on cucumber slices
instructions: Roughly mash the smoked trout with a fork.
Fold in the yoghurt, dill, horseradish and lemon juice, leaving it slightly coarse.
Cut the cucumber into 1 cm slices, top with the rillettes and serve immediately.

title: Meal-prep chickpeas with smoked paprika
instructions: Drain the chickpeas and toss with olive oil, smoked paprika and lemon juice.
Fold in the hemp seeds and parsley.
Pack into a container and keep chilled for up to 3 days, or eat immediately.

title: Apple slices with almond butter and hemp seeds
instructions: Core the apple and cut into 8 wedges.
Spread the almond butter on the cut surfaces.
Sprinkle with hemp seeds and eat immediately.

title: Celery sticks with blue cheese walnut cream
instructions: Cut the celery into 8 cm sticks.
Mash the blue cheese, cream cheese and roughly chopped walnuts into a cream with a fork.
Spoon the cream into a small bowl and serve the celery sticks alongside for dipping.

title: Cottage cheese cucumber canapés on wholegrain crispbread
instructions: Break the crispbread into handy pieces.
Spread with cottage cheese and top with cucumber slices.
Sprinkle with dill, chives and pepper and eat immediately.

title: Endive leaves with chicken mango salsa
instructions: Cut the chicken into small cubes. Finely dice the mango and pepper as well.
Mix everything with lime juice, olive oil and coriander into a salsa.
Wash the endive leaves, spoon the salsa into them and serve immediately.

title: Grilled nectarine with burrata and basil oil
instructions: Halve the nectarines, remove the stones and grill for 3 minutes per side on a hot grill until they have grill marks.
Arrange on a plate, place pieces of burrata on top, and arrange the rocket and tomato around them.
Drizzle with the basil oil and lemon juice and garnish with basil leaves.

title: Radish carpaccio with apple, watercress and yoghurt dressing
instructions: Slice the radish and apple very thinly and arrange them on a large plate.
Stir the yoghurt with olive oil, lemon juice and pepper into a dressing and drizzle over.
Scatter the watercress over it and serve immediately.

title: Air fryer potato wedges with lactose-free herb quark
instructions: Cut the unpeeled potatoes into wedges, toss with olive oil, paprika and pepper.
Cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 20 minutes until golden and crisp, shaking in between.
Stir the quark with the chives and lemon juice and serve as a dip with the hot wedges.

title: Smoked tofu sesame skewer with cucumber salad
instructions: Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes, toss with olive oil and lime juice and thread onto skewers. Sprinkle with sesame.
Fry in a grill pan or in the air fryer at 200 °C for 8 minutes until the edges are crisp.
Slice the cucumber, mix with dill and serve with the skewers.

title: Swabian Maultaschen in beef broth, roasted onions
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour and egg with 1 tbsp water into a firm dough and rest it for 10 minutes.
Mix the minced beef with half of the finely diced onion, the chopped spinach, salt and pepper.
Roll the dough out thinly, cover with the filling, fold it over and cut into 4 Maultaschen.
Poach in the simmering beef stock for 12 minutes. Fry the remaining onion in the rapeseed oil until golden.
Serve the Maultaschen in a deep plate with the broth and top with the fried onions and parsley.

title: Carinthian Kasnudeln, brown butter and chives
instructions: Boil the floury potatoes until soft, peel and mash them while hot. Mix with the grated mountain cheese, salt and pepper.
Knead the wholemeal flour and egg into a dough, roll it out thinly and cut out circles.
Fill the circles with the potato-cheese mixture, close into pockets and press the edges firmly.
Cook the Kasnudeln in boiling salted water for 8 minutes. Brown the butter in a pan.
Pour the brown butter over the pockets and sprinkle with chives.

title: Bread dumplings, porcini cream and lamb's lettuce
instructions: Dice the wholemeal bread leftovers, pour over the milk and soak for 10 minutes, then work in the egg.
Season with salt and pepper, shape 2 dumplings and poach in lightly boiling salted water for 15 minutes.
Fry the porcini and shallot in the rapeseed oil for 6 minutes, pour in the light cream, simmer for 3 minutes and finish with parsley.
Serve the dumplings with the mushroom sauce and the lamb's lettuce alongside.

title: Spinach dumplings on tomato ragout, hard cheese
instructions: Wilt the spinach, squeeze it out well and chop finely. Knead with the wholemeal flour, egg, salt and pepper into a dough.
Shape 4 dumplings and poach in boiling salted water for 10 minutes.
Sweat the garlic in the olive oil, reduce the passata for 8 minutes and season with basil, salt and pepper.
Place the dumplings on the tomato ragout and sprinkle with hard cheese.

title: Koenigsberger veal and beef meatballs, caper sauce and boiled potatoes
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cook them in salted water for 20 minutes.
Mix the minced veal and beef with the soaked, squeezed bread leftovers, egg, grated onion, salt and pepper and shape 6 small meatballs.
Poach the meatballs in the beef stock for 12 minutes, lift them out and bind the stock with mustard and the light cream.
Stir in the capers, coat the meatballs in the sauce and serve with the potatoes.

title: Beef sauerbraten, red cabbage and potato dumplings
instructions: Brown the beef shoulder in the rapeseed oil all over for 5 minutes. Add the onion and carrot, deglaze with the alcohol-free red wine and apple cider vinegar.
Season with bay leaf, salt and pepper and braise covered for 40 minutes until the meat is tender. Thicken lightly with the cornflour.
Cut the red cabbage into strips and steam it soft in a second pot for 20 minutes.
Boil the potatoes, mash them and shape 2 dumplings, poach in salted water for 8 minutes. Serve with the roast and red cabbage.

title: Breaded veal schnitzel and Austrian potato salad
instructions: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 20 minutes, peel and slice them. Mix with onion rings, apple cider vinegar, a little salted water, salt, pepper and chives into a potato salad.
Gently flatten the veal schnitzel, salt it and coat in the beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes per side until golden and serve immediately with the salad.

title: Pichelsteiner stew with beef and root vegetables
instructions: Cut the simmering beef into cubes and brown it in a pot for 5 minutes without fat.
Dice the potatoes, carrot and celeriac, slice the leek and white cabbage into strips and add them to the meat.
Pour in the beef stock, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 35 minutes until everything is tender.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve hot in a deep plate.

title: Gaisburger Marsch with beef, spaetzle and potatoes
instructions: Simmer the beef in the beef stock for 35 minutes, lift it out and slice it.
Dice the potatoes and cook them in the broth for 12 minutes, cooking the sliced carrot at the same time.
Slice the onion into rings and fry them golden in a pan without extra fat.
Add the cooked spaetzle and the beef to the broth, heat briefly and serve with the fried onions and parsley.

title: Potato noodles, creamed savoy cabbage and turkey strips
instructions: Boil and mash the potatoes and knead with the wholemeal flour, egg, salt, pepper and nutmeg into a dough. Roll into finger-shaped potato noodles.
Blanch the potato noodles in salted water for 3 minutes, drain and fry in the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes until golden.
Cut the turkey breast into strips and fry for 5 minutes, then lift out. Sweat the savoy cabbage and onion in the pan juices for 8 minutes, pour in the light cream.
Fold in the turkey and the potato noodles and serve immediately.

title: Schlutzkrapfen with spinach-ricotta filling and brown butter
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour and egg with a little water into a dough and rest it for 10 minutes.
Wilt the spinach, squeeze it out and mix with the ricotta, salt and pepper.
Roll the dough out thinly, cut out circles, fill them and close into half-moons.
Cook the Schlutzkrapfen in salted water for 6 minutes. Brown the butter, pour it over the pockets and sprinkle with chives.

title: Cheese press dumplings on cabbage salad
instructions: Soak the bread leftovers in the milk and mix with the grated mountain cheese, egg, salt, pepper and caraway. Press into 2 flat dumplings.
Fry the dumplings in the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes per side until golden.
Finely shred the white cabbage and mix with the apple cider vinegar, remaining rapeseed oil, caraway, salt and pepper into a cabbage salad. Place the dumplings on top.

title: Capuns (Graubuenden chard wraps) in broth, cheese
instructions: Stir the semolina, egg, finely chopped beef, parsley, salt and pepper into a creamy mixture.
Blanch the chard leaves briefly, spread with the mixture and roll into small wraps.
Poach the Capuns in the beef stock, covered, for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle with the grated mountain cheese and serve in the broth.

title: Valais barley soup with vegetables and a little mountain cheese
instructions: Precook the pearl barley in the low-sodium vegetable stock for 10 minutes.
Dice the carrot, celery, leek and courgette, add them with the thyme and bay leaf and simmer for a further 20 minutes.
Remove the bay leaf. Serve the soup in a deep plate and sprinkle with the grated mountain cheese and parsley.

title: Vegetarian tarte flambée with leek, goat cheese and thyme
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour, water, 5 g of the olive oil and a pinch of salt into a dough and roll it out thinly.
Stir the low-fat quark smooth and spread it on the dough. Slice the leek into fine rings and scatter them on top.
Crumble the goat cheese over it, add the thyme and the remaining olive oil. Bake at 220 °C for 12 minutes until crisp.

title: Onion tart with caraway and herb quark
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour, 1 egg, the rapeseed oil and 2 tbsp water into a dough and press it into a small tin.
Slice the onions into rings and sweat them for 8 minutes until soft, then cool. Mix with the second egg, the sour cream, caraway, salt and pepper and spread on the dough.
Bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes until golden. Stir the low-fat quark with the chives and serve with the tart.

title: Beef meatloaf, mashed potatoes and peas
instructions: Knead the minced beef with the egg, grated onion, soaked bread leftovers, marjoram, salt and pepper and shape into a small roast.
Brush with the rapeseed oil and roast at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Boil the potatoes and mash them with the milk. Cook the peas for 5 minutes.
Slice the roast and serve with the mash and peas.

title: Creamed venison strips, wholemeal spaetzle and unsweetened cranberries
instructions: Cut the venison into fine strips, season with salt and pepper and sear in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes, then lift out.
Fry the onion and mushrooms for 5 minutes, pour in the light cream and reduce for 3 minutes.
Fold in the meat and parsley. Serve with the cooked wholemeal spaetzle and the unsweetened cranberries.

title: Trout au bleu, boiled potatoes and melted butter
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cook them in salted water for 20 minutes.
Bring 1 litre of water with the vinegar, salt and pepper to the boil in a wide pot, add the cleaned trout and poach just below a simmer for 8 minutes until the skin turns bluish and taut.
Melt the butter. Serve the trout with the potatoes, the melted butter, dill and parsley.

title: Bavarian poultry sausage salad with red onions and a pretzel
instructions: Slice the turkey sausage, cut the red onion into fine rings and slice the gherkins.
Toss with the apple cider vinegar, rapeseed oil, salt and pepper into a sausage salad and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with chives and serve with the pretzel.

title: Styrian fried-chicken salad, pumpkin seed oil and potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 20 minutes, peel and quarter them.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper and fry it in 4 g of the olive oil for 8 minutes until golden, then slice into strips.
Dress the lamb's lettuce with the pumpkin seed oil, remaining olive oil, apple cider vinegar, salt and pepper.
Arrange with the potatoes and chicken and scatter the pumpkin seeds on top.

title: Valais cholera pastry with potato, apple and cheese
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour, 4 g of the rapeseed oil and 3 tbsp cold water into a dough and rest it for 10 minutes.
Parboil the potatoes in slices, slice the apple and onion, grate the mountain cheese.
Roll out the dough, fill it in layers with potato, apple, onion and cheese, then fold it closed. Brush with the remaining oil.
Bake at 200 °C for 30 minutes until golden and serve in wedges.

title: Raclette potato plate with cornichons, broccoli and pearl onions
instructions: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 20 minutes and halve them. Steam the broccoli for 6 minutes.
Place the mountain cheese on the potatoes and melt it under the grill for 4 minutes.
Serve with the broccoli, cornichons, pearl onions and parsley, and season lightly with salt and pepper.

title: Semolina dumpling soup with root vegetables
instructions: Stir the semolina with the egg, nutmeg, salt and pepper, leave to swell for 5 minutes and shape 4 small dumplings.
Cut the carrot, celeriac, leek and parsley root into fine dice and simmer in the vegetable stock for 12 minutes.
Add the dumplings to the soup and poach for 8 minutes. Serve with parsley.

title: Chicken-liver spaetzle soup in beef broth, chives
instructions: Finely chop the chicken livers and mix them with the cooked spaetzle, salt and pepper.
Sweat the onion in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes until translucent, then fry the liver spaetzle for 4 minutes until the liver is just cooked.
Pour in the beef stock, leave to stand for 5 minutes, sprinkle with chives and serve hot.

title: Baked apple bread pudding with vanilla yoghurt
instructions: Slice the bread leftovers, cut the apples into wedges and layer them in a small ovenproof dish.
Beat the egg, milk, honey and cinnamon, pour it over and leave to soak for 10 minutes.
Bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve the yoghurt as a vanilla yoghurt alongside.

title: Quark pancakes with unsweetened cranberries
instructions: Stir 40 g of the low-fat quark with the wholemeal flour, egg and milk into a smooth pancake batter.
Cook 2 large pancakes in the rapeseed oil, 2 minutes per side.
Spread the remaining quark on the pancakes, roll them up and serve with the unsweetened cranberries.

title: Apricot dumplings with buttered breadcrumbs and cinnamon
instructions: Knead the low-fat quark, wholemeal flour and egg into a dough and chill it for 10 minutes.
Stone the apricots, wrap them in the dough and shape 3 dumplings. Poach in lightly boiling water for 10 minutes.
Toast the bread leftovers in the butter for 3 minutes until golden and mix with the cinnamon. Toss the dumplings in the crumbs and serve hot.

title: Baked quark casserole with berries and vanilla sauce
instructions: Stir the low-fat quark with the egg, semolina and 4 g of the honey until smooth, then fold in the berries.
Spoon the mixture into a small ovenproof dish and bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes until golden.
Stir the yoghurt with the remaining honey into a vanilla sauce and serve it with the casserole.

title: Baked yeast dumplings with vanilla sauce
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour, 50 g of the milk, the egg and 3 g of the rapeseed oil into a dough and leave it to rise in a warm place for 20 minutes.
Shape 2 dumplings, place them in a small oiled dish, pour in the remaining milk and bake at 180 °C for 20 minutes until they have golden crowns.
Stir the yoghurt with the honey into a vanilla sauce and serve with the dumplings.

title: Bernese rosti with mountain cheese and a fried egg
instructions: Coarsely grate the potatoes, mix with salt and pepper and press them in a pan with 6 g of the rapeseed oil into a rosti; fry for 8 minutes, turning once.
Melt the mountain cheese on the rosti. Fry an egg in the remaining oil.
Place the egg on the rosti, sprinkle with chives and serve immediately.

title: Plain veal schnitzel, lamb's lettuce, radishes and mustard vinaigrette
instructions: Gently flatten the veal schnitzel, season with salt and pepper and fry in 8 g of the olive oil for 3 minutes per side.
Whisk the remaining olive oil, mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper into a vinaigrette.
Toss the lamb's lettuce and sliced radishes with the vinaigrette and serve beside the schnitzel.

title: Borscht with beef, beetroot and sour cream
instructions: Dice the beef and precook it in the beef stock for 25 minutes.
Cut the beetroot, white cabbage, carrot and parsnip into strips or dice, add them and simmer for a further 20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve in a deep plate with the sour cream and dill.

title: Vegetarian borscht with white beans, dill and rye bread
instructions: Cut the beetroot, white cabbage and carrot into fine strips.
Simmer in the low-sodium vegetable stock for 20 minutes, add the white beans and apple cider vinegar and heat for 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Sprinkle with dill and serve with the rye bread.

title: Cabbage and mushroom pierogi, brown butter and sour cream
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour and water into a dough and rest it for 10 minutes.
Finely dice the white cabbage and mushrooms, sweat them with the onion in 4 g of the rapeseed oil for 8 minutes and season with dill, salt and pepper.
Roll out the dough, cut out circles, fill them and close into pierogi. Cook in salted water for 6 minutes.
Fry in the remaining rapeseed oil for 2 minutes and serve with the sour cream and dill.

title: Beef pelmeni, butter and dill yoghurt
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour, egg and water into a dough and rest it for 10 minutes.
Mix the minced beef with grated onion, salt and pepper. Roll the dough out thinly, cut out circles, fill them and close into pelmeni.
Cook in boiling salted water for 8 minutes and toss with the butter.
Stir the yoghurt with the dill and serve with the pelmeni.

title: Bigos with beef, turkey, mushrooms and sauerkraut
instructions: Dice the beef and turkey breast and brown them in the rapeseed oil for 6 minutes. Fry the onion and mushrooms with them for 4 minutes.
Add the sauerkraut and passata, season with bay leaf, salt and pepper and braise for 30 minutes.
Remove the bay leaf and serve the bigos hot in a deep plate.

title: Zurek sour rye soup with egg and turkey sausage
instructions: Tear the rye bread into pieces, soak it in 80 ml of the beef stock for 15 minutes, then puree it finely and stir it back into the remaining stock.
Dice the potato and onion, add them with the garlic and simmer for 12 minutes. Cook the sliced turkey sausage in the soup for 3 minutes.
Finish with the light cream, dill, marjoram, salt and pepper. Boil a soft egg, halve it and place it on the soup.

title: Syrniki with sour-cherry compote and yoghurt
instructions: Knead the low-fat quark with the egg and rolled oats and shape 4 flat patties.
Fry in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Simmer the sour cherries for 5 minutes. Serve the syrniki with the compote and the yoghurt.

title: Vareniki with sour cherries and sour cream
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour, egg and water into a dough, rest it for 10 minutes and roll it out thinly.
Cut out circles, fill them with sour cherries and close into vareniki. Cook in salted water for 7 minutes.
Toss in 4 g rapeseed oil for 2 minutes and serve with the sour cream.

title: Langos with herb yoghurt and cheese
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour, yoghurt and a pinch of the mountain cheese into a dough and rest it for 15 minutes.
Stretch the dough flat and fry it in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Rub with the crushed garlic, scatter the remaining mountain cheese and chives on top and serve with the remaining yoghurt.

title: Hortobagyi palacsinta (chicken pancakes in paprika sauce)
instructions: Make 2 pancakes from the wholemeal flour, egg and milk, cooking 2 minutes per side.
Dice the chicken breast and fry it with the onion and pepper for 8 minutes, add half of the passata, the paprika, salt and pepper and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fill the pancakes, roll them up and place them in a small dish. Stir the remaining tomatoes with the light cream into a sauce, pour it over and bake at 180 °C for 10 minutes.

title: Svickova (braised beef in cream sauce) with Bohemian dumplings
instructions: Brown the beef in the rapeseed oil for 5 minutes, add the onion, carrot and celeriac and braise with bay leaf, salt and pepper for 40 minutes until the meat is tender.
Puree the vegetables and cooking juices with the light cream, slice the meat and keep it warm in the sauce.
Dice the wholemeal roll, bind it with a little water and shape 2 Bohemian dumplings, steam them for 10 minutes. Serve with the cranberries.

title: Uzbek lamb pilaf with carrots, chickpeas and cumin
instructions: Cut the lamb into cubes and brown it well in the rapeseed oil for 6 minutes. Fry the onion and the carrot cut into batons with it for 5 minutes.
Add the parboiled rice, chickpeas, cumin, salt and pepper, pour on 150 ml water, cover and leave to swell for 20 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf and serve it on a plate.

title: Lamb shashlik with grilled vegetables and tomato-onion salad
instructions: Cut the lamb into cubes and marinate with 5 g of the olive oil, salt and pepper. Cut the pepper and courgette into chunks.
Thread the meat and vegetables onto skewers and grill or pan-fry for 10 minutes, turning them.
Dice the tomatoes and onion, mix with the remaining olive oil, lemon juice and parsley into a salad and serve with the skewers.

title: Buckwheat blini with trout roe, quark and dill
instructions: Stir the buckwheat flour, egg and milk into a batter and cook 4 small blini in the rapeseed oil, 2 minutes per side.
Stir the low-fat quark with half of the dill and spread it on the blini.
Top with the trout roe and garnish with the remaining dill.

title: Light Olivier salad with chicken, cucumber and yoghurt
instructions: Poach the chicken breast for 12 minutes, cool and dice it. Cook the carrot and peas for 6 minutes, then cool.
Dice the cucumber and gherkins and mix them with the chicken, carrot and peas.
Stir the yoghurt with mustard, lemon juice and dill, fold it into the diced salad and serve cold.

title: Vinegret of beetroot, potatoes, peas and sauerkraut
instructions: Dice the pre-cooked beetroot and the cooked potatoes. Cook the peas for 5 minutes, then cool.
Mix with the sauerkraut and the finely diced onion.
Fold in the olive oil, dill, salt and pepper and serve the salad cold.

title: Lobiani (Georgian bean flatbread) with adjika and cabbage salad
instructions: Coarsely crush the white beans. Knead the wholemeal flour with 3 tbsp water into a dough, roll it out, fill with half of the beans and close into a flatbread.
Brush with 4 g of the olive oil and bake at 200 °C for 18 minutes.

Chop the pepper and chilli with the remaining oil and coriander into an adjika. Mix the white cabbage with apple cider vinegar, salt and pepper into a cabbage salad. Serve the flatbread with the remaining beans, adjika and salad.

title: Khinkali with beef filling and coriander
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour and water into a firm dough and rest it for 10 minutes.
Mix the minced beef with the finely chopped onion, half of the coriander, salt and pepper and 2 tbsp cold water.
Roll the dough out thinly, cut out 5 circles, fill them and pleat the edges into a gathered top.
Cook in boiling salted water for 12 minutes and serve with the remaining coriander. Do not eat the top; drink the broth inside first.

title: Lobio (Georgian borlotti stew with walnuts) and cornbread
instructions: Sweat the onion in the olive oil for 5 minutes, add the borlotti beans, roughly chopped walnuts, vinegar, salt and pepper and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the coriander.
Stir the cornmeal with the water and a pinch of salt into a firm dough, flatten it and cook in a pan for 4 minutes per side.
Serve the lobio in a deep plate with the cornbread.

title: Chakhokhbili (Georgian chicken tomato stew) with polenta
instructions: Dice the chicken breast and fry it in the olive oil with the onion and pepper for 6 minutes.
Add the passata and chickpeas, braise with salt and pepper for 15 minutes. Stir in the coriander.
Leave the polenta to swell with 30 ml boiling water for 3 minutes and serve as a small accompaniment to the stew.

title: Beef cevapi with onions, kajmak and summer salad
instructions: Knead the minced beef with half of the finely diced onion, salt and pepper and shape 6 small cevapi rolls.
Fry in the rapeseed oil for 8 minutes, turning, until browned all over.
Dice the tomatoes, cucumber and pepper and mix with the remaining onion. Serve the cevapi with the kajmak, onions and the summer salad.

title: Shopska salad with grilled peppers and sheep cheese
instructions: Dice the tomatoes and cucumber, cut the grilled pepper into strips and finely chop the onion.
Fold in the chickpeas and parsley and dress with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Coarsely grate the sheep cheese over it and serve immediately.

title: Banitsa with spinach, cheese and yoghurt
instructions: Wilt the spinach, squeeze it out and mix with the crumbled sheep cheese, half of the yoghurt, the egg, dill, salt and pepper.
Brush the filo pastry with the olive oil, layer or loosely roll it with the filling and place it in a small tin.
Bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes until golden. Stir the yoghurt with the lemon juice and serve it alongside.

title: Mamaliga with sour cream, cheese and mushroom ragout
instructions: Bring the water to the boil with salt, rain in the polenta and cook for 8 minutes, stirring, until thick. Turn it out onto a plate.
Fry the mushrooms and onion in the rapeseed oil for 8 minutes and season with salt, pepper and parsley.
Top the mamaliga with the sour cream and grated mountain cheese and serve the mushroom ragout beside or on top.

title: Hungarian stuffed peppers with minced turkey and rice
instructions: Mix the minced turkey with the uncooked parboiled rice, grated onion, parsley, salt and pepper.
Cut the tops off the peppers, deseed them and fill with the mixture. Stand them upright in a pot.
Pour in the passata and olive oil, cover and braise for 30 minutes until the rice and peppers are cooked.

title: Cacciucco (Tuscan fish soup) with wholemeal bread
instructions: Sweat the garlic in the olive oil for 2 minutes, pour in the passata and simmer for 8 minutes.
Slice the squid into rings and cook for 6 minutes. Add the diced cod and the mussels and simmer for a further 6 minutes until the mussels open. Season with salt, pepper and parsley.
Toast the wholemeal bread, place it in a deep plate and ladle the soup over it.

title: Vitello tonnato with capers and rocket
instructions: Slice the cooked veal escalope cold into very thin slices and arrange them in a fan on a plate.
Puree the tuna with the yoghurt, 8 g of the olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper until smooth.
Spoon the sauce over the veal, top with capers and rocket and drizzle with the remaining olive oil.

title: Veal scaloppine al limone with capers and leaf spinach
instructions: Gently flatten the veal schnitzel, season with salt and pepper and fry in 6 g of the olive oil for 2 minutes per side, then lift out.
Reduce the lemon juice, capers and 2 tbsp water in the pan for 1 minute and turn the schnitzel in the sauce.
Wilt the spinach in the remaining olive oil for 2 minutes, season with salt and serve beside the scaloppine.

title: Pasta e fagioli with borlotti, rosemary and wholemeal pasta
instructions: Sweat the celery and garlic in the olive oil for 3 minutes, add the passata, rosemary, salt and pepper and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the borlotti beans and 150 ml water and simmer for 8 minutes.
Cook the wholemeal pasta in the sauce for 10 minutes until al dente and serve in a deep plate.

title: Tonnarelli cacio e pepe, lemon zest and rocket salad
instructions: Cook the wholemeal pasta in salted water for 9 minutes until al dente, reserving 4 tbsp of the cooking water.
Stir the hard cheese with the cooking water and plenty of black pepper into a creamy sauce, toss the pasta in it and grate over the lemon zest.
Dress the rocket with olive oil and a pinch of salt as a salad and serve it alongside.

title: Cavatelli with broccoli leaves, anchovies and breadcrumbs
instructions: Cook the wholemeal pasta for 9 minutes until al dente. Cut the broccoli into florets and cook them in the last 4 minutes.
Melt the garlic and anchovies in the olive oil for 2 minutes, toast the bread leftovers with them for 2 minutes.
Toss the pasta and broccoli in the pan, season with parsley, salt and pepper and serve with the breadcrumbs.

title: Minestrone alla genovese with pesto and wholemeal bread
instructions: Dice the carrot, courgette and green beans and sweat them in the olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetable stock and borlotti beans and simmer for 12 minutes. Season with salt, pepper and basil.
Stir in the pesto, serve in a deep plate and offer the wholemeal bread alongside.

title: Gnocchi alla Sorrentina with tomato and mozzarella
instructions: Cut the courgette into half-moons and fry in the olive oil for 5 minutes. Add the passata, salt, pepper and basil and simmer for 6 minutes.
Blanch the gnocchi in salted water for 2 minutes, lift them into the sauce and transfer to a small baking dish.
Tear the mozzarella over it and bake at 200 °C for 8 minutes until the cheese melts.

title: Pumpkin gnocchi with sage butter and walnuts
instructions: Cut the Hokkaido pumpkin into cubes, steam until soft for 12 minutes, mash and let the steam escape. Knead with the wholemeal flour, egg, salt and pepper into a dough.
Cut small gnocchi and cook them in salted water for 3 minutes until they float.
Brown the butter with the sage for 2 minutes until nutty, roughly chop the walnuts. Toss the gnocchi in the butter and serve with the nuts.

title: Risotto al nero di seppia with lemon and parsley
instructions: Sweat the onion in the olive oil for 3 minutes until translucent, toast the round-grain rice with it for 1 minute.
Slice the squid into rings and add it with the squid ink. Add the vegetable stock gradually over 18 minutes, stirring, until the risotto is creamy.
Finish with lemon juice, parsley, salt and pepper and serve immediately.

title: Risotto with radicchio, red wine and walnuts
instructions: Cut the radicchio into strips. Toast the round-grain rice in the olive oil for 1 minute, deglaze with the alcohol-free red wine and let it reduce.
Add the vegetable stock gradually over 16 minutes, stirring, and fold in the radicchio after 8 minutes.
Roughly chop the walnuts, stir in the hard cheese, salt and pepper and serve immediately.

title: Polenta e baccala with olive oil and parsley
instructions: Bring the water to the boil with a pinch of salt, rain in the polenta and cook for 8 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Fry the cod in 6 g of the olive oil for 6 minutes and season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
Spread the polenta on a plate, place the fish on top and finish with the remaining olive oil and parsley.

title: Carciofi alla romana with mint, garlic and spelt
instructions: Simmer the spelt in 150 ml water for 20 minutes until it is tender with a bite.
Halve the artichoke hearts lengthways. Chop the garlic and mint, rub them with 6 g of the olive oil, salt and pepper into the cut surfaces.
Braise the artichokes in a pot with the remaining oil, covered, for 12 minutes, deglaze with lemon juice. Serve with the spelt.

title: Jota triestina (sauerkraut and bean soup) with wholemeal bread
instructions: Dice the potato and simmer it with the sauerkraut, borlotti beans, caraway and bay leaf in 250 ml water for 20 minutes.
Toast the garlic in the olive oil for 1 minute, stir it into the soup, remove the bay leaf and season with salt and pepper.
Serve in a deep plate with the wholemeal bread.

title: Anelletti al forno (baked pasta rings with aubergine and peas)
instructions: Parboil the wholemeal pasta for 6 minutes and drain. Dice the aubergine and fry it in the olive oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Simmer the passata, peas, basil, salt and pepper for 5 minutes, then fold in the pasta and aubergine.
Transfer to a small baking dish, tear the mozzarella over it and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes.

title: Beef polpette al sugo with polenta
instructions: Knead the minced beef with the egg, soaked bread leftovers, parsley, salt and pepper and shape 6 small meatballs. Brown them all over in the olive oil for 6 minutes.
Pour in the passata and simmer for 12 minutes.
Leave the polenta to swell with 160 ml boiling water for 5 minutes, spread it on a plate and place the meatballs and sauce on top.

title: Pappardelle with duck ragout and orange zest
instructions: Dice the skinless duck breast and brown it in the olive oil for 6 minutes, sweat the onion with it for 3 minutes.
Add the passata, orange juice and zest, thyme, salt and pepper and reduce for 15 minutes.
Cook the wholemeal pasta for 9 minutes until al dente, toss with the ragout and serve immediately.

title: Pastitsio with minced turkey and wholemeal macaroni
instructions: Sweat the onion in the olive oil for 3 minutes, fry the minced turkey for 6 minutes until crumbly, add the passata, cinnamon, salt and pepper and simmer for 8 minutes.
Parboil the wholemeal pasta for 6 minutes. Beat the yoghurt with the egg.
Layer the pasta, meat sauce and yoghurt topping in a small dish and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until golden.

title: Vegetarian moussaka with lentils, aubergine and a yoghurt topping
instructions: Cook the lentils in 200 ml water for 20 minutes until soft, then drain. Slice the aubergine and fry it in the olive oil for 8 minutes.
Sweat the onion, reduce the passata, cinnamon, salt and pepper for 8 minutes and fold in the lentils.
Layer the aubergine and lentil sauce, spread the yoghurt on top as a topping and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes.

title: Crostata di visciole (sour-cherry tart) with ricotta
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour, olive oil, 10 g of the egg and 1 tbsp water into a shortcrust, chill for 10 minutes and press it into a small tin.
Stir the ricotta with the remaining egg and 4 g of the honey, spread it on the base, scatter the sour cherries on top and drizzle with the remaining honey.
Bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes until the edge is golden and serve lukewarm.

title: Affogato of yoghurt ice cream and espresso
instructions: Stir the yoghurt with 8 g of the honey and freeze for 2 hours, stirring once, or churn in an ice-cream maker for 15 minutes.
Roughly chop the hazelnuts. Brew the espresso fresh.
Place a scoop of yoghurt ice cream in a glass, pour the hot espresso over it and finish with the remaining honey and hazelnuts.

title: One-pot chicken with parboiled rice, peas and lemon
instructions: Dice the chicken breast and fry it in the olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the rice, peas and vegetable stock, season with salt and pepper and simmer covered for 18 minutes until the rice is cooked.
Fold in the lemon juice and parsley and serve immediately.

title: One-pan cod with fennel, olives and cherry tomatoes
instructions: Cut the fennel into wedges and fry it in the olive oil for 6 minutes.
Add the cherry tomatoes and olives, place the cod on top, season with salt and pepper and cook covered for 10 minutes.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve straight from the pan.

title: Tray-baked gnocchi with tomato, courgette and mozzarella
instructions: Cut the courgette and pepper into chunks and halve the cherry tomatoes. Toss with the gnocchi, peas, olive oil, oregano, salt and pepper on a tray.
Roast at 200 °C for 18 minutes, turning once after 10 minutes.
Tear the mozzarella over it, melt for 4 minutes and serve immediately.

title: Pasta bake with salmon, spinach and cottage cheese
instructions: Parboil the wholemeal pasta for 7 minutes and drain. Wilt the spinach for 2 minutes.
Dice the salmon fillet and mix it with the cottage cheese, spinach, lemon, dill, salt and pepper, then fold in the pasta.
Transfer to a small baking dish and bake at 190 °C for 15 minutes until the salmon is cooked.

title: Shepherd's pie with minced turkey and a root-vegetable topping
instructions: Precook the lentils for 15 minutes. Fry the onion and minced turkey in the rapeseed oil for 6 minutes, add the diced carrot, peas, thyme, salt and pepper and simmer for 8 minutes, then fold in the lentils.
Dice the celeriac, boil it until soft for 12 minutes and mash it.
Put the meat mixture in a dish, spread the celeriac mash on top as a topping and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes until golden.

title: Fish pie with cod, leek and a potato topping
instructions: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes and mash them with the milk, season with salt and pepper.
Slice the leek into rings and sweat in the rapeseed oil for 5 minutes. Dice the cod, place it in a dish with the leek, dill, salt and pepper.
Spread the mashed potato on top as a topping and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes until golden.

title: One-pot chilli sin carne with cocoa, lime and parboiled rice
instructions: Sweat the onion in the olive oil for 3 minutes, toast the soy mince, cumin, chilli and salt with it for 2 minutes.
Add the passata, kidney beans, cocoa and 150 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes. Finish with the lime juice.
Cook the parboiled rice in 80 ml water for 12 minutes and serve with the chilli.

title: Tray-baked skinless chicken thighs with potatoes, pepper and oregano
instructions: Cut the potatoes into wedges and the pepper into chunks, toss with 6 g of the olive oil, oregano, salt and pepper on a tray.
Rub the chicken thighs with the remaining oil, lemon, salt and pepper and place them on the vegetables.
Roast at 200 °C for 30 minutes until the meat is cooked and the potatoes are golden.

title: Meal-prep chicken quinoa box with roasted vegetables
instructions: Cook the quinoa in 120 ml water for 12 minutes.
Cut the courgette, pepper and broccoli into chunks, toss with 4 g of the olive oil, salt and pepper and roast on a tray at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Fry the chicken breast in the remaining oil for 8 minutes and slice it into strips. Arrange everything in a box and drizzle with lemon juice.

title: Meal-prep salmon and potato box with green beans and mustard yoghurt
instructions: Quarter the potatoes and boil them for 15 minutes. Steam the green beans for 6 minutes.
Cook the salmon fillet with 4 g rapeseed oil, salt and pepper for 8 minutes in a pan or in the oven.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard and dill. Arrange everything in a box and serve with the dip.

title: One-pot dal with spinach, light coconut milk and parboiled rice
instructions: Sweat the onion in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes, toast the cumin, turmeric and salt with it for 30 seconds and stir in the tomato paste.
Add the lentils and 250 ml water and simmer for 18 minutes. Fold in the spinach and light coconut milk for 3 minutes.
Cook the parboiled rice in 80 ml water for 12 minutes and serve with the dal.
