Fill the tomatoes and arrange potato wedges and the white beans around them on an oiled tray.
Bake at 190 °C for 35 minutes until the rice and potatoes are tender.

title: Ciambotta pugliese with white beans, herbs and wholemeal bread
instructions: Sauté the aubergine, zucchini, pepper and onion in olive oil for 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and white beans and braise for 15 minutes.
Season with basil, oregano, capers and olives and serve with wholemeal bread.

title: Carabaccia (Tuscan onion soup with almonds, cinnamon and wholemeal croutons)
instructions: Sweat the onions in olive oil very slowly for 15 minutes until golden, then add the cinnamon.
Pour in the stock, simmer 15 minutes, then blend smooth with the almonds.
Serve with parsley and toasted wholemeal croutons.

title: Esqueixada (Catalan salt-cod salad with tomato, olive and pepper)
instructions: Shred the desalted salt-cod into fibres.
Mix with diced tomato, pepper, spring onion, olives, olive oil and vinegar.
Scatter with parsley, orange segments and rocket and serve with wholemeal bread.

title: Empedrat (white-bean salad with cod, tomato and olive)
instructions: Cut the cod into bite-sized pieces.
Toss with the white beans, tomato, olives and spring onion.
Fold in the diced cucumber and egg, and dress with olive oil, vinegar and parsley.

title: Açorda alentejana (coriander and garlic bread soup with a poached egg)
instructions: Pound the garlic, coriander and olive oil to a paste in a mortar.
Pour the hot stock over the paste, add the wholemeal bread and leave to soak for 3 minutes.
Poach the egg, set it on the açorda, top with chilli, diced tomato, orange segments and rocket and serve at once.

title: Coca de recapte (Catalan vegetable flatbread with pepper, aubergine and onion)
instructions: Roll out the wholemeal dough made from flour, water and some of the oil.
Cut the pepper, aubergine and onion into strips, toss with the remaining oil and spread on the dough.
Scatter with oregano and bake at 220 °C for 18 minutes until golden.

title: Pipirrana andaluza with tuna, egg, green pepper and olive oil
instructions: Hard-boil the egg, peel and dice it.
Dice the pepper, tomato and cucumber and mix with the tuna, olives and egg.
Dress with olive oil and vinegar and serve with wholemeal bread.

title: Remojón granadino (orange and salt-cod salad with olive and egg)
instructions: Segment the oranges, hard-boil and quarter the egg, shred the salt-cod.
Arrange on a plate with the olives and spring onion.
Finish with olive oil and parsley.

title: Alboronía (Andalusian braised aubergine and chickpeas with cumin)
instructions: Sauté the aubergine and zucchini in olive oil for 8 minutes, then add the onion.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and cumin and braise for 12 minutes.
Season with parsley, lemon juice and chopped almonds and serve warm.

title: Menestra de verduras with artichokes, asparagus and egg
instructions: Sweat the carrot and artichokes in olive oil for 5 minutes, then add the stock.
Add the asparagus and peas and braise for 8 minutes.
Hard-boil the egg, quarter it and set on the vegetables, serve with parsley.

title: Patatas a lo pobre with green pepper, onion and a fried egg
instructions: Slice the potatoes and slowly cook with the pepper and onion in olive oil for 20 minutes until soft, not deep-fried crisp.
Fry the egg in a pan.
Plate the vegetables, set the egg on top and serve with parsley, rocket and lemon juice.

title: Espinacas a la catalana (spinach with raisins, pine nuts and wholemeal bread)
instructions: Toast the pine nuts in olive oil until golden, then briefly cook the garlic with them.
Add the spinach and wilt for 3 minutes, then fold in the raisins.
Serve with toasted wholemeal bread.

title: Chicken shawarma plate with salad, tomato, cucumber and tahini
instructions: Marinate the chicken with the spices, garlic, lemon juice and some of the oil for 20 minutes, then fry for 10 minutes.
Stir the tahini with the remaining lemon juice and a splash of water until smooth.
Plate with the salad, tomato, cucumber and warm wholemeal pitta, and drizzle with tahini.

title: Pollo coi peperoni alla romana with tomato and rosemary
instructions: Brown the chicken in olive oil with garlic and rosemary for 6 minutes.
Add the peppers, zucchini, fennel, passata, capers, olives and raisins and braise for 20 minutes.
Season and serve with toasted wholemeal bread.

title: Spezzatino di pollo with peas, tomato and wholemeal orzo
instructions: Brown the chicken and onion in olive oil for 6 minutes.
Add the passata and 150 ml water, braise 15 minutes, stir in the peas and orzo and cook 10 minutes more.
Finish with parsley and serve hot.

title: Chicken alla livornese with capers, olives and polenta, plus zucchini
instructions: Brown the chicken in olive oil with garlic for 5 minutes, add the passata, capers, olives, zucchini, fennel, spinach and peas and braise 15 minutes.
Cook the polenta in 160 ml water for 8 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Spoon the polenta onto the plate and top with the chicken, sauce, sesame, orange and grapefruit pieces and parsley.

title: Kotopoulo me bamies (chicken with okra in tomato) and herb rice
instructions: Drizzle the okra with lemon juice. Brown the chicken and onion in olive oil for 6 minutes.
Add the passata, braise 10 minutes, stir in the okra and cook 12 minutes more.
Cook the brown rice with dill and parsley for 20 minutes and serve with the chicken.

title: Makdous plate (walnut-stuffed aubergines with tomato salad and wholemeal flatbread)
instructions: Slice the aubergine or cut it into small halves and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes until soft.
Crush the walnuts with garlic and a little oil and spoon onto the aubergine.
Plate a tomato salad with parsley, vinegar, chilli and pomegranate seeds beside it and serve with wholemeal flatbread.

title: Rummanieh (lentil and aubergine pan with pomegranate molasses)
instructions: Par-cook the lentils in water for 15 minutes. Fry the aubergine cubes in olive oil until golden.
Add the onion, stir in the lentils and a little cooking water and braise for 10 minutes.
Stir in the pomegranate molasses, lemon juice and coriander and serve with wholemeal bread.

title: Taameya plate (Egyptian broad-bean falafel with tahini and cabbage salad)
instructions: Coarsely blend the broad beans, chickpeas, herbs and onion and shape into small discs.
Fry in olive oil for 3 minutes per side until golden, without deep-frying.
Stir the tahini with lemon juice, mix the cabbage salad with tomato and serve with wholemeal pitta.

title: Culurgiones (Sardinian potato and mint dumplings) with tomato sauce
instructions: Boil and mash the potatoes and mix with mint and pecorino. Make a dough from the flour, water and some of the oil.
Roll out the dough, fill and seal as culurgiones. Simmer in salted water for 4 minutes until they rise.
Simmer the passata with the remaining oil and basil for 8 minutes and toss the dumplings in it.

title: Inzimino di ceci (chickpeas with chard, tomato and olive oil)
instructions: Sweat the onion and garlic in olive oil, then simmer the passata for 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and chopped chard and braise for 12 minutes.
Season and serve with toasted wholemeal bread.

title: Pasta chi vruoccoli (Sicilian wholemeal pasta with broccoli, pine nuts and raisins)
instructions: Cook the wholemeal pasta in salted water, adding the broccoli 2 minutes before the pasta is al dente.
Toast the pine nuts and garlic in olive oil until golden, then add the raisins.
Toss the pasta and broccoli in the pan and serve with parsley.

title: Zucchine alla scapece (marinated zucchini with mint, vinegar and wholemeal bread)
instructions: Slice the zucchini and fry in olive oil for 5 minutes until golden, then leave to cool.
Marinate with mint, vinegar and garlic and leave for 10 minutes.
Serve with toasted wholemeal bread.

title: Melanzane a funghetto (aubergine cubes with tomato, basil and wholemeal bread)
instructions: Fry the aubergine cubes in olive oil for 8 minutes until they take on colour.
Add the tomatoes, garlic, white beans and capers and braise for 8 minutes.
Fold in the basil and serve with toasted wholemeal bread.

title: Mesciua (Ligurian mixed-pulse pot with olive oil and pepper)
instructions: Par-cook the lentils in the stock for 15 minutes, add the chickpeas and white beans and simmer 10 minutes more.
Season with olive oil and plenty of pepper.
Serve with parsley and a slice of wholemeal bread.

title: Lenticchie di Castelluccio with chard and rosemary
instructions: Sweat the onion, carrot and celery in olive oil, then add the lentils.
Add the stock and rosemary, simmer 20 minutes, and fold in the chard for the last 5 minutes.
Season with lemon juice and chilli and serve hot with lamb's lettuce, orange pieces, diced tomato and a slice of wholemeal bread.

title: Pasta e patate napoletana with celery and light cheese
instructions: Sweat the onion and celery in olive oil, add the diced potatoes and passata and braise for 10 minutes.
Add a little water and cook the wholemeal pasta directly in the sauce for 12 minutes until creamy.
Fold in the light cheese and parsley and serve at once.

title: Bazzoffia (Umbrian artichoke soup with egg and pecorino)
instructions: Sweat the spring onion in olive oil, add the artichokes and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Beat the egg and stir it into the hot soup, then fold in the pecorino.
Season with mint and parsley and serve with wholemeal bread.

title: Soutzoukakia of turkey mince in cinnamon tomato sauce with brown rice
instructions: Shape the turkey mince with a little flour, onion, garlic and the spices into small rolls.
Brown in olive oil, add the passata and cinnamon and braise for 15 minutes.
Cook the brown rice for 20 minutes, briefly wilt the cabbage, and serve with parsley and lemon juice alongside the soutzoukakia.

title: Revithosalata with sun-dried tomatoes, capers and rocket
instructions: Coarsely crush the chickpeas and mix with olive oil and lemon juice.
Fold in the sun-dried tomatoes and capers and top with the rocket.
Serve with warm wholemeal pitta.

title: Kotopoulo me horta (roast chicken with greens, lemon and barley)
instructions: Rub the chicken with olive oil, oregano and lemon juice and roast at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Cook the barley in 110 ml water for 20 minutes.
Wilt the greens in the same pan for 4 minutes and plate with the barley and chicken.

title: Tuna steak on samfaina with toasted almonds
instructions: Braise the aubergine, zucchini, pepper, tomato and garlic in olive oil for 15 minutes into a samfaina.
Sear the tuna steak for 2 minutes per side, leaving the centre slightly pink.
Spoon the samfaina onto the plate and top with the tuna and toasted almonds.

title: Sea bream on fregola sarda with zucchini, saffron and lemon
instructions: Par-cook the fregola in salted water for 10 minutes. Sauté the zucchini in olive oil for 5 minutes, add saffron and a little cooking water.
Add the fregola to the pan and finish cooking for 3 minutes.
Pan-fry the sea bream for 3–4 minutes per side, set it on the fregola and serve with lemon and parsley.

title: Cod al pil-pil with garlic, chilli and parsley potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes, halve them and toss with parsley and a little of the oil.
Warm the garlic and chilli in the remaining olive oil over low heat for 3 minutes, cook the cod in it for 4 minutes per side and gently emulsify the sauce.
Plate the fish with the sauce and the parsley potatoes.

title: Baked sardines with fennel, potatoes and oregano
instructions: Slice the fennel and potatoes, toss with olive oil and oregano on a tray and pre-bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Lay the sardines on top and bake for 12 minutes more.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve at once.

title: Fakes salata with beetroot, walnut and feta
instructions: Cook the lentils in water for 20 minutes, drain and leave to cool.
Dice the beetroot and toss with the lentils, rocket, diced cucumber, orange segments, walnuts and feta.
Dress with olive oil and lemon juice.

title: Berkoukes (Algerian wholegrain pearls) with chickpeas, tomato and herbs
instructions: Sweat the onion in olive oil, then add the passata, spices and 150 ml water.
Simmer the berkoukes and chickpeas for 12 minutes, adding the zucchini for the last 5 minutes.
Finish with coriander and parsley and serve hot.

title: Rechta (Algerian wholemeal noodles) with chicken, chickpeas and cinnamon
instructions: Brown the chicken with onion, carrot, olive oil and the spices for 8 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and 200 ml water and braise for 15 minutes.
Cook the rechta until al dente and plate with the stew and coriander.

title: Moroccan carrot salad with chicken breast, cumin and wholemeal couscous
instructions: Pan-fry the chicken with a little oil and the spices for 8 minutes and slice.
Soak the wholemeal couscous in 100 ml hot water for 10 minutes.
Grate the carrots, toss with lemon juice, orange juice, the remaining oil and herbs, and plate with the chicken and couscous.

title: Moroccan orange and olive salad with cinnamon and mint
instructions: Segment the oranges, catching the juice.
Toss with the olives, cinnamon, mint, olive oil and the juice.
Serve with a slice of wholemeal bread.

title: Chtitha djedj (Algerian pepper chicken with chickpeas and wholemeal bread)
instructions: Brown the chicken with garlic, the spices and olive oil for 6 minutes.
Add the peppers, carrot, zucchini, passata, chickpeas and spinach and braise for 15 minutes.
Finish with coriander, lemon juice, sesame and orange pieces and serve with wholemeal bread.

title: Chicken with za'atar, roasted cauliflower and tahini
instructions: Roast the cauliflower florets with some of the oil at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Rub the chicken with za'atar and the remaining oil and pan-fry for 10 minutes.
Stir the tahini with lemon juice and plate everything with parsley.

title: Scrambled eggs with mascarpone, mushrooms and chives
instructions: Fry the mushrooms in the butter for 5 minutes until they have golden edges.
Beat the eggs, add them to the mushrooms and gently scramble over medium heat for 3 minutes until creamy.
Fold in the mascarpone, season with chives, salt and pepper and serve at once.

title: Baked avocado with egg, parmesan and chilli
instructions: Halve the avocado lengthways, remove the stone and slightly widen the hollows.
Slide one small egg into each half and sprinkle with parmesan and chilli.
Bake at 200 °C for 12 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks are still soft, and serve with salt and pepper.

title: Omelette with camembert, walnuts and lamb's lettuce
instructions: Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes and chop them coarsely.
Beat the eggs, cook them in butter and some of the olive oil as a 2-egg omelette, scatter camembert pieces on top and fold it over.
Dress the lamb's lettuce with the remaining oil, salt and pepper, scatter the walnuts over it and serve with the omelette.

title: Almond-flour pancakes with cream cheese and cucumber
instructions: Stir the almond flour with the egg, a pinch of salt and 1 tbsp water to a thick batter.
Cook 2 small pancakes in the butter for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Spread with cream cheese, top with cucumber slices and dill, and season with salt and pepper.

title: Coconut chia pudding with toasted macadamias
instructions: Stir the chia seeds with the coconut milk and water and leave to swell for 10 minutes, stirring once.
Toast the macadamia nuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden.
Spoon the pudding into a bowl and top with the toasted macadamias and the raspberries.

title: Smoked salmon omelette with avocado and dill
instructions: Beat the eggs with dill, salt and pepper and cook in the butter as a 2-egg omelette.
Lay the smoked salmon on the still-soft omelette and fold it over.
Serve with avocado wedges and a little extra dill.

title: Cheese and egg muffins with spinach and olives
instructions: Wilt the spinach in some of the olive oil for 2 minutes and leave to cool slightly.
Beat the eggs with the cream, salt and pepper, then fold in the spinach, diced mountain cheese and chopped olives.
Divide into two greased ramekins and bake at 180 °C for 16 minutes until set.

title: Baked camembert with celery sticks and walnuts
instructions: Score the top of the camembert in a cross, top with thyme and bake at 180 °C for 12 minutes until soft.
Toast the walnuts dry for 2 minutes, and cut the celery and radishes into sticks.
Serve the hot cheese with walnuts, salt and pepper, and place the celery and radish sticks beside it for dipping.

title: Fried eggs on portobello with herb butter and rocket
instructions: Clean the portobello mushrooms and fry them with crushed garlic and half of the herb butter for 6 minutes.
Fry 2 eggs in the remaining herb butter for 3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks stay soft.
Place one fried egg on each mushroom and serve with rocket, salt and pepper.

title: Grain-free pumpkin-seed porridge with coconut milk and raspberries
instructions: Stir the pumpkin seeds and flaxseed with the coconut milk, coconut flakes and water in a pan until smooth.
Warm over low heat for 6 minutes, stirring, until it has a creamy porridge texture.
Spoon into a bowl and top with the raspberries.

title: Salmon with butter-dill sauce and leaf spinach
instructions: Season the salmon fillet with salt and pepper and fry in some of the butter for 4 minutes per side, then keep warm.
Simmer the dill and cream in the remaining fat for 2 minutes and finish with lemon juice.
Wilt the leaf spinach in the same pan for 2 minutes and serve with the salmon and the sauce.

title: Rump steak with rosemary butter and sauteed romanesco
instructions: Break the romanesco into florets and fry in the olive oil with the garlic for 8 minutes until just tender, then season with salt.
Season the rump steak with salt and pepper and fry in a hot pan for 3 minutes per side.
Place the butter and rosemary on the steak, rest for 2 minutes and serve with the romanesco.

title: Chicken thigh with skin, cauliflower puree and brown butter
instructions: Salt the chicken thigh with skin and fry skin-side down for 8 minutes, then 6 minutes on the other side until crisp, and season with thyme.
Steam the cauliflower until soft for 10 minutes, puree it with the cream and half of the butter, and season with salt and pepper.
Melt the remaining butter for 2 minutes until nut-brown and drizzle it over the puree and the chicken.

title: Turkey schnitzel with a parmesan crust, zucchini and lemon
instructions: Lightly pound the turkey escalope, dip it in the beaten egg and coat it in the mix of parmesan and almond flour.
Fry in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side until golden, and season with salt and pepper.
Fry the zucchini slices in the same pan for 5 minutes and serve with lemon wedges beside the schnitzel.

title: Zucchini spaghetti with basil pesto, chicken and parmesan
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into strips and fry in some of the olive oil for 6 minutes until golden, then season with salt.
Cut the zucchini into spaghetti with a spiraliser and warm them in the pan for just 2 minutes.
Toss with the basil pesto, the remaining oil and the pine nuts, scatter parmesan over, season with salt and pepper and serve at once.

title: Cauliflower pizza with mozzarella, olives and artichokes
instructions: Finely grate the cauliflower, steam for 4 minutes, squeeze dry and knead with the egg, salt and half of the oregano into a base.
Press the base flat onto a tray, brush with olive oil and pre-bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Top with the passata, mozzarella, olives and artichokes, scatter the remaining oregano and bake for 8 minutes more.

title: Stuffed mushrooms with cream cheese, herbs and walnuts
instructions: Remove the mushroom stalks and fry the caps in a little olive oil for 2 minutes.
Mix the cream cheese with parmesan, parsley, chives, chopped walnuts, salt and pepper and fill the caps.
Bake at 190 °C for 12 minutes until the filling has golden spots.

title: Beef steak with mushroom cream sauce and green beans
instructions: Blanch the green beans for 6 minutes until just tender, then toss them in some of the butter.
Season the beef steak with salt and pepper, fry in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side and leave to rest.
Fry the mushrooms in the remaining butter for 5 minutes, reduce the cream for 3 minutes and spoon the sauce over the steak.

title: Lamb chops with garlic herb butter and grilled zucchini
instructions: Mash the butter with garlic, parsley and thyme and keep it cold.
Salt the lamb chops and fry them in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Fry the zucchini in long slices for 5 minutes alongside, place the herb butter on the meat and serve with salt and pepper.

title: Duck breast with creamy savoy cabbage and thyme
instructions: Salt the duck breast and fry it without added fat for 6 minutes skin-side down, then 4 minutes on the flesh side, and leave to rest.
Sweat the onion and savoy cabbage in butter and thyme for 8 minutes, pour in the cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Slice the duck, lay it on the creamy savoy cabbage and season with salt and pepper.

title: Mackerel with mustard cream and cucumber salad
instructions: Season the mackerel fillet with salt and pepper and fry in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side.
Stir the sour cream with the mustard and some of the dill.
Slice the cucumber, dress it with apple cider vinegar, the remaining dill, salt and pepper, and serve with the fish and the mustard cream.

title: Pan-fried halloumi with avocado cucumber salad
instructions: Slice the halloumi and fry it without fat for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Dice the avocado and cucumber, slice the radishes, and mix with mint, olive oil and lemon juice.
Lay the cheese on the salad and season with salt and pepper.

title: Baked cauliflower with cheddar and spring onions
instructions: Break the cauliflower into florets, blanch for 6 minutes until just tender and drain well.
Beat the egg with the cream, nutmeg, salt and pepper and pour it over the cauliflower in a small dish.
Scatter cheddar and spring onions over it and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes until golden.

title: Cheeseburger salad with minced beef, cheddar, cucumber and mustard dressing
instructions: Fry the minced beef with salt and pepper for 8 minutes until crumbly, then melt the cheddar over it at the end.
Stir the mustard with the olive oil into a dressing.
Arrange the iceberg lettuce, tomatoes, pickled gherkin and red onion, top with the warm mince and drizzle with the dressing.

title: Taco salad bowl with minced beef, avocado, cheddar and chipotle
instructions: Fry the minced beef with chipotle powder, cumin, salt and pepper in the olive oil for 8 minutes until crumbly.
Dice the avocado and mix it with lime juice and coriander.
Place the romaine lettuce in a bowl and top with the mince, avocado, cheddar and sour cream.

title: Caesar salad with chicken, parmesan and egg, no croutons
instructions: Salt the chicken breast, fry it in the olive oil for 6 minutes per side and slice it into strips.
Boil the egg for 8 minutes and halve it so one yolk is visible.
Stir the mayonnaise with lemon juice and garlic, toss the romaine in it, top with the chicken, parmesan and the egg, and serve with salt and pepper.

title: Cobb salad with turkey, egg, avocado and blue cheese
instructions: Pan-fry or poach the turkey breast for 8 minutes until cooked, dice it, boil the egg for 8 minutes and quarter it.
Dress the leaf salad with olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt and pepper.
Arrange the turkey, egg, avocado wedges, blue cheese and cherry tomatoes in rows on top.

title: Portobello burger with beef steak, cheddar and salad
instructions: Fry the portobello mushrooms in the olive oil for 5 minutes per side and season with salt.
Fry the beef steak for 3 minutes per side and melt the cheddar on it in the last minute.
Place the steak between the mushrooms and fill with leaf salad, tomato, red onion, salt and pepper.

title: Zucchini boats with minced beef, tomato and mozzarella
instructions: Halve the zucchini lengthways, scoop out some of the flesh and fry for 5 minutes in the olive oil.
Fry the onion and minced beef for 8 minutes, simmer the passata and oregano for 5 minutes, and season with salt and pepper.
Fill the zucchini, scatter mozzarella on top and bake at 200 °C for 12 minutes.

title: Peppers filled with cheese scrambled eggs and herbs
instructions: Halve the red pepper lengthways, deseed it and soften it in the oven at 200 °C for 5 minutes.
Gently scramble the eggs in butter for 3 minutes and fold in the mountain cheese, chives and parsley.
Fill the pepper halves with the scrambled eggs and season with salt and pepper.

title: Savoy cabbage roulades with a cheese and mince filling, no rice
instructions: Blanch the savoy cabbage leaves for 3 minutes and trim the ribs flat.
Mix the minced beef with the egg, grated emmental, onion, salt and pepper and roll it in the leaves.
Brown the roulades in olive oil for 5 minutes, add the passata and braise covered for 20 minutes.

title: Shirataki with egg-parmesan sauce, mushrooms and parsley
instructions: Rinse the shirataki noodles well, soak them in hot water for 2 minutes and drain them dry.
Fry the mushrooms in butter and olive oil for 5 minutes.
Take the pan off the heat, stir the egg yolks, parmesan and parsley into the noodles, season with salt and pepper and do not cook any further.

title: Cauliflower quesadilla with cheese, chicken and guacamole
instructions: Mix the cauliflower with the egg, salt and half of the cheddar into two flat tortillas and cook in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Fry the chicken breast in strips for 6 minutes, place it between the tortillas with the remaining cheddar and melt for 2 minutes.
Mash the avocado with lime and coriander into guacamole and serve it alongside.

title: Aubergine lasagne with minced turkey, ricotta and tomato
instructions: Cut the aubergine into long slices and fry in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side.
Fry the onion and minced turkey for 8 minutes, simmer the passata and basil for 8 minutes, and season with salt and pepper.
Layer aubergine, sauce, ricotta and mozzarella in a dish and bake at 190 °C for 20 minutes.

title: Salmon patties with avocado-lime cream and leaf salad
instructions: Finely chop the salmon fillet and shape it with the egg, almond flour, salt and pepper into 2 patties.
Fry in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Mash the avocado with lime into a cream and serve with the lamb's lettuce and coriander.

title: Minced beef pan with savoy cabbage, feta and olive oil
instructions: Cut the savoy cabbage into strips and sweat it in the olive oil with the garlic for 6 minutes.
Add the minced beef, paprika and caraway and fry for 8 minutes until crumbly, then season with salt and pepper.
Crumble the feta over it and warm for just 1 minute more.

title: Chicken piccata with lemon, capers and Brussels sprouts
instructions: Pound the chicken breast flat, salt it and fry in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side, then keep warm.
Halve the Brussels sprouts and fry them in the same pan for 8 minutes.
Melt the butter, lemon juice, capers and parsley into a sauce for 2 minutes, pour it over the chicken and serve with salt and pepper.

title: Lamb fillet with an almond herb crust and sauteed chard
instructions: Mix the almonds with parsley, rosemary, mustard and some of the olive oil into a crust.
Salt the lamb fillet, sear it for 2 minutes per side, press on the crust and finish at 200 °C for 8 minutes.
Sweat the chard with garlic in the remaining oil for 4 minutes and serve with salt and pepper beside the meat.

title: Celery boats with blue cheese, walnut and pear strips
instructions: Cut the celery into 8 cm lengths.
Mash the gorgonzola until soft and spread it into the grooves.
Top with walnut kernels, pear strips and rocket, and drizzle with olive oil.

title: Cucumber canapes with herb cream cheese and radishes
instructions: Cut the cucumber into 1 cm slices.
Mix the cream cheese with chives, dill, salt and pepper and spoon it onto the slices.
Top with radish slices and cress.

title: Cheese crisps with guacamole and pepper sticks
instructions: Place the mountain cheese in 6 small piles on a lined tray and bake at 200 °C for 8 minutes into golden crisps, then leave to cool.
Mash the avocado with lime and coriander into guacamole and season with salt and pepper.
Cut the red pepper into sticks and serve with the cheese crisps and the guacamole.

title: Olive and almond plate with manchego and cucumber
instructions: Cut the manchego into thin slices or triangles.
Cut the cucumber into sticks, drain the olives and toast the almonds dry for 2 minutes.
Arrange everything on a plate with olive oil and rosemary.

title: Egg salad in avocado shells with chives
instructions: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel them and dice them roughly.
Halve the avocado, scoop out a little of the flesh and mix it with the eggs, yoghurt, lemon juice, chives, salt and pepper.
Spoon the mixture back into the avocado shells.

title: Tuna steak with salsa verde and sauteed cauliflower
instructions: Blend the parsley, basil, capers, garlic, lemon juice and most of the olive oil into salsa verde and season with salt.
Fry the cauliflower florets in the remaining oil for 8 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Fry the tuna steak for 2 minutes per side, leaving it pink inside, and serve with the salsa and cauliflower.

title: Veal schnitzel with sage butter and leaf spinach
instructions: Lightly pound the veal escalope, salt it and fry in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side, then keep warm.
Melt the butter with the sage for 2 minutes until nut-brown.
Wilt the leaf spinach with garlic in the same pan for 2 minutes and serve the schnitzel on top with the sage butter, salt and pepper.

title: Chicken breast in a parmesan-almond crust with broccoli
instructions: Dip the chicken breast in the beaten egg and coat it in parmesan and ground almonds.
Fry in butter and olive oil for 5 minutes per side until golden and season with salt and pepper.
Steam the broccoli for 6 minutes until just tender and serve it alongside.

title: Zucchini cannelloni with ricotta, spinach and tomato sauce
instructions: Slice the zucchini into long, thin ribbons.
Wilt the spinach for 2 minutes, mix it with ricotta, egg, nutmeg, salt and pepper and roll it in the zucchini slices.
Place in a dish, cover with passata and parmesan, drizzle with olive oil and bake at 190 °C for 20 minutes.

title: Beef fillet with peppercorn cream sauce and asparagus
instructions: Season the beef fillet with salt and crushed green peppercorns, fry in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side and leave to rest.
Fry the green asparagus in the butter for 6 minutes until just tender.
Reduce the cream in the steak pan for 3 minutes and spoon the sauce over the meat.

title: Minced turkey skewers with tzatziki, cucumber and tomato
instructions: Mix the minced turkey with onion, half of the mint and dill, salt and pepper, shape onto 2 skewers and fry in the olive oil for 8 minutes, turning often.
Stir the yoghurt with half of the grated cucumber, garlic and the remaining mint and dill into tzatziki.
Serve the remaining cucumber and the tomatoes in slices alongside.

title: Rainbow trout with horseradish cream and cucumber salad
instructions: Salt the rainbow trout fillet and fry it in olive oil and some of the butter for 4 minutes per side.
Warm the cream with the horseradish for 2 minutes, without boiling.
Dress the cucumber with dill, the remaining butter (melted for a sheen), salt and pepper, and serve with the fish and sauce.

title: Mushroom stroganoff of beef with sour cream and dill, no noodles
instructions: Cut the beef rump into strips, sear in butter for 3 minutes and take it out.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the same pan for 6 minutes, stir in the mustard and sour cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Return the meat, fold in the dill and diced gherkin, season with salt and pepper and serve without noodles.

title: Stuffed zucchini with tuna, egg and herb mayonnaise
instructions: Halve the zucchini lengthways, hollow them out and fry in the olive oil for 5 minutes.
Boil the egg for 9 minutes, dice it and mix with the tuna, mayonnaise, parsley, chives, salt and pepper.
Fill the zucchini, scatter mountain cheese over them and bake at 200 °C for 12 minutes.

title: Roast duck leg with red cabbage and walnuts, no dumplings
instructions: Salt the duck leg and fry it skin-side down for 8 minutes until crisp, then finish in the oven at 180 °C for 25 minutes.
Braise the red cabbage with apple cider vinegar, bay leaf and clove for 15 minutes and fold in the butter.
Toast the walnuts for 2 minutes and scatter them over the red cabbage, serve the leg with no dumplings, and season with salt and pepper.

title: Chicken gyros pan with tzatziki, red cabbage and grilled peppers
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into strips and fry with the gyros spice, salt and some of the olive oil for 8 minutes.
Grill the pepper and onion in the remaining oil for 6 minutes, and shred the red cabbage finely.
Stir the yoghurt with cucumber and garlic into tzatziki and serve it with everything.

title: Scampi in chilli garlic oil on leaf spinach
instructions: Warm the garlic and chilli in the olive oil for 1 minute over medium heat, without browning.
Cook the scampi in the oil for 3 minutes until pink and firm, and finish with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Wilt the leaf spinach in the residual oil for 2 minutes and place the scampi and parsley on top.

title: Kohlrabi fritters with herb quark and lamb's lettuce
instructions: Grate the kohlrabi, squeeze it dry and mix with the egg, almond flour, salt and pepper.
Fry 3 small fritters in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Stir the quark with the chives and parsley and serve with the lamb's lettuce.

title: Avocado halves with tuna tartare, sesame and cress
instructions: Finely dice the tuna and mix it with sesame oil, lime, spring onion, salt and pepper.
Halve the avocado, slightly widen the hollows and fill them with the tartare.
Scatter sesame seeds and cress over the top.

title: Deviled eggs with avocado, mustard and paprika
instructions: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool them, peel them, halve them lengthways and scoop out the yolks.
Mash the yolks with avocado, mustard, mayonnaise, salt and pepper until creamy and pipe into the whites.
Dust with paprika powder. The recipe makes 6 halves from 3 eggs.

title: Broccoli cheese soup with chicken and slivered almonds
instructions: Sweat the onion in the butter for 3 minutes, add the broccoli and low-sodium vegetable stock and cook for 12 minutes until soft.
Cook the chicken breast separately for 8 minutes and dice it. Blend the soup smooth with the cream and cheddar, and season with salt and pepper.
Add the chicken to the soup, toast the slivered almonds for 2 minutes and scatter them on top.

title: Pak choi pan with beef strips, ginger and sesame oil, no rice
instructions: Cut the beef rump into strips, sear in the sesame oil for 3 minutes and take it out.
Fry the pak choi, ginger and garlic in the same pan for 4 minutes and add the soy sauce.
Return the meat, fold in the spring onion and sesame and serve without rice.

title: Pike-perch with brown butter, almonds and green beans
instructions: Season the pike-perch fillet with salt and pepper and fry in some of the butter for 4 minutes per side, then keep warm.
Cook the green beans for 6 minutes until just tender.
Brown the remaining butter with the flaked almonds for 2 minutes, add lemon juice and parsley and pour over the fish and beans.

title: Turkey involtini with ricotta, basil and zucchini
instructions: Pound the turkey breast flat, spread it with ricotta, basil, salt and pepper, roll it up and secure with toothpicks.
Brown in olive oil for 4 minutes all over, add the passata and braise for 15 minutes, scattering parmesan over in the last 3 minutes.
Fry the zucchini slices in a second pan for 5 minutes and serve them alongside.

title: Grilled cheese skewers with zucchini, olive and herb oil
instructions: Dice the grilling cheese and zucchini and thread them onto 2 skewers, alternating with olives.
Stir the olive oil with oregano and thyme and brush the skewers with it.
Fry or grill for 3 minutes per side until golden and serve with lemon juice, leaf salad, salt and pepper.

title: Cauliflower couscous with minced lamb, mint and yoghurt
instructions: Finely grate the cauliflower and dry-steam it in some of the olive oil for 5 minutes like couscous, then season with salt.
Fry the minced lamb with onion, cumin and cinnamon in the remaining oil for 8 minutes until crumbly, and season with salt and pepper.
Serve with mint, yoghurt and pomegranate seeds.

title: Salmon tartare with avocado, lime and cucumber
instructions: Finely dice the salmon, and also dice the avocado and cucumber.
Mix everything with olive oil, lime juice and chives.
Season with salt and pepper and serve cold at once.

title: Creamy Tuscan chicken pan with sun-dried tomatoes, spinach and parmesan
instructions: Salt the chicken thighs and fry them in the olive oil for 5 minutes per side until golden.
Fry the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute, pour in the cream and simmer for 6 minutes.
Fold in the spinach for 2 minutes, scatter the parmesan and season with salt and pepper.

title: Asian minced beef in lettuce cups with lime and coriander
instructions: Fry the minced beef with ginger, garlic and chilli in the sesame oil for 8 minutes until crumbly, then add the soy sauce.
Cut the carrot into fine strips and cook it with the mince for 1 minute.
Arrange the lettuce leaves as cups, fill them with the mince and top with lime and coriander.

title: Pepper rings with beef tartare, egg and capers
instructions: Mix the beef tartare with finely diced onion, mustard, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Cut the red pepper into 2 cm rings and fill them with the tartare.
Place 1 egg yolk in the centre of the serving and scatter capers and chives over it.

title: Chia flaxseed crackers with cream cheese and cucumber
instructions: Leave the chia seeds, flaxseed and pumpkin seeds to swell with water, olive oil, salt and pepper for 10 minutes.
Spread thinly on baking paper and bake at 160 °C for 25 minutes until crisp, then break into pieces.
Spread with cream cheese and top with cucumber slices.

title: Baked feta with broccoli, zucchini and olive oil
instructions: Cut the broccoli and zucchini into pieces and toss them on a tray with olive oil, oregano, chilli, salt and pepper.
Place the feta in the centre and scatter the cherry tomatoes around it.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until the cheese is soft and the vegetables are browned.

title: Turkey steak with herb ghee and sauteed radicchio
instructions: Warm the ghee with thyme and rosemary for 1 minute.
Salt the turkey steak and fry it in half of the herb ghee for 4 minutes per side.
Quarter the radicchio, fry it in the remaining ghee and olive oil for 3 minutes, and serve with balsamic, walnuts, salt and pepper beside the meat.

title: Cauliflower egg fried rice with prawns and spring onions
instructions: Finely grate the cauliflower. Fry the prawns in the sesame oil for 3 minutes until pink and take them out.
Fry the cauliflower in the same pan for 5 minutes, stir in the egg and let it set for 1 minute, then add soy sauce and ginger.
Fold in the prawns, spring onions and peas and serve hot.

title: Zucchini fritters with salmon and dill sour cream
instructions: Grate the zucchini, squeeze dry and mix with the egg, almond flour, salt and pepper.
Fry 3 fritters in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Stir the sour cream with dill, lay the smoked salmon on it and serve with the fritters.

title: Venison steak with juniper butter and Brussels sprouts
instructions: Mash the butter with crushed juniper berries and thyme.
Salt the venison steak, fry it in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side, top with the juniper butter and rest for 3 minutes.
Halve the Brussels sprouts and fry them in the same pan for 8 minutes, and serve with salt and pepper.

title: Chicken cordon bleu with cheese, turkey slices and broccoli
instructions: Pound the chicken breast flat, top it with turkey slices and mountain cheese, fold it over and secure it.
Dip in the beaten egg and almond flour, fry in the olive oil for 5 minutes per side until golden, and season with salt and pepper.
Steam the broccoli for 6 minutes until just tender and serve it alongside.

title: Keto carbonara with zucchini noodles, egg and parmesan
instructions: Cut the zucchini into noodles and fry the mushrooms and garlic in the olive oil for 4 minutes.
Warm the zucchini noodles for just 2 minutes, then take the pan off the heat.
Quickly stir in the egg, yolks and parmesan until a creamy sauce forms, and season with salt and pepper. Do not top with a fried egg.

title: Minced lamb pan with aubergine, feta and mint, no rice
instructions: Dice the aubergine and fry it in the olive oil for 8 minutes until soft, then take it out.
Fry the minced lamb with garlic and cumin for 8 minutes until crumbly, return the aubergine and season with salt and pepper.
Top with feta and mint and serve without rice.

title: Saithe with a mustard crust, leaf spinach and cauliflower
instructions: Mix the mustard with the ground almonds and spread it on the saithe fillet.
Sear in the olive oil for 2 minutes, then finish at 200 °C for 10 minutes, and season with salt and pepper.
Steam the cauliflower for 8 minutes, wilt the leaf spinach in the butter for 2 minutes and serve both with the fish.

title: Braised beef brisket with celery, mushrooms and red-wine sauce, no side starch
instructions: Salt the beef brisket and brown it all over in olive oil and some of the butter for 6 minutes.
Fry the celery and mushrooms for 5 minutes, add the alcohol-free red wine and low-sodium vegetable stock, and add the thyme and bay leaf.
Braise covered for 70 minutes, mount the remaining butter into the sauce, season with salt and pepper and serve with no starchy side.

title: Macadamia cheese balls with herbs
instructions: Mix the cream cheese and goat's cheese with half of the chives and parsley, salt and pepper.
Finely chop the macadamia nuts, shape 8 small balls and roll them in the nuts.
Serve with the remaining chives and parsley and cucumber slices.

title: Turkey meatballs with white cabbage mustard salad
instructions: Mix the minced turkey with the egg, half of the onion, parsley, salt and pepper, shape 6 small meatballs and fry in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Shred the white cabbage finely and dress it with the remaining onion, mustard, apple cider vinegar, remaining oil, salt and pepper.
Serve the meatballs on the mustard salad.

title: Sardine salad with egg, olive, avocado and salad leaves
instructions: Fry the sardines in a little olive oil for 3 minutes per side and season with salt.
Boil the egg for 8 minutes and quarter it.
Dress the leaf salad with the remaining oil and lemon juice, top with avocado, olives, egg and sardines, and serve with salt and pepper.

title: Baked chicory with mountain cheese, walnut and pear
instructions: Halve the chicory lengthways, fry in the butter for 4 minutes and place in a dish.
Pour the cream over, scatter mountain cheese and walnuts, and season with salt and pepper.
Bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes and lay thin pear strips on top to serve.

title: Zurich-style sliced turkey with mushrooms, cream and cauliflower puree
instructions: Cut the turkey breast into strips, fry in some of the butter for 4 minutes and take it out.
Fry the onion and mushrooms for 5 minutes, reduce the cream for 4 minutes, return the meat and parsley, and season with salt and pepper.
Steam the cauliflower for 10 minutes, puree it with the remaining butter and serve it as the side.

title: Coconut pancakes made from eggs, with berries and almond butter
instructions: Beat the eggs with the coconut flakes and cream cheese into a batter.
Cook 3 small pancakes in the coconut oil for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Spread with almond butter and top with raspberries and blueberries.

title: Salmon burger with no bun, avocado and salad
instructions: Coarsely chop the salmon fillet and shape it with the egg, dill, salt and pepper into 1 large patty.
Fry in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Serve on leaf salad with avocado slices, tomato and red onion, with no bun.

title: Radish carpaccio with parmesan, olive and rocket
instructions: Slice the radish very thinly and arrange it on a plate.
Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Shave the parmesan over it and scatter olives and rocket on top.

title: Beef carpaccio with rocket, parmesan and olive oil
instructions: Slice the beef rump very thinly and arrange it cold on a plate.
Slice the mushrooms very thinly and lay them on top.
Finish with olive oil, lemon juice, rocket and parmesan, and season with salt and pepper.

title: Stuffed pointed peppers with tuna-egg cream
instructions: Halve the pointed peppers lengthways and deseed them.
Boil the egg for 9 minutes, mash it and mix with the tuna, cream cheese, capers, lemon juice, parsley, salt and pepper.
Fill the peppers with the cream and serve them cold or lightly baked at 180 °C for 8 minutes.

title: Zucchini lasagne with salmon, ricotta and dill
instructions: Slice the zucchini into long sheets and cut the salmon fillet into thin pieces.
Mix the ricotta with the egg, dill, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Layer zucchini, ricotta and salmon in a dish, top with parmesan and bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes.

title: Scrambled eggs with smoked trout, horseradish and cucumber
instructions: Gently scramble the eggs in the butter for 3 minutes until moist and season with salt and pepper.
Flake the smoked trout into pieces and fold it in.
Serve with horseradish, cucumber slices and dill. The scramble is made from 3 eggs, with no whole yolks visible.

title: Ghee prawns with cauliflower rice and coriander
instructions: Finely grate the cauliflower and fry it in some of the ghee for 5 minutes like rice, then season with salt.
Fry the prawns with garlic and chilli in the remaining ghee for 3 minutes until pink.
Place them on the cauliflower rice and finish with lime, coriander, salt and pepper.

title: Veal loin with a herb crust, fennel and lemon
instructions: Mix the parsley, thyme, almonds, mustard and some of the olive oil into a crust.
Salt the veal loin, sear it for 2 minutes per side, press on the crust and finish at 200 °C for 10 minutes.
Fry the fennel in wedges in the remaining oil for 10 minutes and serve with lemon, salt and pepper beside the meat.

title: Kohlrabi sticks with a blue-cheese dip
instructions: Peel the kohlrabi and cut it into sticks.
Mash the blue cheese with yoghurt, lemon juice, chives, salt and pepper into a dip.
Arrange the sticks around the dip bowl.

title: Burrata with roasted peppers, olive and basil oil
instructions: Cut the roasted peppers into strips and place the olives beside them.
Place the burrata in the centre.
Stir the olive oil with chopped basil, drizzle it over and serve with salt and pepper.

title: Salmon spinach rolls with cream cheese and sesame
instructions: Beat the egg with the blanched, squeezed spinach, salt and pepper and cook in a little olive oil as a thin 1-egg omelette, 2 minutes per side.
Spread the cream cheese mixed with dill on the omelette, lay smoked salmon and cucumber strips on top and roll it up tightly.
Cut into 4 pieces and scatter sesame seeds over them.

title: Cauliflower steaks with tahini, cumin and herb quark
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into 2 thick slices and brush them with olive oil, cumin, salt and pepper.
Bake at 220 °C for 20 minutes until the edges are brown.
Stir the tahini with lemon juice, mix the quark with the parsley and mint, and serve both with sesame and roasted red pepper beside the steaks.

title: Herb frittata with zucchini, goat's cheese and rocket
instructions: Fry the zucchini slices in the olive oil for 4 minutes.
Beat the eggs and egg white with chives, parsley, salt and pepper, pour over the zucchini, scatter the goat's cheese and cook covered over medium heat for 6 minutes until set.
Top with rocket and cut into quarters.

title: Minced beef avocado boats with cheddar and lime
instructions: Fry the minced beef with cumin, chilli, salt and pepper for 8 minutes until crumbly.
Halve the avocado, scoop out a little flesh, dice it and fold it into the mince with lime, tomato and coriander.
Fill the avocado halves with the mixture and top with cheddar.

title: Monkfish with herb butter and sauteed pak choi
instructions: Salt the monkfish fillet and fry it in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side, then keep warm.
Halve the pak choi lengthways and fry it with garlic in the same pan for 4 minutes.
Place the herb butter on the fish and finish with lemon juice, salt and pepper.

title: Tempeh bowl with quinoa, edamame, red cabbage and tahini
instructions: Cook the quinoa in salted water for 12 minutes, drain and let the steam escape briefly.
Dice the tempeh and fry it in the olive oil for 6 minutes until golden, then cook the edamame with it for 3 minutes.
Shred the red cabbage finely, mix the tahini with lime, salt and pepper and serve everything in a bowl.

title: Smoked tofu with lentils, broccoli and peanut-lime sauce
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 20 minutes, cut the broccoli into florets and steam for 6 minutes.
Slice the smoked tofu and fry in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side until browned.
Stir the peanut butter with lime, soy sauce and grated ginger into a sauce, plate everything and season with salt and pepper.

title: Seitan steak bowl with sweet potato, cavolo nero and mustard dressing
instructions: Dice the sweet potato and roast with half of the olive oil, salt and pepper at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Press the seitan flat into one steak, rub with garlic and fry for 4 minutes per side.
Wilt the cavolo nero in the remaining oil for 4 minutes, stir in the mustard and serve with the seitan and the sweet potato.

title: Lupin bowl with cucumber, tomato, rocket, sesame and lemon dressing
instructions: Drain the lupins, dice the cucumber and tomatoes and cut the pepper into strips.
Put the rocket and parsley in a bowl and scatter the lupins, cucumber, tomato and pepper on top.
Whisk the olive oil with lemon juice, salt and pepper, pour over and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

title: Edamame spaghetti with tempeh, cherry tomatoes and basil
instructions: Cook the edamame spaghetti in salted water for 6 minutes until al dente and drain.
Dice the tempeh and fry it with the garlic in the olive oil for 5 minutes until crisp.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, fry them for 3 minutes, fold in basil, salt and pepper and serve with the pasta.

title: Tofu tikka bowl with cauliflower, chickpeas and mint soy yoghurt
instructions: Cut the tofu and cauliflower into pieces and roast with olive oil, cumin, turmeric, paprika, salt and pepper at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Drain the chickpeas and add them to the tray for 8 minutes until they take on a little colour.
Stir the soy yoghurt with mint and lemon juice and finish the bowl with it.

title: Black bean tofu bowl with sweetcorn, avocado and coriander
instructions: Dice the tofu and fry it in the olive oil for 6 minutes until golden, then season with salt and pepper.
Drain the black beans and the sweetcorn and heat them in the pan for 3 minutes.
Cut the avocado into wedges and serve everything in a bowl with lime and coriander.

title: Soy mince bolognese with lentils and wholemeal pasta
instructions: Cook the wholemeal pasta in salted water for 10 minutes until al dente and cook the lentils until tender for 18 minutes.
Dice the onion, sweat it in the olive oil for 4 minutes and roast the soy mince with it for 5 minutes.
Simmer the passata, oregano and basil for 8 minutes, fold in the lentils, season with salt and pepper and serve with the pasta.

title: Natto bowl with brown rice, avocado, spring onion and nori
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes and leave it to cool slightly.
Loosen the natto with the soy sauce, cut the avocado into wedges and slice the spring onions into rings.
Put the rice in a bowl, top with natto, avocado, nori and sesame and season with salt and pepper.

title: Tofu satay bowl with cucumber salad, red cabbage and peanut sauce
instructions: Cut the tofu into 8 cubes and fry in the olive oil for 6 minutes until crisp, then season with salt and pepper.
Slice the cucumber and shred the red cabbage into fine strips.
Stir the peanut butter with soy sauce and lime into a satay sauce and finish the bowl with it.

title: Tempeh Reuben bowl with sauerkraut, rye bread cubes and mustard dressing
instructions: Slice the tempeh and fry it in the olive oil for 5 minutes until brown, then season with salt and pepper.
Cut the rye bread into 2 cm cubes and toast them in the remaining fat for 4 minutes.
Warm the sauerkraut and the gherkin, mix the mustard with caraway and dill and serve everything in a bowl.

title: Vegan mapo tofu with brown rice and pak choi
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Dice the tofu and fry the soy mince and doubanjiang with the ginger in the sesame oil for 5 minutes.
Braise the tofu in the sauce for 6 minutes, cook the pak choi and spring onions with it for 3 minutes, season with salt and pepper and serve with the rice.

title: Chickpea tofu stew with spinach and wholemeal couscous
instructions: Dice the tofu and fry it in the olive oil for 5 minutes, then toast the cumin and paprika with it for 1 minute.
Simmer the chickpeas and passata for 10 minutes, wilt the spinach for 2 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Leave the wholemeal couscous to swell in boiling water for 5 minutes and serve with the stew.

title: Sliced seitan with pepper, mushrooms, courgette and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Cut the seitan into strips and fry with the pepper, mushrooms, courgette and garlic in the olive oil for 8 minutes.
Fold in the thyme, salt and pepper and serve with the rice.

title: Adzuki bowl with barley, roasted broccoli and miso tahini
instructions: Cook the barley until tender for 25 minutes and heat the adzuki beans.
Roast the broccoli with olive oil at 200 °C for 15 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Stir the tahini with the miso, serve everything in a bowl and sprinkle with hemp seeds.

title: Tofu katsu with slaw, sesame and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Cut the tofu into 4 slices, coat in cornflour, soy milk and panko and fry in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side until crisp, then season with salt and pepper.
Shred the white cabbage finely, mix with rice vinegar and sesame and serve with the tofu and the rice.

title: Lentil walnut mince bowl with cauliflower rice and parsley sauce
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 20 minutes, chop the walnuts finely and fry them together in the olive oil for 5 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Grate the cauliflower finely and cook it in a pan for 6 minutes until it resembles cauliflower rice.
Stir the parsley, nutritional yeast flakes and lemon juice into a sauce and finish the bowl with it.

title: Soy skyr bowl with berries, hemp seeds and buckwheat granola
instructions: Toast the buckwheat and pumpkin seeds in a dry pan for 5 minutes until they smell nutty.
Stir in the maple syrup, toast for 3 minutes more and leave the granola to cool.
Spoon the soy skyr into a bowl, add the raspberries and hemp seeds and scatter the granola on top.

title: Protein tofu scramble with black beans, spinach, mushrooms and salsa
instructions: Mash the tofu with a fork, season with turmeric, cumin, salt and pepper and fry in the olive oil for 5 minutes.
Fry the mushrooms and onion with it for 4 minutes and wilt the spinach for 2 minutes.
Heat the black beans and the diced tomatoes for 2 minutes and serve with lime and coriander.

title: Soy yoghurt porridge with pea protein, raspberries and flaxseed
instructions: Cook the oats with a little water for 6 minutes until you have a thick porridge.
Stir in the pea protein and the soy yoghurt until the mixture is creamy.
Top with the raspberries and the ground flaxseed and serve at once.

title: Tempeh tacos with red cabbage, lime and black beans in corn tortillas
instructions: Crumble the tempeh and fry it in the olive oil for 6 minutes until brown, then season with salt and pepper.
Heat the black beans for 3 minutes, shred the red cabbage finely and warm the 2 corn tortillas briefly.
Fill the tortillas with tempeh, beans and red cabbage and finish with lime and coriander.

title: Baked tofu with farro, broccoli and lemon tahini
instructions: Cook the farro until just tender for 25 minutes.
Roast the tofu and broccoli with half of the olive oil at 200 °C for 20 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Stir the tahini with lemon juice and the remaining oil and finish the bowl with it.

title: Beluga lentil bowl with smoked tofu, beetroot and horseradish dressing
instructions: Cook the beluga lentils until just tender for 20 minutes.
Slice the smoked tofu and fry it in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side, then season with salt and pepper.
Slice the beetroot thinly, mix the horseradish with a little oil and serve in a bowl with the rocket.

title: Chickpea pasta with tomato sauce, olives and crisp tempeh
instructions: Cook the chickpea pasta for 8 minutes until al dente and drain.
Dice the tempeh and fry it in the olive oil for 6 minutes until crisp, then season with salt and pepper.
Simmer the passata with oregano, basil and the olives for 6 minutes and toss the pasta and tempeh in the sauce.

title: Moong dal khichdi with tofu, spinach and coriander
instructions: Cook the moong dal and the brown rice together for 20 minutes into a soft khichdi, stirring in the turmeric and cumin.
Dice the tofu and fry it in the olive oil for 5 minutes until golden, then season with salt and pepper.
Wilt the spinach for 2 minutes and serve the khichdi with the tofu and coriander.

title: Seitan doner bowl with red cabbage, tomato, cucumber and tahini
instructions: Cut the seitan into thin strips, season with oregano, parsley, salt and pepper and fry in the olive oil for 6 minutes.
Chop the red cabbage, tomatoes and cucumber.
Loosen the tahini with lemon juice and finish the bowl with it.

title: Tofu poke with edamame, avocado, cucumber and nori
instructions: Dice the tofu and marinate it with soy sauce, rice vinegar, salt and pepper for 10 minutes.
Blanch the edamame for 3 minutes, slice the cucumber into half-moons and the avocado into wedges, and cut the spring onions into rings.
Arrange everything in a bowl and sprinkle with nori and sesame seeds.

title: Chilli sin carne with tempeh, kidney beans and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Crumble the tempeh and fry it with the pepper, chilli and cumin in the olive oil for 6 minutes.
Simmer the kidney beans and passata for 15 minutes, season with salt and pepper and serve with the rice.

title: Lupin schnitzel with herb potato salad and cucumber
instructions: Cook the potatoes for 15 minutes, slice them and mix with mustard, herbs, half of the oil, salt and pepper into a potato salad, then slice the cucumber.
Shape the lupins and lupin meal into 2 flat schnitzels and coat them in panko.
Fry the schnitzels in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes per side until crisp and serve with the potato salad and cucumber.

title: Oven tofu with roasted chickpeas, kale and pomegranate
instructions: Dice the tofu, drain the chickpeas and roast both with half of the olive oil at 200 °C for 18 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Wilt the kale with the remaining oil in the oven for 5 minutes.
Serve with the pomegranate seeds and lemon juice.

title: Soy sprout stir-fry with tofu, pak choi and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Dice the tofu and fry it in the olive oil for 5 minutes, then stir-fry the soy sprouts, pak choi and ginger with it for 4 minutes.
Fold in the soy sauce, salt and pepper and serve with the rice.

title: Toor dal with tempeh, spinach and brown basmati
instructions: Cook the toor dal until tender for 25 minutes, cook the basmati for 15 minutes and stir in the turmeric and cumin.
Dice the tempeh and fry it in the olive oil for 5 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Wilt the spinach for 2 minutes and serve the dal with the tempeh, rice and lemon juice.

title: Tofu banh mi bowl with pickled radish, cucumber and sriracha
instructions: Cut the radish and carrot into fine strips and pickle them in the rice vinegar for 10 minutes.
Cut the tofu into batons and fry them in the olive oil for 6 minutes until crisp, then season with salt and pepper.
Slice the cucumber and serve everything in a bowl with sriracha, peanuts and coriander.

title: Edamame hummus with vegetable sticks and roasted tofu
instructions: Cut the tofu into 8 cubes and roast them in the olive oil at 200 °C for 8 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Blend the edamame with tahini and lemon juice into a hummus.
Cut the pepper, cucumber and carrot into sticks and serve with the hummus and the tofu.

title: Quinoa chilli with soy mince, pepper and avocado
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 12 minutes.
Fry the soy mince and pepper with chilli and cumin in the olive oil for 6 minutes.
Simmer the passata for 10 minutes, season with salt and pepper and serve with the quinoa and avocado wedges.

title: Tempeh satay with steamed vegetables and peanut-coconut sauce
instructions: Cut the tempeh into 8 pieces, thread them onto 2 skewers and fry in the olive oil for 6 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Steam the broccoli, pepper and courgette for 6 minutes.
Stir the peanut butter with the coconut milk into a sauce and serve everything with it.

title: White bean rosemary pan with crisp tofu and kale
instructions: Dice the tofu and fry it in the olive oil for 6 minutes until crisp, season with salt and pepper and set aside.
Fry the garlic and rosemary for 1 minute, then stew the white beans and kale with them for 5 minutes.
Return the tofu and serve at once.

title: Savoury oat porridge with smoked tofu, spinach and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Cook the oats with the soy milk for 6 minutes into a savoury porridge and season with salt and pepper.
Dice the smoked tofu and toast it in a pan for 4 minutes, then fold in the spinach for 2 minutes.
Serve the porridge with the tofu, spinach and pumpkin seeds.

title: Lentil moussaka with aubergine and tofu bechamel
instructions: Cook the lentils for 20 minutes, simmer the onion and passata for 8 minutes into a ragout and add oregano, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Cut the aubergine into 6 slices and fry them in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side.
Blend the tofu with soy milk and nutritional yeast into a bechamel, layer the dish with aubergine, lentil ragout and bechamel and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.

title: Seitan stroganoff with mushrooms, mustard and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Cut the seitan into strips, quarter the mushrooms and fry both in the olive oil for 7 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Stir in the mustard and soy yoghurt for 2 minutes and serve with parsley and the rice.

title: Tofu scramble burrito with black beans, salsa and salad
instructions: Mash the tofu, season with turmeric, cumin, salt and pepper and fry in the olive oil for 5 minutes, then fry the onion and pepper with it for 4 minutes.
Heat the black beans and the diced tomatoes for 2 minutes.
Warm 1 wholemeal wrap, fill it with tofu, beans, tomatoes, pepper, salad and lime and roll it up.

title: Buckwheat bowl with tempeh, roasted carrots and tahini
instructions: Cook the buckwheat for 15 minutes.
Dice the tempeh, cut the carrots into batons and roast both with olive oil at 200 °C for 18 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Loosen the tahini and serve it with parsley over the buckwheat.

title: Urad dal with tofu, kale and lemon
instructions: Cook the urad dal until tender for 25 minutes and stir in the turmeric and cumin.
Dice the tofu and fry it in the olive oil for 5 minutes, stew the kale with it for 4 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Serve the dal with the tofu, kale and lemon juice.

title: Roasted chickpeas and lupins with paprika and lemon
instructions: Drain the chickpeas and lupins and toss them with olive oil, paprika, salt and pepper.
Roast them on a tray at 200 °C for 20 minutes until crisp.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve warm as a snack.

title: Jackfruit chilli with black beans, tofu and coriander
instructions: Shred the jackfruit, dice the tofu and fry both with chilli and cumin in the olive oil for 6 minutes.
Simmer the black beans and passata for 12 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Serve with the coriander.

title: Tofu teriyaki with broccoli, edamame, brown rice and sesame
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Dice the tofu and fry it in the olive oil for 6 minutes, then cook the broccoli and edamame with it for 5 minutes.
Reduce the soy sauce, maple syrup and ginger for 2 minutes into a teriyaki sauce and serve everything with it, the sesame, salt and pepper.

title: Tempeh gyros bowl with cabbage, tomato and soy yoghurt tzatziki
instructions: Cut the tempeh into strips, season with oregano, salt and pepper and fry in the olive oil for 6 minutes.
Chop the white cabbage and the tomatoes.
Stir the soy yoghurt with grated cucumber, dill and garlic into a tzatziki and serve the bowl with it.

title: Freekeh bowl with lentil falafel, cucumber and tahini
instructions: Cook the freekeh for 20 minutes.
Shape the cooked lentils with chickpea flour, parsley and cumin into 4 falafel and fry them in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side, then season with salt and pepper.
Slice the cucumber, loosen the tahini and assemble the bowl.

title: Okara patties with quinoa salad and mustard dressing
instructions: Shape the okara, tofu and lupin meal with half of the parsley, salt and pepper into 3 patties and fry them in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Cook the quinoa for 12 minutes and dice the cucumber.
Stir the mustard with the remaining parsley into a dressing and serve everything together.

title: Doenjang stew with tofu, courgette and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Dissolve the doenjang in a little water, dice the tofu and slice the courgette and mushrooms.
Simmer everything gently in the olive oil for 12 minutes, season with salt and pepper and serve with the rice.

title: Cottage cheese bowl with lentils, cucumber, tomato and dill
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 18 minutes and leave them to cool.
Dice the cucumber and the tomatoes.
Stir the cottage cheese with dill, olive oil, salt and pepper and scatter the lentils and vegetables on top.

title: Paneer tikka bowl with quinoa, cauliflower and mint yoghurt
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 12 minutes.
Roast the paneer and cauliflower with olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper at 200 °C for 18 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with mint and lemon juice and finish the bowl with it.

title: Skyr bowl with barley, roasted vegetables and herbs
instructions: Cook the barley until tender for 25 minutes.
Roast the courgette, pepper and tomatoes with olive oil, paprika and pepper at 200 °C for 18 minutes, with no added salt.
Spoon the skyr into a bowl, top with the barley and vegetables and sprinkle with parsley and thyme.

title: Halloumi lentil bowl with rocket, tomato and lemon oil
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 18 minutes.
Cut the halloumi into 4 slices and fry without extra fat for 2 minutes per side until golden, then season with salt and pepper.
Arrange the rocket and tomatoes, whisk the olive oil with lemon juice and pour it over.

title: Ricotta wholemeal pasta with broccoli, lemon and pine nuts
instructions: Cook the wholemeal pasta for 10 minutes until al dente, cook the broccoli with it for 6 minutes and drain.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes.
Fold the ricotta with olive oil, lemon juice, basil, salt and pepper into the pasta and serve with the pine nuts.

title: Cottage cheese protein pancakes with berries and flaxseed
instructions: Stir the cottage cheese, egg, oats and flaxseed into a batter.
Cook 3 pancakes in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side.
Serve with the raspberries at once.

title: Egg and lentil breakfast bowl with spinach, tomato and cumin
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 18 minutes.
Dice the courgette and tomatoes, fry them with 1 g olive oil, cumin and paprika for 6 minutes, wilt the spinach for 2 minutes, with no added salt.
Fry 2 eggs in the same pan for 3 minutes as sunny-side-up eggs and finish the bowl with them.

title: Feta chickpea bowl with cucumber, mint and bulgur
instructions: Leave the bulgur to swell for 10 minutes.
Drain the chickpeas, dice the cucumber and red onion and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Crumble the feta, add olive oil, lemon juice, mint, salt and pepper and toss everything.

title: Egg and bean bowl with a large salad, salsa and sweetcorn
instructions: Boil the egg and the egg white for 8 minutes and halve the whole egg.
Drain the kidney beans and sweetcorn, dice the tomatoes and onion into a salsa.
Put a large salad in a bowl and top with the beans, sweetcorn, salsa, egg, egg white, olive oil, lime, coriander, salt and pepper.

title: Herb quark fritters with lentil salad and cucumber
instructions: Cook the lentils for 18 minutes, leave them to cool and mix with cucumber slices, half of the herbs, salt and pepper into a salad.
Shape the quark, egg, chickpea flour and the remaining herbs into 4 fritters.
Fry the fritters in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side until golden and serve with the salad.

title: Poached eggs on white beans with kale and olive oil
instructions: Heat the white beans with garlic, half of the olive oil, salt and pepper for 6 minutes.
Wilt the kale in the remaining oil for 4 minutes and fold in the parsley and thyme.
Poach 2 eggs for 3 minutes and serve them on the beans, finishing with lemon juice.

title: Cottage cheese wrap with hummus, pepper and lambs lettuce
instructions: Lay out 1 wholemeal wrap flat and spread it with hummus.
Spread the cottage cheese on top and add pepper strips and lamb's lettuce.
Season with salt and pepper, roll it tightly and cut it in half.

title: Mozzarella lentil salad with basil, tomato, rocket, cucumber and olives
instructions: Cook the lentils for 18 minutes and leave them to cool.
Tear the mozzarella into 6 pieces and cut the tomatoes, cucumber and olives.
Toss with rocket, basil, olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper into a salad.

title: Cheese polenta with lentil ragout and vegetarian hard cheese
instructions: Cook the lentils with the passata, rosemary and thyme for 18 minutes into a ragout and season with salt and pepper.
Cook the polenta for 8 minutes, stirring, until it is thick.
Fold the olive oil and the vegetarian hard cheese into the polenta and serve with the lentil ragout.

title: Skyr omelette with herbs, tomato and pumpernickel
instructions: Beat the eggs with the skyr, parsley, chives, salt and pepper.
Fry in the olive oil for 4 minutes into an omelette, adding the diced tomatoes in the last 2 minutes.
Serve with 2 slices of pumpernickel.

title: Barley bowl with egg, roasted courgette, spinach and herb yoghurt
instructions: Cook the barley until tender for 25 minutes.
Roast the courgette and tomatoes with 1 g olive oil and paprika at 200 °C for 15 minutes, wilt the spinach for 2 minutes, with no added salt.
Boil 2 eggs for 8 minutes and halve them, stir the yoghurt with parsley and dill and assemble the bowl.

title: Paneer saag with red lentils and a wholemeal chapati
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, cook the spinach with garlic, turmeric, cumin and ginger for 6 minutes into a saag and season with salt and pepper.
Dice the paneer and fry it in the olive oil for 4 minutes until golden, then fold it into the saag.
Warm 1 wholemeal chapati and serve it alongside.

title: Cottage cheese tomato crostini with basil, rocket, pine nuts and olive oil
instructions: Toast 2 slices of wholemeal toast with half of the olive oil at 200 °C for 5 minutes.
Spread the cottage cheese on the slices, dice the tomatoes and place them on top.
Finish with basil, rocket, pine nuts, the remaining oil, salt and pepper.

title: Tempeh buddha bowl with wild rice, pak choi and miso dressing
instructions: Cook the wild rice for 30 minutes.
Dice the tempeh and fry it in the olive oil for 6 minutes, stew the pak choi with it for 3 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Stir the miso with the tahini and finish the bowl with it.

title: Tofu kimchi bowl with brown rice, cucumber and sesame
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Dice the tofu and fry it in the olive oil for 6 minutes until crisp, then season with salt and pepper.
Slice the cucumber and serve the vegan kimchi and sesame with the rice and tofu.

title: Lupin bolognese with wholemeal spaghetti and nutritional yeast
instructions: Cook the wholemeal pasta for 10 minutes until al dente.
Toast the lupins and lupin meal in the olive oil for 6 minutes, simmer the passata and oregano for 10 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Spoon the sauce over the spaghetti and sprinkle with the nutritional yeast flakes.

title: Tofu breakfast wrap with spinach, salsa and black beans
instructions: Mash the tofu, season with turmeric, salt and pepper and fry in the olive oil for 5 minutes, then wilt the spinach with it for 2 minutes.
Heat the black beans and the diced tomatoes for 2 minutes.
Fill 1 wholemeal wrap with the tofu, spinach, beans, tomatoes, rocket and chives and roll it up.

title: Chickpea spinach curry with tempeh and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Sweat the onion in the olive oil for 4 minutes, toast the vegan curry paste for 1 minute, dice the tempeh and fry it with the paste for 5 minutes.
Simmer the chickpeas, coconut milk and spinach for 8 minutes, season with lemon juice, coriander, salt and pepper and serve with the rice.

title: Seitan pepper goulash with parsley brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes and fold in the parsley.
Dice the seitan and fry the onion and pepper in the olive oil for 8 minutes.
Simmer the passata for 12 minutes into a goulash, season with salt and pepper and serve with the parsley rice.

title: Tofu fajita bowl with pepper, onion and guacamole
instructions: Cut the tofu into strips and fry with the pepper and onion in the olive oil for 8 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Mash the avocado with lime and coriander into a guacamole.
Serve the bowl with the tofu fajita, guacamole and pumpkin seeds.

title: Soy skyr with cucumber, dill, pumpkin seeds and wholegrain crispbread
instructions: Dice the cucumber finely and fold it into the soy skyr with dill, salt and pepper.
Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan for 3 minutes.
Spoon the skyr into a bowl, scatter the seeds on top and serve with 2 slices of wholegrain crispbread.

title: Lentil shepherd pie with tofu and a potato-celeriac crust
instructions: Cook the lentils for 18 minutes, crumble the tofu, simmer the onion and passata with the peas for 8 minutes into a ragout and season with salt and pepper.
Cook the potatoes and celeriac until soft for 15 minutes and mash them with some of the olive oil into a puree.
Put the ragout in a dish, cover with the mash, drizzle with the remaining olive oil and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.

title: Edamame quinoa salad with smoked tofu and ginger dressing
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 12 minutes and blanch the edamame for 3 minutes.
Dice the smoked tofu and fry it in the olive oil for 4 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Slice the radishes, stir the ginger with lemon juice into a dressing and assemble the salad.

title: Tempeh mushroom ragout on herb polenta
instructions: Cook the polenta for 8 minutes, fold in the nutritional yeast, parsley and thyme and season with salt and pepper.
Dice the tempeh and fry the mushrooms and onion in the olive oil for 8 minutes.
Serve the ragout on the polenta.

title: Greek protein bowl with egg, feta, lentils and oregano
instructions: Cook the lentils for 18 minutes, hard-boil 2 eggs for 8 minutes and halve them.
Cut the cucumber, tomatoes and olives and crumble the feta.
Serve everything in a bowl with olive oil, oregano, salt and pepper.

title: Cottage cheese breakfast with pear, cinnamon and walnuts
instructions: Cut the pear into wedges.
Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl and dust with cinnamon, with no added salt.
Arrange the pear wedges and walnuts on top and serve at once.

title: Tofu shakshuka with chickpeas, pepper and herbs
instructions: Dice the pepper and fry it in the olive oil for 5 minutes.
Simmer the passata, chickpeas and cumin for 8 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Nestle the tofu in 6 pieces and let it poach in the sauce for 6 minutes, then serve with parsley.

title: Beluga lentil tacos with avocado, cabbage and lime
instructions: Cook the beluga lentils until just tender for 20 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Warm 2 corn tortillas, cut the avocado into wedges and shred the white cabbage finely.
Fill the tortillas with the lentils, avocado and cabbage and finish with lime, sesame, coriander and olive oil.

title: Ricotta lentil bake with spinach and nutmeg
instructions: Cook the lentils for 18 minutes.
Wilt the spinach in the olive oil for 3 minutes and fold in the ricotta, egg, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Combine with the lentils in a dish and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes.

title: Soy mince lahmacun on a wholemeal flatbread with parsley salad
instructions: Mix the soy mince with the passata, paprika, cumin, onion, half of the parsley, salt and pepper into a topping.
Spread the topping on 1 wholemeal flatbread, drizzle with olive oil and bake at 220 °C for 10 minutes.
Mix the remaining parsley with the tomatoes into a salad and serve it with the lahmacun.

title: Tofu massaman bowl with broccoli, peanut, potato and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes and cook the potatoes for 12 minutes.
Dice the tofu and fry it in the olive oil for 5 minutes, toast the vegan curry paste for 1 minute, then simmer the coconut milk and broccoli for 6 minutes.
Fold in the potatoes and serve with the peanuts, lime, salt and pepper, alongside the rice.

title: Huge salad bowl with egg, chickpeas, cucumber and yoghurt dressing
instructions: Boil 1 egg for 8 minutes and halve it, also cook the extra egg white for 8 minutes until firm and dice it.
Drain the chickpeas and slice the cucumber and radishes.
Put a large salad in a bowl, make a dressing from the yoghurt, olive oil, dill, parsley, salt and pepper and toss everything.

title: Goat cheese lentil salad with beetroot and walnut
instructions: Cook the lentils for 18 minutes and leave them to cool.
Slice the beetroot thinly, about 60 g, roughly chop the walnuts and crumble the goat cheese.
Toss with the lamb's lettuce, olive oil, salt and pepper into a salad.

title: Roasted cauliflower with lentils, tofu and chermoula
instructions: Cook the lentils for 18 minutes.
Cut the cauliflower into florets and the tofu into cubes, roast them with half of the olive oil at 200 °C for 20 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
