Blend the parsley, coriander, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, paprika and the remaining oil into a chermoula and serve everything with it.

title: White bean bowl with egg, rocket, tomato and olive oil
instructions: Hard-boil 2 eggs for 8 minutes and halve them.
Heat the white beans for 5 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Serve in a bowl with the rocket, tomatoes and olive oil.

title: Tempeh sambal bowl with cucumber, edamame and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Dice the tempeh and fry it in the olive oil for 6 minutes, toast the sambal with it for 1 minute and season with salt and pepper.
Blanch the edamame for 3 minutes, slice the cucumber and serve everything with the rice.

title: Quark flax porridge with berries and sunflower seeds
instructions: Cook the oats with a little water for 6 minutes into a porridge.
Stir in the quark and the flaxseed.
Serve with the raspberries and sunflower seeds.

title: Chickpea tagine with tofu, courgette and wholemeal couscous
instructions: Dice the tofu, slice the courgette into half-moons and fry with olive oil, cumin, cinnamon and paprika for 8 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Stew the chickpeas with the mix for 10 minutes and finish with lemon juice.
Leave the wholemeal couscous to swell for 5 minutes and serve it with the tagine.

title: Seitan teriyaki skewers with sesame broccoli and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Cut the seitan into 9 pieces, thread them onto 3 skewers and fry in the sesame oil for 6 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Steam the broccoli for 6 minutes, reduce the soy sauce and maple syrup for 2 minutes into a teriyaki sauce and serve the skewers and broccoli with it, the sesame and the spring onions.

title: Egg and vegetable bowl with barley, peas and herbs
instructions: Cook the barley until tender for 25 minutes.
Stew the peas, courgette and pepper with 3 g olive oil for 6 minutes, fold in the parsley and chives, with no added salt, only pepper and paprika.
Boil 2 eggs for 8 minutes, halve them and finish the bowl with them.

title: Tofu skewers with peanut dip and raw vegetables
instructions: Cut the tofu into 9 cubes, thread them onto 3 skewers and fry in the olive oil for 6 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Stir the peanut butter with lime into a dip.
Cut the carrot, cucumber and pepper into sticks and serve with the skewers and the dip.

title: Miso aubergine with tofu, buckwheat and spring onion
instructions: Cook the buckwheat for 15 minutes.
Cut the aubergine into 6 wedges and the tofu into cubes, fry both in the olive oil for 8 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Brush the miso over the aubergine, caramelise for 3 minutes and serve with the buckwheat, spring onions and sesame.

title: Cottage cheese pesto bowl with wholemeal pasta and peas
instructions: Cook the wholemeal pasta for 10 minutes until al dente, cook the peas with it for the last 3 minutes and drain.
Fold the cottage cheese and the vegetarian basil pesto into the hot pasta and season with salt and pepper.
Serve at once in a bowl.

title: Lupin burger in a wholemeal bun with slaw and tomato
instructions: Shape the lupins and lupin meal with salt and pepper into 1 flat burger.
Fry in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Split 1 wholemeal bun and fill it with mustard, the burger, white cabbage and tomatoes.

title: Tofu jollof bowl with black-eyed peas and kale
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice with the passata, pepper, thyme, chilli and paprika for 18 minutes into a jollof and season with salt and pepper.
Dice the tofu and fry it in the olive oil for 6 minutes, then heat the black-eyed peas for 4 minutes.
Stew the kale for 3 minutes and serve everything in a bowl.

title: Oven halibut with leek, lemon and spelt
instructions: Cook the spelt in salted water for 25 minutes, slice the leek into rings and cut the carrot into thin slices.
Bake the halibut fillet, leek and carrot with olive oil, thyme, salt, pepper and lemon slices at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Spoon the cooked spelt onto the plate and serve the oven halibut with the leek, carrot and lemon on top.

title: Redfish on lentils with roasted pepper and parsley
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 20 minutes and dice the onion and the garlic.
Cut the pepper into strips and roast with olive oil, salt and pepper at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Pan-fry the redfish fillet for 4 minutes per side and serve it on the lentils with the pepper, parsley and lemon juice.

title: Arctic char in a foil parcel with herbs, courgette and new potatoes
instructions: Halve the potatoes and parboil them for 10 minutes, slice the courgette and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Place the arctic char fillet with the potatoes, courgette, cherry tomatoes, olive oil, parsley, dill, thyme, salt, pepper and lemon in foil.
Bake the parcel at 200 °C for 18 minutes and serve it in the foil or on the plate.

title: Plaice a la meuniere with cucumber salad and parsley potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes, drain them and toss them with the parsley.
Slice the cucumber and dress it with dill, apple cider vinegar, red onion, salt and pepper to make the salad.
Dust the plaice fillet in the wheat flour and fry it in the butter for 3 minutes per side until golden, then serve with the cucumber salad and the parsley potatoes.

title: Monkfish medallions with saffron fennel and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Cut the fennel into wedges, halve the cherry tomatoes and stew both with olive oil, saffron, salt and pepper for 12 minutes, then deglaze with lemon.
Cut the monkfish fillet into 2 medallions, fry for 3 minutes per side and serve with the fennel, cherry tomatoes, parsley and the rice.

title: Scallops with cauliflower puree, capers and lemon
instructions: Steam the cauliflower until soft for 12 minutes and blend it with part of the olive oil, salt and pepper into a puree.
Sear the 4 scallops in the remaining olive oil for 2 minutes per side.
Spoon the puree onto the plate and top with the scallops, capers, chives, radishes and lemon juice.

title: Crab omelette with chives, cucumber salad and wholemeal toast
instructions: Slice the cucumber and the radishes and mix them with dill, apple cider vinegar, salt and pepper into a salad.
Beat the 2 eggs, fold in the crab meat and the chives, cook in the olive oil for 4 minutes as an omelette and season with salt and pepper.
Toast the 2 slices of wholemeal toast and serve them with the omelette and the cucumber salad.

title: Herring pieces with apple onion salad and boiled potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 20 minutes, peel them and halve them.
Dice the apple and the cucumber, slice the onion into fine rings, mix with dill, mustard, lemon juice, salt and pepper into a salad and fold in the capers and the lamb lettuce.
Cut the herring into pieces and serve with the boiled potatoes, the apple onion salad, the capers and the lamb lettuce.

title: Matjes bowl with beetroot, apple, dill and wholemeal bread
instructions: Dice the beetroot and slice the apple and the cucumber.
Stir the yoghurt with the horseradish, dill, salt and pepper.
Slice the matjes fillet into strips and serve in a bowl with the beetroot, apple, cucumber, lamb lettuce, horseradish yoghurt and the wholemeal bread.

title: Pike-perch fillet on pea puree with mint and lemon
instructions: Dice the shallot, cook the peas with the shallot until soft for 8 minutes and blend with mint, a little olive oil, salt and pepper.
Fry the pike-perch fillet in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes per side and season with salt, pepper and lemon.
Spoon the pea puree onto the plate and serve the pike-perch, rocket and lemon on top.

title: Rainbow trout en papillote with pak choi, ginger and rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Place the rainbow trout fillet with the pak choi, ginger, spring onions, sesame oil, lime, salt and pepper in a paper or foil parcel.
Bake the parcel at 200 °C for 16 minutes and serve it with the brown rice.

title: Wild salmon with a horseradish crust, celery and quinoa
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes.
Mix the horseradish with the low-fat quark and the breadcrumbs into a crust and spread it on the wild salmon fillet.
Cut the celery and the carrot into pieces and bake them with olive oil, salt and pepper beside the salmon at 200 °C for 15 minutes, then serve with parsley and the quinoa.

title: Tuna ceviche with lime, mango, red onion and sweetcorn
instructions: Cut the tuna into 2 cm cubes and marinate them with lime juice, chili, salt and pepper for 10 minutes.
Dice the mango and the cucumber, slice the red onion into fine rings and drain the sweetcorn.
Serve the tuna in a bowl with the mango, cucumber, red onion, sweetcorn and coriander.

title: Cod fish cakes with pea mint puree and salad
instructions: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, mash them and shape them with the chopped cod fillet, the egg, mustard, salt and pepper into 2 fish cakes.
Cook the peas for 8 minutes and blend them with mint, a little olive oil, salt and pepper, then plate the lettuce and the radishes.
Fry the fish cakes in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes per side and serve with the pea puree, salad, radishes and lemon.

title: Hake in tomato olive sauce with wholemeal orzo
instructions: Cook the wholemeal orzo until al dente for 10 minutes and dice the courgette.
Sweat the garlic in the olive oil for 1 minute, simmer the courgette, passata, olives, oregano and thyme for 8 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Cook the hake fillet in the sauce for 6 minutes and serve it with parsley and the orzo.

title: Mackerel fillet with rhubarb salsa and buckwheat
instructions: Cook the buckwheat for 15 minutes.
Cut the rhubarb into pieces, finely chop the red onion and warm them with honey, lemon juice, dill, salt and pepper for 5 minutes into a salsa.
Fry the mackerel fillet in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side and serve with the rhubarb salsa, lamb lettuce and buckwheat.

title: Sardine pasta with fennel, raisins and pine nuts
instructions: Cook the wholemeal pasta until al dente for 10 minutes and slice the fennel thinly.
Sweat the garlic and the fennel in the olive oil for 5 minutes, toast the pine nuts with them for 2 minutes, then fold in the raisins, sardines, capers, lemon juice, salt and pepper for 3 minutes.
Toss the pasta with the sardine fennel sauce and serve with parsley.

title: Anchovy crostini with roasted pepper and rocket
instructions: Roast the pepper in the oven at 220 °C for 15 minutes, peel it and cut it into strips, then drain the chickpeas.
Cut the wholemeal bread into 4 slices and toast them with garlic and olive oil for 5 minutes.
Top the crostini with the anchovies, pepper, chickpeas, rocket, capers, lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve.

title: Trout roe on cucumber slices with dill quark and chives
instructions: Stir the low-fat quark with the dill, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Cut the cucumber into 8 thick slices and spread them with the dill quark.
Spoon the trout roe and the chives onto the cucumber slices and serve at once.

title: Squid pan with peas, tomato and herb rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes and mix it with the parsley and the dill.
Cut the squid into rings, dice the pepper and the courgette and quarter the mushrooms.
Fry the squid, pepper, courgette, mushrooms, peas, tomatoes and garlic in the olive oil for 6 minutes, season with salt, pepper and lemon and serve with the herb rice.

title: Grilled octopus with a bean celery salad and olive oil
instructions: Cook the octopus until tender for 30 minutes, cut it into pieces and grill it with part of the olive oil, salt and pepper for 4 minutes.
Slice the celery, cut the red onion into rings and drain the white beans.
Mix the beans, celery, onion, capers, lamb lettuce, parsley, lemon juice and the remaining olive oil into a salad and top with the grilled octopus.

title: Mussels in a white wine herb broth with wholemeal bread
instructions: Cut the onion, leek and fennel into strips, finely chop the garlic and sweat them in the olive oil for 4 minutes.
Add the mussels and the alcohol-free white wine, steam for 8 minutes until the shells open, then season with parsley, thyme, salt, pepper and lemon.
Serve with the wholemeal bread at the side of the bowl.

title: Prawn curry with spinach, tomato and basmati
instructions: Cook the basmati rice for 15 minutes.
Sweat the garlic and the ginger in the olive oil for 1 minute, toast the turmeric, cumin and chili with them for 30 seconds, then simmer the tomatoes and the light coconut milk for 8 minutes.
Cook the prawns and the spinach in the sauce for 5 minutes, season with salt, pepper and coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Shakshuka with prawns, cumin and wholemeal pita
instructions: Dice the onion and the pepper, sweat them in the olive oil for 4 minutes and toast the cumin and paprika with them for 30 seconds.
Simmer the passata for 8 minutes, cook the prawns in it for 4 minutes, crack 1 egg into a well and let it set for 4 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve with coriander and the wholemeal pita.

title: Sea bass on ratatouille with olive oil and thyme
instructions: Dice the courgette, aubergine and pepper and quarter the tomatoes.
Stew the vegetables with garlic, olives, thyme, part of the olive oil, salt and pepper in the oven at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Fry the sea bass fillet in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes per side and serve it on the ratatouille.

title: Salt-crust sea bream with fennel salad and lemon
ingredients: Sea salt for the crust (not eaten)
instructions: Cover the whole sea bream thickly with the sea salt for the crust (the salt is not eaten later), bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes, crack the crust and lift out the firm white fillet.
Slice the fennel thinly and segment the orange.
Dress the fennel salad with orange, olives, dill, olive oil, salt and pepper and serve it with the sea bream and lemon wedges.

title: Salmon tacos with cabbage, lime and coriander in corn tortillas
instructions: Dice the salmon fillet and fry it in the olive oil with chili, salt and pepper for 5 minutes.
Shred the white cabbage into fine strips, cut the avocado into wedges and the red onion into rings, then mix with lime and coriander.
Warm the 2 corn tortillas and fill them with the salmon, cabbage, avocado, onion, lime and coriander.

title: Pollock fish curry with coconut, cauliflower and rice
instructions: Cook the basmati rice for 15 minutes.
Sweat the ginger in the olive oil for 1 minute, toast the turmeric, cumin and chili, then simmer the cauliflower, peas and light coconut milk for 10 minutes.
Cook pieces of the pollock fillet in the sauce for 6 minutes, season with lime, coriander, salt and pepper and serve with the rice.

title: Haddock with mustard sauce, leaf spinach and boiled potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard, lemon juice, chives, salt and pepper into a mustard sauce.
Fry the haddock fillet in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side, wilt the leaf spinach for 2 minutes and serve with the mustard sauce and the boiled potatoes.

title: Smoked mackerel on a warm potato leek salad
instructions: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes, slice them, cut the leek into rings and stew the leek for 4 minutes.
Stir the mustard, apple cider vinegar, olive oil, dill, salt and pepper into a dressing and mix with the potatoes, leek, cucumber and radishes into a warm salad.
Break the smoked mackerel into pieces and serve it on the warm potato leek salad.

title: Smorrebrod with matjes, apple, dill and pumpernickel
instructions: Stir the yoghurt with the horseradish, mustard, dill, salt and pepper.
Slice the apple and the cucumber and cut the red onion into fine rings.
Spread the 2 slices of pumpernickel with the horseradish yoghurt and top with the matjes fillet, apple, cucumber, red onion, dill and chives.

title: Bouillabaisse bowl with rouille yoghurt and wholemeal croutons
instructions: Cut the wholemeal bread into cubes and toast them in the olive oil for 5 minutes into croutons, then finely chop the garlic.

Dice the fennel and the tomatoes, simmer them with part of the garlic, saffron and chili for 10 minutes, cook the pollock fillet, hake fillet and mussels in the broth for 8 minutes and season with salt, pepper and parsley.
Stir the yoghurt with the remaining garlic, a little chili and saffron into a rouille and finish the bowl with the croutons and the rouille yoghurt.

title: Light cioppino with cod, mussels, tomato and fennel
instructions: Cut the fennel and the celery into strips, finely chop the garlic and sweat them in the olive oil for 4 minutes.
Simmer the tomatoes, alcohol-free white wine and chili for 8 minutes, then cook the cod fillet and the mussels in the broth for 8 minutes.
Season with parsley, salt and pepper and serve in a bowl.

title: Tom yum with prawns, mushrooms and rice noodles
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water for 5 minutes and simmer the vegetable broth with lemongrass, ginger and chili for 8 minutes.
Cook the prawns, mushrooms, pak choi and cherry tomatoes in the broth for 5 minutes, then stir in the fish sauce and the lime.
Put the noodles in the bowl, pour the soup over them and finish with coriander, Thai basil, spring onions, salt and pepper.

title: Light moqueca with pollock, pepper, coriander and rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Cut the onion and the pepper into strips, finely chop the garlic, sweat them in the olive oil for 4 minutes, then simmer the tomatoes and the light coconut milk for 6 minutes.
Cook the pollock fillet in the sauce for 6 minutes, season with lime, coriander, salt and pepper and serve with the rice.

title: Fish tacos al pastor style with pineapple salsa and red cabbage
instructions: Dice the pollock fillet and fry it with chili, cumin, paprika, olive oil, salt and pepper for 6 minutes.
Dice the pineapple, shred the red cabbage, slice the red onion and the radishes and mix them with lime and coriander into a salsa.
Warm the 2 corn tortillas and fill them with the pollock, pineapple salsa, red cabbage, onion, radishes, lime and coriander.

title: Cod brandade cakes on lamb lettuce with lemon
instructions: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, mash them and shape them with the chopped cod fillet, garlic, yoghurt, part of the olive oil, salt and pepper into 3 flat cakes.
Fry the cakes in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes per side until golden.
Dress the lamb lettuce with radishes, capers, chives, lemon, salt and pepper and serve the brandade cakes on top.

title: Tilapia with mango salsa, black beans and lime
instructions: Dice the mango and the pepper, finely chop the red onion and mix them with lime, coriander, chili, salt and pepper into a salsa.
Drain the black beans and warm them for 3 minutes.
Fry the tilapia in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side and serve with the mango salsa, beans and lime.

title: Blue trout with melted butter, potatoes and dill
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes.
Bring the vinegar to a boil with water, salt and pepper, then poach the cleaned trout in it for 12 minutes until it takes on a bluish sheen.
Melt the butter, slice the cucumber and the radishes and serve the trout with the butter, dill, potatoes, cucumber and radishes.

title: Crustless salmon quiche with leek, dill and quark
instructions: Cut the leek into rings and stew it in the olive oil for 5 minutes, halve the cherry tomatoes and dice the salmon fillet.
Beat the 2 eggs with the low-fat quark, dill, salt and pepper and fold in the leek, salmon and cherry tomatoes.
Bake the mixture without a pastry base at 180 °C for 25 minutes and serve it in wedges.

title: Tuna steak with ginger cucumbers and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Slice the cucumber and the radishes and marinate them with ginger, rice vinegar, soy sauce, spring onions, sesame, a little sesame oil, salt and pepper.
Sear the tuna steak in the remaining sesame oil for 2 minutes per side so the centre stays pink, then serve with the cucumbers and the rice.

title: Prawn skewers with pepper, courgette and lemon couscous
instructions: Leave the wholemeal couscous to swell in hot water with lemon juice and part of the parsley for 5 minutes.
Thread 8 prawns with pepper and courgette pieces, garlic, olive oil, salt and pepper onto skewers and set the cherry tomatoes aside.
Grill the skewers for 6 minutes, roast the cherry tomatoes with them for 3 minutes and serve with the couscous and the remaining parsley.

title: Wholemeal linguine alle vongole with parsley and chili
instructions: Cook the wholemeal linguine until al dente for 10 minutes and halve the cherry tomatoes.

Sweat the garlic and the chili in the olive oil for 1 minute, steam the clams and the alcohol-free white wine for 6 minutes until the shells open, then cook the cherry tomatoes and capers with them for 2 minutes.
Toss the pasta in the pan with parsley, lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve with rocket.

title: Halibut ceviche with grapefruit, avocado and coriander
instructions: Cut the halibut fillet into 2 cm cubes and marinate them with lime juice, chili, salt and pepper for 10 minutes.
Segment the grapefruit, cut the avocado into wedges, dice the cucumber and slice the red onion into rings.
Serve the halibut in a bowl with the grapefruit, avocado, cucumber, red onion and coriander.

title: Pike-perch dumplings in dill sauce with cucumber salad
instructions: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes, mash them and shape them with the chopped pike-perch fillet, the egg, shallot, a little dill, salt and pepper into 8 small dumplings.
Slice the cucumber and dress it with part of the yoghurt, mustard, lemon juice, salt and pepper into a salad.
Fry the dumplings in the olive oil for 8 minutes until golden, spoon over the remaining dill yoghurt sauce and serve with the cucumber salad.

title: Oven mackerel with mustard honey, carrots and barley
instructions: Cook the barley for 25 minutes, cut the carrots into batons and the leek into rings.
Stir the mustard with the honey and brush it onto the mackerel fillet.
Bake the mackerel, carrots and leek with olive oil, salt, pepper and lemon at 200 °C for 15 minutes and serve with dill and the barley.

title: Crab rice bowl with avocado, cucumber and nori
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes, loosen it with the rice vinegar and leave it to cool slightly.
Cut the avocado into wedges, slice the cucumber and the radishes, cut the spring onions into rings and tear the nori into strips.
Put the rice in a bowl and top with the crab meat, avocado, cucumber, radishes, nori, sesame, soy sauce, salt and pepper.

title: Squid salad with chickpeas, lemon and parsley
instructions: Cut the squid into rings and fry them in the olive oil for 4 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Drain the chickpeas, dice the cucumber, the pepper and the cherry tomatoes, slice the red onion into rings and add the olives.
Toss everything with the lemon juice and the parsley into a salad and serve.

title: Salmon cabbage parcel with ginger, sesame and rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes and blanch the white cabbage leaves for 3 minutes.
Season the salmon fillet with ginger, sesame oil, soy sauce, salt and pepper and wrap it in 2 cabbage leaves.
Bake the parcels at 190 °C for 15 minutes and serve with the rice, sesame and spring onions.

title: Hake piccata with capers, lemon and green beans
instructions: Cook the green beans until crisp-tender for 8 minutes and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Dust the hake fillet in the wheat flour and fry it in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side, then season with salt and pepper.
Add the capers, lemon and parsley to the pan and serve with the beans and the cherry tomatoes.

title: Sardine bowl with white beans, fennel and orange
instructions: Slice the fennel thinly, segment the orange, cut the red onion into rings and drain the white beans.
Drain the sardines and break them into large pieces.
Serve the beans, fennel, orange, onion, rocket, sardines, olive oil, parsley, salt and pepper in a bowl.

title: Scallops on beluga lentils with leek and thyme
instructions: Cook the beluga lentils for 20 minutes, cut the leek into rings and dice the carrot small.
Stew the leek and the carrot with thyme, part of the olive oil, salt and pepper for 6 minutes, fold them into the lentils and season with lemon juice and parsley.
Sear the 4 scallops in the remaining olive oil for 2 minutes per side and serve them on the lentils.

title: Herring pot with sour cream, apple, cucumber and boiled potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 20 minutes, peel them and halve them.
Dice the herring, apple and cucumber, finely chop the onion and slice the radishes.
Stir the sour cream with the mustard, horseradish, dill, salt and pepper, mix everything into a herring pot and serve with the boiled potatoes.

title: Prawn wok with sugar snaps, broccoli and rice noodles
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water for 5 minutes, cut the broccoli into florets and the pepper into strips.
Stir-fry the prawns, sugar snap peas, broccoli, pepper, ginger and garlic in the sesame oil for 5 minutes.
Fold in the noodles and the soy sauce for 2 minutes and serve with spring onions, salt and pepper.

title: Salmon poke with watermelon, cucumber, sesame and rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes and leave it to cool.
Cut the salmon into 2 cm cubes, dice the watermelon, cucumber and radishes, slice the spring onions into rings and cut the nori into strips.
Put the rice in a bowl and top with the salmon, watermelon, cucumber, radishes, sesame, nori, soy sauce, lime, salt and pepper.

title: Cod with chermoula, chickpeas and roasted carrot
instructions: Blend the coriander, parsley, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper into a chermoula.
Cut the carrots and the courgette into batons, drain the chickpeas and roast them with part of the chermoula at 200 °C for 20 minutes, then slice the red onion into rings.
Bake the cod fillet with the remaining chermoula in the oven for 12 minutes and serve with the chickpeas, carrots, courgette and red onion.

title: Redfish papillote with tomato, olive and wholemeal couscous
instructions: Leave the wholemeal couscous to swell in hot water for 5 minutes and dice the tomatoes and the courgette.
Place the redfish fillet with the tomatoes, olives, courgette, thyme, olive oil, lemon, salt and pepper in a parcel.
Bake the parcel at 200 °C for 16 minutes and serve it with the couscous.

title: Tuna rillettes on wholemeal crispbread with cucumber
instructions: Mash the tuna with the low-fat quark, olive oil, lemon juice, capers, chives, salt and pepper into rillettes.
Slice the cucumber.
Spread the 4 slices of wholemeal crispbread with the rillettes and serve with cucumber and chives.

title: Sardine crostini with tomato, lemon and parsley
instructions: Cut the wholemeal bread into 2 slices and toast them with garlic and olive oil for 5 minutes.
Slice the tomatoes and drain the sardines.
Top the crostini with tomato, sardines, lemon, parsley, rocket, salt and pepper.

title: Sea bream with potato artichoke vegetables and rosemary
instructions: Quarter the potatoes, halve the artichoke hearts and leave the cherry tomatoes whole.
Roast the vegetables with garlic, rosemary, olives, capers, part of the olive oil, salt and pepper at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Fry the sea bream in the remaining olive oil for 6 minutes per side or finish it in the oven for 15 minutes, then serve with lemon and the vegetables.

title: Rainbow trout with horseradish apple salad and spelt
instructions: Cook the spelt for 25 minutes.
Cut the apple into wedges, stir the yoghurt with the horseradish, dill, salt and pepper and toss with the apple and the lamb lettuce into a salad.
Fry the rainbow trout fillet in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side and serve with the horseradish apple salad and the spelt.

title: Pollock bake with leek, potato and light cheese
instructions: Slice the potatoes, cut the leek into rings and parboil both for 8 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard, dill, salt and pepper and cut the pollock fillet into pieces.
Layer the potatoes, leek and pollock, top with the yoghurt and the light cheese and bake at 190 °C for 20 minutes.

title: Prawn okra pan with tomato, coriander and rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Sweat the onion and the garlic in the olive oil for 3 minutes, stew the okra and the tomatoes for 8 minutes and toast the cumin and paprika with them.
Cook the prawns with the vegetables for 5 minutes, season with lime, coriander, salt and pepper and serve with the rice.

title: Sea bass with olive orange sauce and fennel vegetables
instructions: Halve the potatoes, cut the fennel into wedges and roast both with thyme, part of the olive oil, salt and pepper at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Juice the orange and prepare a few segments, chop the olives and the capers and stir them with the remaining olive oil into a sauce.
Fry the sea bass fillet for 4 minutes per side and serve with the olive orange sauce, fennel, potatoes and parsley.

title: Mussel curry with tomato, coriander and wholemeal bread
instructions: Sweat the onion, ginger and garlic in the olive oil for 3 minutes and toast the turmeric, cumin and chili with them.
Simmer the tomatoes and the light coconut milk for 6 minutes, steam the mussels for 8 minutes until the shells open and season with lime, coriander, salt and pepper.
Serve with the wholemeal bread.

title: Haddock stew with tomato, potato, celery and dill
instructions: Dice the onion, cut the celery and the potatoes into pieces and sweat them in the olive oil for 5 minutes.
Simmer the tomatoes, thyme and bay leaf for 12 minutes, then cook the peas and the haddock fillet with them for 8 minutes.
Season with dill, salt and pepper and serve in a bowl.

title: Kippers-style smoked mackerel with scrambled eggs and wholemeal toast
instructions: Toast the 2 slices of wholemeal toast and halve the tomatoes.
Scramble the 2 eggs in the olive oil for 3 minutes and season with chives, salt and pepper.
Serve the smoked mackerel beside the scrambled eggs, toast and tomatoes.

title: Squid rice with peas, saffron and lemon
instructions: Sweat the garlic, pepper and fennel in the olive oil for 4 minutes, then toast the brown rice and the saffron with them for 1 minute.
Add water and simmer for 20 minutes, then cook the squid, peas and olives with the rice for 6 minutes.
Season with lemon, parsley, salt and pepper and serve.

title: Salmon burger in a wholemeal bun with dill yoghurt and salad
instructions: Finely chop the salmon fillet, shape it with salt and pepper into 1 patty and fry it in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Stir the yoghurt with the dill and the mustard, slice the cucumber and the tomato and cut the red onion into rings.
Split the wholemeal roll and fill it with the dill yoghurt, the salmon patty, lettuce, cucumber, tomato and onion.

title: Cod tacos with cabbage lime slaw and avocado
instructions: Shred the white cabbage into fine strips, slice the radishes and mix them with lime, yoghurt, salt and pepper into a slaw.
Fry the cod fillet in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side, break it into pieces and cut the avocado into wedges.
Warm the 2 corn tortillas and fill them with the cod, cabbage slaw, avocado, coriander and lime.

title: Pike-perch on sauerkraut with boiled potatoes and mustard
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes.
Warm the sauerkraut with diced apple, caraway and dill for 8 minutes.
Fry the pike-perch fillet in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side, serve with mustard, sauerkraut and boiled potatoes and season with salt and pepper.

title: Prawn barley risotto with courgette, lemon and parsley
instructions: Sweat the shallot in the olive oil for 3 minutes, toast the barley for 1 minute and cook it with the vegetable broth for 20 minutes, stirring often.
Dice the courgette and the cherry tomatoes, cook them with the barley for 5 minutes and fold in the prawns for 4 minutes.
Season with lemon, parsley, salt and pepper and serve.

title: Tuna nicoise bowl with egg, beans, potato and olive
instructions: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, cook the green beans until crisp-tender for 6 minutes, hard-boil 1 egg for 9 minutes and quarter it.
Stir the olive oil with the apple cider vinegar, salt and pepper into a dressing.
Serve the tuna, potatoes, beans, egg, olives, capers, radishes, cherry tomatoes and rocket in a bowl with the dressing.

title: Trout fillet with almond butter, green beans and potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes, cook the green beans until crisp-tender for 8 minutes and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Fry the trout fillet for 4 minutes per side, set it aside and toast the flaked almonds in the butter for 1 minute until golden.
Serve the trout with the almond butter, beans, potatoes, cherry tomatoes, dill and lemon and season with salt and pepper.

title: Monkfish tagine with chickpeas, lemon and coriander
instructions: Dice the onion and the carrots, sweat them in the olive oil for 4 minutes and toast the cumin, turmeric and paprika with them.
Stew the tomatoes, chickpeas and olives for 10 minutes, then cook pieces of the monkfish fillet with them for 8 minutes.
Season with lemon, coriander, salt and pepper and serve.

title: Oven salmon on a courgette ricotta gratin with dill
instructions: Slice the courgette, layer it with ricotta, garlic, dill, salt and pepper, scatter the cherry tomatoes and pine nuts on top and pre-bake at 190 °C for 15 minutes.
Place the salmon fillet on the gratin with olive oil, salt, pepper and lemon.
Bake for a further 12 minutes and serve with dill.

title: Crab cakes with corn salsa and green salad
instructions: Shape the crab meat with the egg, part of the yoghurt, salt and pepper into 2 flat cakes and fry them in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Mix the sweetcorn, pepper and red onion with lime, coriander and the remaining yoghurt into a salsa.
Serve the crab cakes with the corn salsa and the green salad.

title: Rollmops plate with potato salad, apple and cucumber
instructions: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes and slice them, hard-boil 1 egg for 9 minutes and quarter it.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard, apple cider vinegar, dill, salt and pepper and mix with the potatoes, diced apple, cucumber, onion and gherkin into a salad.
Serve the 2 rollmops with the potato salad and the egg.

title: Arctic char tartare with cucumber, dill, mustard and wholemeal toast
instructions: Finely dice the arctic char fillet, finely chop the shallot and the capers and mix them with mustard, lemon juice, olive oil, dill, salt and pepper into a tartare.
Slice the cucumber and toast the 2 slices of wholemeal toast.
Serve the tartare with the cucumber and the toast.

title: Prawn pad thai with rice noodles, egg, sprouts and peanut
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water for 5 minutes and stir the tamarind with the soy sauce and the lime into a sauce.
Fry the prawns and the pak choi in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes, scramble 1 egg with them for 1 minute, then fold in the noodles, sauce, bean sprouts and spring onions for 3 minutes.
Serve with the peanuts, coriander, salt and pepper.

title: Oven tilapia with tomato ginger sauce and basmati
instructions: Cook the basmati rice for 15 minutes.
Sweat the onion, garlic and ginger in the olive oil for 3 minutes, simmer the tomatoes, cumin and turmeric for 8 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Bake the tilapia in the sauce at 200 °C for 12 minutes and serve with coriander, lime and the rice.

title: Smoked salmon rolls with horseradish quark and chives
instructions: Stir the low-fat quark with the horseradish, lemon juice, a little of the chives, salt and pepper.
Lay the smoked salmon in 4 strips, spread them with the horseradish quark and roll them up.
Serve with radishes, lamb lettuce and the remaining chives.

title: Mussels a la provencale with tomato, garlic and wholemeal bread
instructions: Sweat the onion and the garlic in the olive oil for 3 minutes and dice the courgette.
Simmer the tomatoes, courgette, olives, capers, thyme and alcohol-free white wine for 6 minutes, then steam the mussels for 8 minutes until the shells open.
Season with parsley, salt and pepper and serve with the wholemeal bread.

title: Salmon with miso glaze, pak choi and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes.
Stir the miso with the honey and a little ginger into a glaze, brush it on the salmon fillet and bake at 200 °C for 12 minutes.
Fry the pak choi in the sesame oil with the remaining ginger for 4 minutes and serve with sesame, spring onions, the rice, salt and pepper.

title: Hake with peas, shallots and herb mash
instructions: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes and mash them with parsley, dill, mint, a little olive oil, salt and pepper into a herb mash.
Quarter the shallots and fry them in the remaining olive oil for 5 minutes until golden, then cook the peas with them for 5 minutes.
Fry the hake fillet for 4 minutes per side and serve with the peas, shallots, herb mash and lemon.

title: Tuna melon salad with mint, feta and lime
instructions: Sear the tuna steak in the olive oil for 2 minutes per side, cut it into cubes and leave the centre pink.
Dice the honeydew melon and the cucumber, crumble the feta and slice the red onion into rings.
Toss everything with mint, rocket, lime, salt and pepper into a salad and serve.

title: Cod provencale with tomato, olive, fennel and potatoes
instructions: Quarter the potatoes, cut the fennel into wedges and dice the tomatoes.
Stew the vegetables with garlic, olives, capers, thyme, olive oil, salt and pepper in the oven at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Bake the cod fillet on the vegetables in the oven for 12 minutes and serve with parsley.

title: Prawn frittata with courgette, dill and salad
instructions: Slice the courgette, cut the spring onions into rings and stew them in the olive oil for 4 minutes.
Beat the 3 eggs with dill, salt and pepper, fold in the prawns and the courgette, let the frittata set in the pan for 8 minutes and finish under the grill for 4 minutes.
Dress the lettuce with the radishes and serve it with a slice of the frittata.

title: Mackerel on a warm lentil salad with mustard and herbs
instructions: Cook the lentils for 20 minutes, dice the onion and the carrot and stew them for 5 minutes.
Stir the mustard, apple cider vinegar, olive oil, parsley, dill, chives, salt and pepper into a dressing and mix with the lentils, onion, carrot and rocket into a warm salad.
Fry the mackerel fillet for 4 minutes per side and serve it on the lentil salad.

title: Scallops with pumpkin cream, sage and hazelnut
instructions: Dice the pumpkin, finely chop the shallot, stew them with part of the olive oil until soft for 12 minutes, blend into a cream and season with salt and pepper.
Coarsely chop the hazelnuts and toast them without fat for 2 minutes, then fry the sage in the remaining olive oil for 30 seconds until crisp.
Sear the 4 scallops for 2 minutes per side and serve them on the pumpkin cream with sage, hazelnut and lemon juice.

title: Sea bass ceviche with lime, coriander and sweet potato
instructions: Boil the sweet potato for 15 minutes, cut it into cubes, dice the radish and the cucumber and slice the red onion into rings.
Cut the sea bass fillet into 2 cm cubes and marinate them with lime juice, chili, salt and pepper for 10 minutes.
Serve the ceviche in a bowl with the sweet potato, radish, cucumber, red onion and coriander.

title: Salmon kofte in tomato sauce with bulgur and parsley
instructions: Leave the bulgur to swell for 10 minutes, finely chop the salmon fillet, dice the pepper and shape it with the egg, onion, garlic, mint, a little parsley, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper into 8 kofte.
Brown the kofte in the olive oil for 6 minutes, then simmer the passata over them for 8 minutes.
Serve with the remaining parsley and the bulgur.

title: Pollock piccata on spinach with lemon and capers
instructions: Dust the pollock fillet in the wheat flour and fry it in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side, then season with salt and pepper.
Wilt the garlic and the spinach for 2 minutes.
Add the capers, lemon and parsley to the pan and serve the pollock on the spinach.

title: Cottage cheese salmon toast with cucumber, dill and radishes
instructions: Fry the salmon fillet in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side, break it into pieces and season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
Toast the 2 slices of wholemeal toast and slice the cucumber and the radishes.
Spread the toast with the cottage cheese and top with the salmon, cucumber, radishes and dill.

title: Sea bream with freekeh, roasted courgette and lemon
instructions: Cook the freekeh for 20 minutes.
Slice the courgette, halve the cherry tomatoes and roast them with garlic, olive oil, salt and pepper at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Fry the sea bream for 6 minutes per side and serve with the freekeh, courgette, cherry tomatoes, pomegranate seeds, parsley, mint and lemon.

title: Prawn orzo with feta, tomato, dill and lemon
instructions: Cook the wholemeal orzo until al dente for 10 minutes and finely chop the shallot.
Sweat the shallot in the olive oil for 2 minutes, cook the tomatoes and the prawns with them for 5 minutes and fold in the orzo.
Crumble the feta, fold it in with dill, lemon, salt and pepper and serve.

title: Halibut with a horseradish crust, red cabbage and boiled potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes, shred the red cabbage, dice the apple and stew them for 8 minutes.
Mix the horseradish with the low-fat quark and the breadcrumbs into a crust and spread it on the halibut fillet.
Bake the halibut with olive oil at 200 °C for 12 minutes and serve with the red cabbage, potatoes and dill, then season with salt and pepper.

title: Squid keftedes with tomato salad and tzatziki
instructions: Finely chop the squid, shape it with the egg, breadcrumbs, onion, parsley, oregano, salt and pepper into 6 keftedes and fry them in the olive oil for 8 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with the cucumber, garlic, dill and a little lemon juice into a tzatziki.
Cut the tomatoes into wedges, dress them with the remaining lemon juice, salt and pepper into a salad and serve with the keftedes and the tzatziki.

title: Salmon cabbage rolls with rice, dill and tomato sauce
instructions: Parboil the brown rice for 15 minutes and blanch the white cabbage leaves for 3 minutes.
Finely chop the salmon fillet, mix it with the rice, dill, mint, parsley, onion, pine nuts, lemon juice, salt and pepper and wrap the filling in 3 cabbage leaves.
Place the rolls in the passata and the cherry tomatoes, braise them with olive oil at 180 °C for 25 minutes and serve.

title: Avocado toast with sardines, lemon and chili flakes
instructions: Toast the 2 slices of wholemeal toast, mash the avocado and season it with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Drain the sardines and slice the radishes.
Spread the toast with the avocado and top with the sardines, lemon, chili flakes, olive oil and radishes.

title: Barley stew with kale, white beans and thyme
instructions: Dice the onion and the carrot, slice the kale into strips and simmer the barley in the vegetable stock for 5 minutes.
Heat the olive oil in a pot, sweat the onion and the carrot for 5 minutes, then add the white beans, kale, thyme, salt and pepper.
Pour in the barley with the vegetable stock and simmer for 25 minutes, then serve the stew.

title: Freekeh salad with chickpeas, courgette, mint and lemon
instructions: Cook the freekeh in salted water for 15 minutes, drain it and let it cool.
Slice the courgette, dice the cucumber and cut the red onion into fine rings.
Mix the freekeh with the chickpeas, courgette, cucumber, red onion, mint, parsley, olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve.

title: Buckwheat bowl with lentils, broccoli, tahini and herbs
instructions: Cook the buckwheat and the lentils separately in salted water for 15 minutes, then drain them.
Cut the broccoli into florets and the carrot into slices and steam them for 8 minutes.
Stir the tahini with lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper, spoon it over the buckwheat, lentils, broccoli and carrot and finish with parsley and mint.

title: Kamut salad with tomato, cucumber, parsley and feta
instructions: Cook the kamut in salted water for 25 minutes, drain it and let it cool.
Dice the tomatoes and the cucumber, cut the pepper into strips, slice the red onion into rings and crumble the feta.
Mix the kamut with the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, red onion, rocket, parsley, feta, olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve.

title: Teff bowl with black beans, pepper and coriander-lime
instructions: Cook the teff in lightly salted water for 15 minutes until it forms a porridge.
Cut the pepper into strips and the red onion into rings, fry them with olive oil, salt and pepper for 8 minutes, then add the sweetcorn and the black beans.
Spoon the teff into a bowl and top it with the pepper, onion, sweetcorn, black beans, coriander, lime, cucumber, pomegranate seeds and sesame seeds.

title: Oat-bran patties with lentil salad and herb quark
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain them and mix them with the cucumber, carrot, lemon juice, salt and pepper into a salad.
Mix the oat bran with the egg, salt and pepper, shape 4 patties and fry them in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Stir the low-fat quark with parsley, chives, salt and pepper into a herb quark and serve it with the patties, the lentil salad, medium-hot mustard, radishes and apple.

title: Wholemeal spaetzle with lentil vegetable sauce and parsley
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, dice the onion and the carrot, cut the broccoli into florets and slice the celery and the fennel.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion, carrot, broccoli, celery and fennel for 6 minutes, add the passata, lentils, salt and pepper and simmer for 10 minutes.
Heat the wholemeal spaetzle in salted water for 3 minutes, drain them and serve with the lentil vegetable sauce and the parsley.

title: Pearl barley risotto with mushrooms, spinach and hard cheese
instructions: Dice the onion, slice the mushrooms and toast the barley in the olive oil with the onion for 2 minutes.
Add the vegetable stock gradually and cook the barley, stirring, for 25 minutes until creamy, adding the mushrooms, spinach, thyme, salt and pepper after 15 minutes.
Stir in the vegetarian hard cheese (parmesan style), parsley, leek, walnuts and lemon juice and serve the risotto at once.

title: Bulgur stew with chickpeas, aubergine and mint
instructions: Dice the aubergine, finely dice the onion and chop the garlic.
Heat the olive oil, fry the onion, garlic and aubergine for 8 minutes, add the passata, chickpeas, salt and pepper and simmer for 12 minutes.
Let the bulgur swell in the stew for 10 minutes, season with mint, lemon juice, bell pepper, carrot, rocket, leek and salt and serve.

title: Wheat-berry bowl with roasted broccoli, chickpeas and tahini
instructions: Cook the wheat berries in salted water for 25 minutes and drain them.
Split the broccoli into florets and roast them with olive oil, salt and pepper at 200 °C for 15 minutes, adding the chickpeas for the last 5 minutes.
Stir the tahini with lemon juice, salt and pepper, spoon it over the wheat berries, broccoli and chickpeas and finish with parsley and pomegranate seeds.

title: Pumpernickel with cottage cheese, cucumber, radish and cress
instructions: Lay out the 2 slices of pumpernickel and stir the cottage cheese with salt and pepper.
Slice the cucumber and the radishes and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Spread the cottage cheese on the pumpernickel and top it with the cucumber, radishes, cherry tomatoes, cress and the flaxseeds, then serve.

title: Rye-flake patties with white cabbage salad and yoghurt
instructions: Shred the white cabbage and the carrot and mix them with apple cider vinegar, caraway, dill, salt and pepper into a salad.
Mix the rye flakes with the egg, grated onion, salt and pepper, shape 4 patties and fry them in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Stir the yoghurt with dill, salt and pepper and serve it with the patties, the white cabbage salad, cucumber, medium-hot mustard and radishes.

title: Barley groats with savoy cabbage, carrots and caraway
instructions: Dice the onion, slice the carrots and cut the savoy cabbage into strips.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion, carrots and caraway for 5 minutes, toast the barley groats briefly, pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the savoy cabbage, salt and pepper and cook for 10 minutes more, then serve with parsley.

title: Beluga lentil pan with kale, lemon and wholemeal orzo
instructions: Cook the beluga lentils until tender for 20 minutes, cook the wholemeal orzo in salted water for 8 minutes and drain both.
Dice the onion and the garlic, slice the kale into strips and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion, garlic and kale for 6 minutes, add the lentils, orzo, cherry tomatoes, lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve.

title: Adzuki barley stew with leek and herbs
instructions: Slice the leek into rings, the carrot into slices and the savoy cabbage into strips.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the leek, carrot and savoy cabbage for 6 minutes, toast the barley, then add the adzuki beans, thyme, salt, pepper and the vegetable stock.
Simmer the stew for 25 minutes, season with parsley, thyme and lemon juice and serve.

title: Pinto bean salad with quinoa, pepper, coriander and lime
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes, drain it and let it cool.
Dice the pepper and the cucumber, slice the red onion into fine rings and drain the sweetcorn and the pinto beans.
Mix the quinoa with the pinto beans, pepper, cucumber, sweetcorn, red onion, coriander, olive oil, lime, salt and pepper and serve.

title: Lima bean ragout with tomato, celery and pumpernickel
instructions: Dice the onion and the celery, slice the carrot, dice the tomatoes and chop the garlic.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion, celery, carrot and garlic for 6 minutes, add the lima beans, tomatoes, thyme, salt and pepper and simmer for 15 minutes.
Cut the pumpernickel into cubes and serve it beside the ragout.

title: Broad bean pan with dill, yoghurt and bulgur
instructions: Let the bulgur swell in hot salted water for 10 minutes, then drain it.
Chop the garlic, slice the spring onions into rings, heat the olive oil and fry the broad beans with the garlic for 8 minutes, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Stir the yoghurt with dill, lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve it with the bean pan, the bulgur and the spring onions.

title: Toor dal with leaf spinach, tomato and quinoa
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes and the toor dal until tender for 20 minutes, then drain both.
Dice the onion and the tomatoes, finely chop the garlic and the ginger and sweat them in the olive oil with cumin and turmeric for 5 minutes.
Stew the toor dal, leaf spinach, salt and pepper together for 5 minutes and serve with the quinoa and the coriander.

title: Urad lentil bowl with cauliflower, cumin and coriander
instructions: Cook the urad lentils until tender for 20 minutes and drain them.
Cut the cauliflower into florets, dice the onion and the tomatoes, chop the ginger and roast everything with olive oil, cumin, salt and pepper at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Serve the urad lentils in a bowl with the cauliflower, onion, tomatoes, ginger, lemon juice, coriander, bell pepper, leek and spinach, and season with salt and pepper.

title: Mung dal with courgette, ginger and buckwheat
instructions: Cook the buckwheat for 15 minutes and the mung dal until tender for 20 minutes, then drain both.
Slice the courgette, dice the tomatoes, chop the garlic and the ginger and fry them in the olive oil with turmeric and cumin for 6 minutes.
Simmer the mung dal, courgette, tomatoes, salt and pepper for 8 minutes and serve with the buckwheat and the coriander.

title: Lupine salad with cucumber, tomato, herbs and olive oil
instructions: Dice the cucumber, tomatoes and pepper, slice the radishes and cut the red onion into fine rings.
Drain the lupins and mix them in a bowl with the cucumber, tomatoes, pepper, radishes, red onion, parsley and mint.
Add the olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper, toss once more with feta, lamb's lettuce and olives and serve the salad.

title: Chickpea-flour pancakes with a vegetable filling and yoghurt
instructions: Stir the chickpea flour with the water, salt and pepper into a smooth batter and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Cut the courgette and the pepper into small dice, tear the spinach roughly, fry them in the olive oil for 5 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Cook 2 pancakes from the batter for 3 minutes per side, fill them with the vegetables, yoghurt, parsley, mint and lemon juice and serve.

title: Wholemeal pita pockets with lentil falafel, cabbage and tahini
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain them, blend with parsley, cumin, coriander, salt and pepper, shape 4 falafel and fry them in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Shred the white cabbage and the carrot, slice the cucumber and stir the tahini with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Open the wholemeal pita and fill it with the lentil falafel, cabbage, carrot, cucumber, tahini, rocket and tomatoes, then serve.

title: Savoury oat risotto with mushrooms, peas and thyme
instructions: Dice the onion, slice the mushrooms and sweat the onion in the olive oil for 3 minutes.
Stir the oats briefly, pour in the vegetable stock and cook, stirring, for 12 minutes until creamy, adding the mushrooms, peas, thyme, salt and pepper after 6 minutes.
Stir in the vegetarian hard cheese (parmesan style), parsley, carrot, garlic and lemon juice and serve the risotto.

title: Overnight barley flakes with apple, cinnamon and walnuts
instructions: Stir the barley flakes with the water, cinnamon and a pinch of salt in a bowl and let them swell cold overnight or for at least 8 hours.
Dice the apple, roughly chop the walnuts and have the raspberries ready.
Serve the swollen barley flakes with the skyr, apple, walnuts and raspberries, dusting with more cinnamon if you like.

title: Buckwheat pancakes with skyr, raspberries and flaxseeds
instructions: Stir the buckwheat flour with the oat bran, egg, water, cinnamon, salt and half of the flaxseeds into a batter.
Cook 3 small pancakes in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve the pancakes with the skyr, raspberries and the remaining flaxseeds.

title: Teff porridge with apple, cinnamon and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Cook the teff with the water and the cinnamon, stirring, for 15 minutes into a porridge and season with a pinch of salt.
Dice the apple and have the pumpkin seeds and the flaxseeds ready.
Serve the porridge with the yoghurt, apple, pumpkin seeds, flaxseeds and a little more cinnamon.

title: Oat-bran porridge with pear, flaxseeds and yoghurt
instructions: Simmer the oat bran with the water and the cinnamon, stirring, for 8 minutes into a porridge and season with a pinch of salt.
Slice the pear and roughly chop the walnuts.
Serve the porridge with the yoghurt, pear, flaxseeds, walnuts and a little more cinnamon.

title: Edamame salad with cucumber, sesame and lemon
instructions: Blanch the edamame in salted water for 5 minutes, drain them and cool them under cold water.
Slice the cucumber and the radishes and cut the spring onions into rings.
Mix the edamame with the cucumber, radishes, spring onions, sesame, olive oil, lemon juice, rice vinegar, salt and pepper and serve.

title: Lentil dip with carrot, cucumber and pepper sticks
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes and drain them.
Blend the lentils with the tahini, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, cumin, parsley, salt and pepper into a dip.
Cut the carrots, cucumber, pepper and radishes into sticks and serve them with the lentil dip and sesame seeds.

title: Chickpea crackers with hummus and vegetable sticks
instructions: Knead the chickpea flour with the sesame, water, olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper into a dough, roll it 0,3 cm thin and cut it into 8 crackers.
Bake the crackers at 180 °C for 12 minutes until they are firm and golden.
Cut the carrots, cucumber and pepper into sticks and serve them with the hummus and the chickpea crackers.

title: Chicken barley stew with celery, carrot and herbs
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into 3 cm pieces, dice the onion and slice the celery, carrot and leek.
Heat the olive oil, sear the chicken for 5 minutes, sweat the onion, celery, carrot and leek for 5 minutes, then add the barley, vegetable stock, thyme, parsley, salt and pepper.
Simmer the stew for 25 minutes and serve it with parsley, fennel and peas.

title: Turkey breast on lentils with chard and lemon
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 20 minutes, dice the onion and the carrot, chop the garlic and slice the chard into strips.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion, carrot and garlic for 5 minutes, add the chard, lentils, lemon juice, salt and pepper and stew for 5 minutes.
Season the turkey breast with salt and pepper, fry it in the remaining pan for 5 minutes per side and serve it on the lentils with the chard, lemon, parsley, fennel, dill, capers and bell pepper.

title: Oven cod on chickpeas with spinach and cumin
instructions: Chop the garlic, halve the cherry tomatoes and drain the chickpeas.
Place the chickpeas, spinach, garlic, cherry tomatoes, olive oil, cumin, lemon juice, salt and pepper in a baking dish and lay the cod fillet on top.
Bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes and serve with lemon.

title: Salmon on barley vegetables with fennel and lemon
instructions: Cook the barley in salted water for 25 minutes, drain it, and slice the fennel and the carrot.
Stew the fennel, carrot and peas with half of the olive oil, salt and pepper for 10 minutes, then fold in the barley, dill and lemon.
Fry the salmon fillet in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes per side, season with salt and pepper and serve it on the barley vegetables with capers and rocket.

title: Tofu bowl with beluga lentils, broccoli and miso-ginger
instructions: Cook the beluga lentils until tender for 20 minutes and drain them, and steam the broccoli florets for 6 minutes.
Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes and fry them in the olive oil for 6 minutes until golden, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Stir the miso with the ginger, lemon juice and a splash of water, spoon it over the tofu, lentils and broccoli and finish with spring onions and sesame.

title: Tempeh freekeh pan with courgette and herbs
instructions: Cook the freekeh for 15 minutes and drain it, slice the tempeh 1 cm thick, slice the courgette, halve the cherry tomatoes and chop the garlic.
Heat the olive oil, fry the tempeh for 4 minutes per side, then fry the courgette, garlic and cherry tomatoes with it for 5 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Fold in the freekeh and serve with parsley, mint, lemon juice, sesame seeds, spring onions and reduced-sodium soy sauce.

title: Egg ragout with chickpeas, spinach and parboiled rice
instructions: Cook the parboiled rice for 15 minutes, drain it and dice the onion.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion with cumin and turmeric for 4 minutes, stew the chickpeas, spinach, salt and pepper for 5 minutes, crack in the 2 eggs and let them set for 4 minutes.
Serve the egg ragout with the parboiled rice, the lemon juice, tomatoes and carrot.

title: Feta bulgur bake with courgette, tomato and mint
instructions: Let the bulgur swell in hot salted water for 10 minutes, then drain it, slice the courgette and dice the tomatoes and the onion.
Mix the bulgur with the courgette, tomatoes, onion, mint, parsley, olive oil, salt and pepper, spread it in a dish and crumble the feta on top.
Bake the dish at 200 °C for 20 minutes and serve it with mint.

title: Ricotta chard rolls on a lentil tomato sauce
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, dice the onion and the garlic, sweat them in the olive oil for 4 minutes, then simmer the passata, lentils, nutmeg, thyme, salt and pepper for 10 minutes.
Blanch the chard leaves for 2 minutes, stir the ricotta with lemon juice, salt and pepper, fill 4 leaves and roll them up.
Place the rolls on the lentil tomato sauce, bake at 180 °C for 12 minutes and serve with carrot, parsley, rocket, cherry tomatoes and olives.

title: White bean chili with pepper, celery and parboiled rice
instructions: Cook the parboiled rice for 15 minutes, drain it, dice the onion and the celery and cut the pepper into strips.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion, celery and pepper for 6 minutes, add the white beans, passata, cumin, chili, oregano, salt and pepper and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve the chili with the parboiled rice, the coriander, sweetcorn and lime.

title: Kidney bean cabbage pan with caraway, apple and quinoa
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes, drain it, slice the white cabbage into strips and dice the apple and the onion.
Heat the olive oil, stew the onion, white cabbage, caraway, salt and pepper for 8 minutes, then stew the kidney beans, apple and apple cider vinegar with them for 5 minutes.
Serve the pan with the quinoa.

title: Black bean enchiladas with a wholemeal wrap, pepper and salsa
instructions: Dice the pepper and the tomatoes, finely dice the red onion and drain the sweetcorn and the black beans.
Heat the olive oil, fry the pepper, onion, sweetcorn and black beans with cumin, paprika, salt and pepper for 8 minutes, then fold in half of the tomatoes and the coriander.
Roll the filling in the wholemeal wrap, bake it with the remaining tomato salsa, lime, coriander, rocket and garlic at 200 °C for 10 minutes and serve.

title: Borlotti minestra with farro, tomato and rosemary
instructions: Parboil the farro in salted water for 10 minutes, dice the onion, celery and carrot, dice the tomatoes and slice the kale into strips.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion, celery and carrot for 6 minutes, add the borlotti beans, tomatoes, farro, rosemary, salt and pepper and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the kale with the soup for 5 minutes and serve the minestra.

title: Giant beans with kale, lemon and pumpernickel
instructions: Chop the garlic, slice the kale into strips, halve the cherry tomatoes and cut the pumpernickel into 2 pieces.
Heat the olive oil, stew the garlic and kale for 6 minutes, then stew the giant beans, cherry tomatoes, lemon juice, salt and pepper with them for 8 minutes.
Serve with parsley and the 2 pieces of pumpernickel.

title: Black-eyed pea pan with tomato, okra and parboiled rice
instructions: Cook the parboiled rice for 15 minutes, drain it, dice the onion and the tomatoes, cut the okra into 2 cm pieces and chop the garlic.
Heat the olive oil, fry the onion, garlic and okra for 6 minutes, then simmer the black-eyed peas, tomatoes, cumin, chili, salt and pepper for 10 minutes.
Serve the pan with the parboiled rice, the coriander, celery and lime.

title: Pea barley stew with mint and yoghurt
instructions: Dice the onion, slice the carrot and toast the barley in the olive oil for 2 minutes.
Add the vegetable stock, onion, carrot, peas, salt and pepper and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with mint, lemon juice and the yoghurt.

title: Sugar-snap bulgur pan with tofu and sesame
instructions: Let the bulgur swell in hot salted water for 10 minutes, then drain it, cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes, the carrot into matchsticks, the spring onions into rings and chop the ginger.
Heat the olive oil, fry the tofu for 5 minutes until golden, then fry the sugar snap peas, carrot and ginger with it for 4 minutes and deglaze with the soy sauce, salt and pepper.
Fold in the bulgur and serve with sesame and spring onions.

title: Cauliflower lentil dal with a wholemeal chapati
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, cut the cauliflower into florets, dice the onion and the tomatoes and chop the ginger.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion, ginger, cumin, turmeric and chili for 3 minutes, then simmer the lentils, cauliflower, tomatoes, salt and pepper for 12 minutes.
Warm the wholemeal chapati for 1 minute per side in a dry pan and serve it with the dal, the coriander, yoghurt, peas and garlic.

title: Broccoli chickpea pan with cumin and quinoa
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes, drain it, split the broccoli into florets and chop the garlic.
Heat the olive oil, fry the broccoli, chickpeas, garlic and cumin for 8 minutes and season with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Serve the pan with the quinoa and the parsley.

title: Savoy cabbage bulgur roulades with yoghurt mint sauce
instructions: Cook the lentils half-tender for 12 minutes, let the bulgur swell for 10 minutes, drain both, dice the onion and blanch 4 large savoy leaves for 3 minutes.

Mix the bulgur, lentils, onion, parsley, mint, half of the olive oil, salt and pepper, roll the filling in the leaves, set them in the passata and the remaining olive oil and bake at 180 °C for 20 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with mint, lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve it with the roulades, walnuts, carrot and fennel.

title: Pointed cabbage lentil pan with caraway and pumpernickel
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain them, slice the pointed cabbage into strips, dice the carrot and the onion and cut the pumpernickel into 2 pieces.
Heat the olive oil, stew the onion, carrot, pointed cabbage and caraway for 8 minutes, then stew the lentils, apple cider vinegar, salt and pepper with them for 5 minutes.
Serve the pan with the 2 pieces of pumpernickel.

title: Fennel barley with white beans, orange and herbs
instructions: Cook the barley in salted water for 25 minutes, drain it, cut the fennel into wedges, segment the orange and drain the white beans.
Heat the olive oil, fry the fennel for 8 minutes, then warm the white beans, barley, orange segments, lemon juice, salt and pepper with it for 5 minutes.
Serve with parsley and dill.

title: Artichoke freekeh with peas, lemon and parsley
instructions: Cook the freekeh for 15 minutes, drain it, slice the spring onions into rings and halve the artichoke hearts.
Heat the olive oil, fry the artichokes and the peas for 6 minutes, then fold in the freekeh, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Serve with parsley, mint, spring onions, olives, rocket and cherry tomatoes.

title: Aubergine lentil bake with tomato and herb quark
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain them, slice the aubergine, dice the onion and the tomatoes and chop the garlic.
Roast the aubergine slices with half of the olive oil, salt and pepper at 200 °C for 15 minutes, stew the onion, garlic and tomatoes in the remaining pan for 6 minutes and fold in the lentils.
Layer the lentils and the aubergines, spoon the low-fat quark mixed with parsley, mint and lemon juice on top, bake for 10 minutes and serve.

title: Courgette quinoa pan with chickpeas and mint
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes, drain it, slice the courgette and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Heat the olive oil, fry the courgette and the cherry tomatoes for 6 minutes, then fold in the chickpeas, quinoa, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Serve with mint and parsley.

title: Peppers stuffed with lentils, bulgur and parsley
instructions: Cook the lentils half-tender for 12 minutes, let the bulgur swell for 8 minutes, drain both, dice the onion and halve and deseed the 2 peppers.
Mix the bulgur, lentils, onion, parsley, mint, half of the olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper and fill the 4 pepper halves.
Set the stuffed peppers in the passata and the remaining olive oil, bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes and serve with rocket and pomegranate seeds.

title: Tomato lentil soup with barley and thyme
instructions: Dice the onion, carrot and celery and dice the tomatoes.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion, carrot and celery for 5 minutes, then add the lentils, barley, tomatoes, vegetable stock, thyme, salt and pepper.
Simmer the soup for 25 minutes and serve with leek, lemon juice and garlic.

title: Celery chickpea stew with cumin and coriander
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes, drain it and dice the celery, carrot and onion.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the celery, carrot, onion and cumin for 6 minutes, then simmer the chickpeas, passata, lemon juice, salt and pepper for 12 minutes.
Serve the stew with the quinoa and the coriander.

title: Carrot lentil dal with ginger, spinach and quinoa
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes and the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain both, dice the carrots and the onion and chop the ginger.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion, ginger, cumin and turmeric for 4 minutes, simmer the carrots, lentils, salt and pepper for 10 minutes and fold in the spinach for 3 minutes.
Serve the dal with the quinoa, coriander and lemon juice.

title: Apple walnut cottage cheese with cinnamon and flaxseeds
instructions: Dice the apple and roughly chop the walnuts.
Stir the cottage cheese with the cinnamon and the flaxseeds.
Serve the cottage cheese in a bowl with the apple, walnuts and the oat bran, dusting with a little more cinnamon.

title: Pear skyr with oat bran and hazelnuts
instructions: Slice the pear and roughly chop the hazelnuts.
Stir the skyr with the cinnamon, oat bran and flaxseeds.
Serve the skyr with the pear and the hazelnuts, dusting with a little more cinnamon.

title: Baked apple with oat-bran crumble and yoghurt
instructions: Quarter the apple and remove the core, then roughly chop the walnuts.
Mix the oat bran, walnuts, flaxseeds, cinnamon, olive oil and a pinch of salt into a crumble, spoon it over the apple quarters and bake at 180 °C for 15 minutes.
Serve the baked apple with the yoghurt.

title: Berry chia pudding with oat bran and almonds
instructions: Stir the chia seeds with the yoghurt, oat bran and a pinch of salt and let them swell for at least 20 minutes or overnight.
Roughly chop the almonds and have the mixed berries ready.
Serve the chia pudding with the berries and the almonds.

title: Kale lentil pan with smoked tofu and lemon
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain them, dice the onion and the garlic, slice the kale into strips and cut the smoked tofu into 1 cm cubes.
Heat the olive oil, fry the tofu for 5 minutes until golden, stew the onion, garlic and kale with it for 6 minutes, then fold in the lentils, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Serve with the sesame.

title: Chard chickpea stew with bulgur and dill
instructions: Let the bulgur swell in hot salted water for 10 minutes, then drain it, dice the onion and the tomatoes, chop the garlic and slice the chard into strips.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion and the garlic for 4 minutes, then simmer the chard, chickpeas, tomatoes, salt and pepper for 10 minutes.
Serve the stew with the bulgur, dill and lemon juice.

title: Brussels sprout barley pan with hazelnut and thyme
instructions: Cook the barley in salted water for 25 minutes, drain it, halve the Brussels sprouts, dice the onion, slice the carrot and roughly chop the hazelnuts.
Heat the olive oil, fry the Brussels sprouts, onion, carrot and thyme for 10 minutes, then fold in the barley, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Serve with the hazelnuts.

title: Romanesco lentil bowl with tahini and cumin
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain them and split the romanesco into florets.
Roast the romanesco with olive oil, cumin, salt and pepper at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Stir the tahini with lemon juice, salt and pepper, spoon it over the lentils and the romanesco and finish with parsley and pomegranate seeds.

title: Okra chickpea pot with tomato and parboiled rice
instructions: Cook the parboiled rice for 15 minutes, drain it, cut the okra into 2 cm pieces, dice the onion and the tomatoes and chop the garlic.
Heat the olive oil, fry the onion, garlic and okra for 6 minutes, then simmer the chickpeas, tomatoes, cumin, chili, salt and pepper for 12 minutes.
Serve the pot with the parboiled rice, the coriander, spinach, lemon juice and bell pepper.

title: Purslane lentil salad with lemon, onion and wholemeal pita
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain them and let them cool, and warm the wholemeal pita for 1 minute per side in a pan.
Tear the purslane roughly, dice the cucumber and the tomatoes and slice the red onion into fine rings.
Mix the lentils with the purslane, cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, parsley, mint, olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve with the pita.

title: Lamb lettuce bowl with lentils, apple, walnut and yoghurt dressing
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain them and let them cool, dice the apple, roughly chop the walnuts and slice the radishes.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper into a dressing.
Serve the lamb lettuce in a bowl with the lentils, apple, walnuts, radishes and the yoghurt dressing.

title: Rocket chickpea salad with wholemeal orzo and lemon
instructions: Cook the wholemeal orzo in salted water for 8 minutes, drain it and let it cool, halve the cherry tomatoes and shave the vegetarian hard cheese (parmesan style).
Drain the chickpeas and have the rocket and the parsley ready.
Mix the orzo with the chickpeas, rocket, cherry tomatoes, parsley, vegetarian hard cheese (parmesan style), olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve.

title: Napa cabbage lentil pan with ginger and buckwheat
instructions: Cook the buckwheat for 15 minutes and the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain both, slice the napa cabbage into strips, cut the carrot into matchsticks, slice the spring onions into rings and chop the ginger.
Heat the olive oil, fry the ginger, napa cabbage and carrot for 5 minutes, then fold in the lentils, buckwheat, soy sauce, salt and pepper.
Serve with sesame and spring onions.

title: Pak choi mung dal with sesame and parboiled rice
instructions: Cook the parboiled rice for 15 minutes and the mung dal until tender for 20 minutes, drain both, halve the pak choi lengthways, chop the garlic and the ginger and slice the spring onions into rings.
Heat the olive oil, fry the garlic, ginger and pak choi for 5 minutes, then fold in the mung dal, soy sauce, salt and pepper.
Serve with the parboiled rice, sesame and spring onions.

title: Cavolo nero borlotti stew with farro and rosemary
instructions: Parboil the farro in salted water for 10 minutes, dice the onion, chop the garlic, slice the cavolo nero into strips and dice the tomatoes.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion and the garlic for 4 minutes, then simmer the borlotti beans, farro, tomatoes, rosemary, salt and pepper for 20 minutes.
Cook the cavolo nero with the stew for 8 minutes, season with lemon juice and serve.

title: Chicory lentil salad with orange, walnut and goat cheese
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain them and let them cool, slice the chicory into strips, segment the orange, roughly chop the walnuts and crumble the goat cheese.
Place the lamb lettuce and the lentils in a bowl.
Toss with the chicory, orange segments, walnuts, goat cheese, olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve.

title: Radicchio barley pan with walnut, thyme and hard cheese
instructions: Cook the barley in salted water for 25 minutes, drain it, slice the radicchio into strips, dice the onion, roughly chop the walnuts and shave the vegetarian hard cheese (parmesan style).
Heat the olive oil, stew the onion, radicchio and thyme for 6 minutes, then fold in the barley, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Serve with the walnuts and the vegetarian hard cheese (parmesan style).

title: Endive lentil salad with apple, mustard and yoghurt
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain them and let them cool, slice the endive leaves into strips, dice the apple and roughly chop the walnuts.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard, olive oil, apple cider vinegar, salt and pepper into a dressing.
Toss the endive with the lentils, apple, walnuts and the yoghurt-mustard dressing and serve.

title: Warm lentil breakfast with egg, spinach and cumin
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain them and dice the onion and the tomatoes.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion and the cumin for 3 minutes, then stew the lentils, spinach, tomatoes, lemon juice, salt and pepper with them for 4 minutes.
Let 1 egg set in a well for 4 minutes and serve with the yoghurt.

title: Chickpea hash with a fried egg, pepper and parsley
instructions: Dice the onion, cut the pepper into strips, roughly crush the chickpeas and have the spinach ready.
Heat the olive oil, fry the onion, pepper, chickpeas, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper for 8 minutes, folding in the spinach for the last 2 minutes.
Fry 1 egg for 3 minutes and serve it with the hash, parsley, lemon juice, radishes and cucumber.

title: Quark oat-bran pancakes with berries and cinnamon
instructions: Stir the low-fat quark with the oat bran, egg, cinnamon, flaxseeds and a pinch of salt into a batter.
Cook 3 small pancakes in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve the pancakes with the berries and a little more cinnamon.

title: Turkey mince lentil sauce with wholemeal pasta and parsley
instructions: Cook the wholemeal pasta in salted water for 8 minutes, drain it, dice the onion, the carrot, the courgette and the celery and chop the garlic.
Heat the olive oil, brown the turkey mince for 5 minutes, sweat the onion, carrot, courgette, celery and garlic for 4 minutes, then simmer the lentils, passata, salt and pepper for 15 minutes.
Spoon the sauce over the wholemeal pasta and serve with parsley.

title: Chicken freekeh pan with courgette, lemon and herbs
instructions: Cook the freekeh for 15 minutes, drain it, cut the chicken breast into 2 cm strips, slice the courgette, halve the cherry tomatoes and chop the garlic.
Heat the olive oil, sear the chicken for 5 minutes, then fry the courgette, garlic and cherry tomatoes with it for 5 minutes and season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
Fold in the freekeh and serve with parsley, mint, thyme, bell pepper, carrot and rocket.

title: Pollock on a wheat-berry salad with cucumber and dill
instructions: Cook the wheat berries in salted water for 25 minutes, drain them and let them cool, and slice the cucumber and the radishes.
Mix the wheat berries with the cucumber, radishes, dill, yoghurt, half of the olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper into a salad.
Fry the pollock fillet in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes per side, season with salt and pepper and serve it on the salad.

title: Tofu barley bowl with broccoli, edamame and tamari-lime
instructions: Cook the barley in salted water for 25 minutes, drain it, steam the broccoli florets for 6 minutes, cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes and slice the spring onions into rings.
Heat the olive oil, fry the tofu for 6 minutes until golden, warm the edamame with it for 2 minutes and deglaze with the tamari, lime, salt and pepper.
Serve the barley, broccoli, tofu and edamame in a bowl, sprinkled with sesame and spring onions.

title: Tempeh bulgur pan with kale and lemon zest
