instructions: Let the bulgur swell in hot salted water for 10 minutes, then drain it, slice the tempeh 1 cm thick, slice the kale into strips, cut the spring onions into rings and chop the garlic.
Heat the olive oil, fry the tempeh for 4 minutes per side, stew the kale and the garlic with it for 5 minutes and season with lemon zest, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Fold in the bulgur and serve with sesame and spring onions.

title: Cottage cheese flaxseed crackers with cucumber and radish
instructions: Knead the cottage cheese with the flaxseeds, oat bran, sesame, olive oil, salt and pepper into a dough, roll it 0,4 cm thin and cut it into 6 crackers.
Bake the crackers at 180 °C for 15 minutes until they are firm and golden.
Slice the cucumber and the radishes and serve them with the crackers and the cress.

title: Wholemeal lasagne with lentil bolognese and ricotta
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, dice the onion and the carrot and cut the courgette into small dice.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion, carrot and courgette for 6 minutes, then simmer the lentils, passata, oregano, basil, salt and pepper for 10 minutes.
Layer the wholemeal lasagne sheets with the lentil bolognese, the ricotta, spinach and garlic, bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes and serve.

title: Wholemeal wrap rolls with hummus, lentils, carrot and rocket
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain them and let them cool, coarsely grate the carrot and cut the cucumber into sticks.
Spread the wholemeal wrap with the hummus, then add the lentils, carrot, cucumber, rocket, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Roll the wrap up tightly, cut it into 4 pieces and serve.

title: Pearl barley pilaf with edamame, carrot and dill
instructions: Cut the carrot into small dice, slice the spring onions into rings and toast the barley in the olive oil for 2 minutes.
Pour in salted water and cook the barley for 20 minutes, adding the edamame and the peas for the last 5 minutes, then drain.
Toss with dill, spring onions, lemon juice, salt, pepper, courgette, sesame seeds and tomatoes and serve.

title: Pumpernickel salad with white beans, tomato and oregano
instructions: Cut the pumpernickel into 2 cm cubes, dice the tomatoes and the cucumber, slice the red onion into fine rings and drain the white beans.
Mix the pumpernickel, white beans, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, oregano and parsley in a bowl.
Add the olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper, toss once more with capers, olives and radishes and serve.

title: Oat herb patties with white cabbage salad and yoghurt
instructions: Shred the white cabbage and the carrot and mix them with apple cider vinegar, salt and pepper into a salad.
Mix the oats, oat bran, egg, parsley, chives, dill, grated onion, salt and pepper, shape 4 patties and fry them in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Stir the yoghurt with dill, salt and pepper and serve it with the patties, the white cabbage salad, apple, flaxseed and lamb's lettuce.

title: Barley bowl with black beans, pepper and lime
instructions: Cook the barley in salted water for 25 minutes, drain it, cut the pepper into strips, the red onion into rings and the courgette into slices, set out the lamb's lettuce and the spring onions, and drain the sweetcorn and the black beans.
Heat the olive oil, fry the pepper and the onion for 5 minutes, warm the black beans and the sweetcorn with them for 3 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Spoon the barley into a bowl and top it with the pepper, onion, beans, sweetcorn, lamb's lettuce, spring onions, courgette, coriander and lime.

title: Quinoa lentil patties with cucumber mint salad
instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes and the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain both and let some steam escape, then finely grate the carrot.
Mix the quinoa, lentils, egg, carrot, parsley, salt and pepper, shape 4 patties and fry them in the olive oil for 4 minutes per side.
Slice the cucumber, mix it with mint, yoghurt, lemon juice, salt, pepper, bell pepper, spring onions and lamb's lettuce into a salad and serve it with the patties.

title: Buckwheat mushroom pan with lentils and thyme
instructions: Cook the buckwheat for 15 minutes and the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, drain both, slice the mushrooms and dice the onion.
Heat the olive oil, fry the onion, mushrooms and thyme for 6 minutes, then fold in the spinach, lentils, buckwheat, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Serve with parsley.

title: Skyr berry tartlets on an oat-bran base
instructions: Knead the oat bran, almonds, flaxseeds, olive oil, cinnamon and a pinch of salt into a crumb dough, press it into 2 small tins and bake at 180 °C for 12 minutes, then let them cool.
Stir the skyr until smooth and have the mixed berries ready.
Fill the bases with the skyr and the berries and serve.

title: Chickpea spinach soup with barley and lemon
instructions: Dice the onion and the garlic and toast the barley in the olive oil for 2 minutes.
Add the vegetable stock, chickpeas, onion, garlic, cumin, salt and pepper and simmer for 20 minutes, folding in the spinach for the last 3 minutes.
Serve the soup with lemon juice and coriander.

title: White bean fennel stew with pumpernickel croutons
instructions: Cut the fennel into wedges, dice the onion and the carrot and cut the pumpernickel into 1,5 cm cubes.

Heat the olive oil, using half of it for the croutons: toast the pumpernickel in the pan for 5 minutes, sweat the fennel, onion and carrot in the remaining olive oil for 6 minutes, then simmer the white beans, vegetable stock, thyme, lemon juice, salt and pepper for 15 minutes.
Serve the stew with the pumpernickel croutons.

title: Lentil shepherd pie with a cauliflower crust and peas
instructions: Cook the lentils until tender for 15 minutes, steam the cauliflower until soft for 12 minutes and mash it with the low-fat quark, salt and pepper into a puree, then dice the onion and the carrot.
Heat the olive oil, sweat the onion and the carrot for 5 minutes, simmer the lentils, peas, passata, thyme, salt and pepper for 8 minutes and spread the filling in a dish.
Spread the cauliflower puree as a crust on top, bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes until golden and serve.

title: Chicken breast on a large fennel-orange salad with barley
instructions: Wash Chicken breast, Fennel, Orange, Lamb's lettuce, Red onion, Parsley, dill, Carrot, Rocket, Radishes and Chicory and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Cook Pearl barley in water for 20 minutes and drain.
Heat Olive oil in a pan and cook Chicken breast for 8 minutes.
Add Lemon juice and Pepper, cumin, cinnamon, oregano, paprika, mix everything and serve.

title: Turkey strips with broccoli, carrots and unsalted herb rice
instructions: Wash Turkey breast, sliced into strips, Broccoli, Carrots, Parsley, Spring onions, Courgette and Sesame seeds and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Cook Basmati rice in water for 20 minutes and drain.
Heat Olive oil in a pan and cook Turkey breast, sliced into strips for 8 minutes.
Add Lemon juice, Pepper, cumin, cinnamon, oregano, paprika and Lime juice, mix everything and serve.

title: Oven vegetable plate with chickpeas, courgette, pepper and herb quark
instructions: Wash Chickpeas (drained), Courgette, Pepper, Parsley, mint, Onion, Cherry tomatoes, Thyme, Rocket, Fennel, Endive leaves and Chilli and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Heat Olive oil in a pan and cook Chickpeas (drained) and Low-fat quark for 8 minutes.
Add Lemon juice and Pepper, cumin, cinnamon, oregano, paprika, mix everything and serve.

title: Cod on tomato-courgette vegetables with parsley potatoes
instructions: Wash Cod fillet, Tomatoes, Courgette, Potatoes, Parsley, Garlic, Fennel, Peas (cooked) and Radicchio and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Cook Potatoes in water for 20 minutes and drain.
Heat Olive oil in a pan and cook Cod fillet for 8 minutes.
Add Lemon juice and Pepper, cumin, cinnamon, oregano, paprika, mix everything and serve.

title: Lentil vegetable stew with celery, carrot and thyme
instructions: Wash Lentils (dry), Celery, Carrot, Thyme, Onion, Passata, Parsley, Leek, Pepper, Fennel and Cavolo nero and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Heat Low-sodium vegetable stock in a pot.
Heat Olive oil in a pan and cook Lentils (dry) for 8 minutes.
Add Pepper, cumin, cinnamon, oregano, paprika, mix everything and serve.

title: Sliced turkey with mushrooms, peas and brown rice
instructions: Wash Turkey breast, sliced into strips, Mushrooms, Peas (cooked), Onion, Parsley, Pepper and Carrot and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Cook Brown rice (uncooked) in water for 20 minutes and drain.
Heat Olive oil in a pan and cook Turkey breast, sliced into strips for 8 minutes.
Add Lemon juice and Pepper, cumin, cinnamon, oregano, paprika, mix everything and serve.

title: Chicken vegetable skewers with bulgur salad and lemon
instructions: Wash Chicken breast, Pepper, Courgette, Parsley, Cucumber, Tomatoes, Red onion, Pomegranate seeds and Fennel and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Cook Bulgur in water for 20 minutes and drain.
Heat Olive oil in a pan and cook Chicken breast for 8 minutes.
Add Lemon and Pepper, cumin, cinnamon, oregano, paprika, mix everything and serve.

title: Pollock with cucumber-dill salad, carrots and quinoa
instructions: Wash Saithe fillet, Cucumber, Dill, Carrots, Radishes, Orange, Fennel and Green asparagus and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Cook Quinoa (uncooked) in water for 20 minutes and drain.
Heat Olive oil in a pan and cook Saithe fillet for 8 minutes.
Add Lemon juice and Pepper, cumin, cinnamon, oregano, paprika, mix everything and serve.

title: White bean stew with kale, tomato and herbs
instructions: Wash White beans (drained), Kale, Tomatoes, Parsley, thyme, Onion, Carrot, Celery, Pepper, Romanesco and Chilli and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Heat Low-sodium vegetable stock in a pot.
Heat Olive oil in a pan and cook White beans (drained) for 8 minutes.
Add Pepper, cumin, cinnamon, oregano, paprika and Lemon juice, mix everything and serve.

title: Courgette noodles with turkey mince, tomato and plenty of lettuce
instructions: Wash Courgette, Minced turkey, Tomatoes, Lettuce, Garlic, Onion, Oregano, basil, Carrot and Rocket and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Heat Olive oil in a pan and cook Minced turkey for 8 minutes.

Cook or fry the protein and vegetables for 12 minutes, finish the side for 15 minutes.
Plate everything on a plate and serve hot.
Season with Salt, pepper and serve at once.

title: Turkey schnitzel in a coconut almond crust with tomato fennel salad
instructions: Prepare, wash, cut or measure Turkey breast, Almond flour, Coconut flakes, Egg, Tomatoes, Olive oil, Parsley, Fennel and Pepper.
Cook or fry the protein and vegetables for 12 minutes, finish the side for 15 minutes.
Plate everything on a plate and serve hot.
Season with Pepper and serve at once.

title: Caper and olive crostini with tomato, rocket, aubergine, celery and chilli
instructions: Prepare, wash, cut or measure Wholemeal bread, Capers, Olives, Tomatoes, Rocket, Olive oil, Parsley, Oregano, Aubergine, Celery and Chilli.
Prepare, cut, mix or spread the ingredients in 8 minutes.
Plate cold and eat at once.
Season with Pepper and serve at once.

title: Tempeh lentil salad with red cabbage, orange and tahini
instructions: Prepare, wash, cut or measure Tempeh, Lentils (uncooked), Red cabbage, Orange, Tahini, Lemon juice and Parsley.
Cook the protein for 12 minutes, leave to cool, stir the dressing in 5 minutes.
Toss the prepared ingredients for 8 minutes, plate the salad and serve.
Season with Pepper and serve at once.

title: Mackerel potato salad with dill, cucumber, radishes, fennel, capers, pepper and apple cider vinegar
instructions: Prepare, wash, cut or measure Mackerel fillet, Potatoes, Cucumber, Radishes, Capers, Dill, Apple cider vinegar, Olive oil, Fennel, Lamb's lettuce, Pepper, Olives and Lemon juice.
Cook the protein for 12 minutes, leave to cool, stir the dressing in 5 minutes.
Toss the prepared ingredients for 8 minutes, plate the salad and serve.
Season with Pepper and serve at once.

title: Chicken and feta pan with spinach, courgette, olive and lemon
instructions: Prepare, wash, cut or measure Chicken breast, Feta, Leaf spinach, Courgette, Olives, Lemon juice and Olive oil.
Cook or fry the protein and vegetables for 12 minutes, finish the side for 15 minutes.
Plate everything on a plate and serve hot.
Season with Salt, pepper and serve at once.

title: Vegetable rosti with egg, herbs and unsweetened yoghurt
instructions: Prepare, wash, cut or measure Potatoes, Courgette, Carrots, Pepper, Egg, Yoghurt (0.2% fat), Parsley, chives and Rapeseed oil.
Mix the filling or mixture for 8 minutes, fill the tin or the vegetables, then bake in the oven for 25 minutes.
Take it out, plate and serve hot.
Season with Pepper and serve at once.

title: Hazelnut cocoa balls with dates, orange, sesame, chia and coconut flakes
instructions: Prepare, wash, cut or measure Hazelnuts, Cocoa, Dates (pitted), Orange, Rolled oats, Sesame seeds, Almonds, Chia seeds and Coconut flakes.
Prepare, cut, mix or spread the ingredients in 8 minutes.
Plate cold and eat at once.
Season to taste and serve at once.

title: Quick win: egg plate with cucumber, tomato, wholemeal bread and chives
instructions: Place the eggs in boiling water, cook for 8 minutes until hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Meanwhile wash the cucumber and tomato and cut them into slices.
Halve the eggs and arrange them on a plate with cucumber, tomato and the bread.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and finely cut chives.

title: Quick win: scrambled eggs with baby spinach, cherry tomatoes and edamame
instructions: Whisk the eggs in a bowl with salt and pepper.
Heat the rapeseed oil in a non-stick pan and warm the edamame in it for 2 minutes.
Add the eggs and stir over medium heat for 3 minutes until set, folding in the baby spinach during the last minute.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and arrange them next to the scrambled eggs on the plate.

title: Quick win: cottage cheese plate with radishes, pepper, cucumber and crispbread
instructions: Wash the radishes, pepper and cucumber and cut them into slices or strips.
Put the cottage cheese into a small bowl and season with salt, pepper and chives.
Arrange the vegetables and 2 slices of crispbread around the bowl on the plate.

title: Quick win: turkey breast plate with egg, cucumber, pepper and wholegrain crispbread
instructions: Place the egg in boiling water, cook for 8 minutes until hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Wash the cucumber and pepper, slice the cucumber and cut the pepper into strips.
Loosely fold the sliced turkey and arrange it on a plate with the halved egg, the vegetables and the crispbread.
Season the egg with salt and pepper.

title: Quick win: skyr bowl with blueberries, rolled oats, sunflower seeds and cinnamon
instructions: Stir the skyr smooth in a bowl.
Wash and drain the blueberries and spread them over the skyr.
Sprinkle with the oats, sunflower seeds and cinnamon and eat straight away.

title: Quick win: smoked salmon plate with egg, cucumber, dill and pumpernickel
instructions: Place the egg in boiling water, cook for 8 minutes until hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Wash the cucumber and cut it into thin slices.
Arrange the smoked salmon, the halved egg, the cucumber and the pumpernickel on a plate.
Drizzle the salmon with lemon juice and sprinkle everything with dill, salt and pepper.

title: Quick win: tuna plate with egg, tomato, cucumber and red onion
instructions: Place the egg in boiling water, cook for 8 minutes until hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Slice the tomato and cucumber and cut the red onion into thin rings.
Flake the tuna and arrange it on a plate with the halved egg and the vegetables.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.

title: Quick win: chicken breast plate with hummus, cucumber, carrot and wholemeal bread
instructions: Peel or wash the cucumber and carrot and cut them into sticks.
Put the hummus into a small bowl.
Arrange the sliced chicken, vegetable sticks and bread next to the hummus and dip.

title: Quick win: light feta plate with watermelon, cucumber, mint and crispbread
instructions: Cut the watermelon without rind into cubes and slice the cucumber.
Cut the light feta into cubes or crumble it roughly.
Arrange everything on a plate, sprinkle with mint and pepper and add the crispbread.

title: Quick win: fried eggs on wholemeal bread with tomato and rocket
instructions: Heat the rapeseed oil in a pan and crack in the eggs.
Fry over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are set.
Meanwhile slice the tomato and wash the rocket.
Top the bread with rocket and tomato, place the fried eggs on top and season with salt and pepper.

title: Quick win: omelette with pepper, spring onion and cucumber salad
instructions: Finely dice the pepper and cut the spring onion into rings.
Whisk the eggs and egg white with salt and pepper.
Heat the rapeseed oil in a pan, fry the pepper for 1 minute, add the egg mixture and spring onion and let it set covered for 4 minutes.
Slice the cucumber thinly, dress it with lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve it next to the folded omelette.

title: Quick win: herb quark with kohlrabi, carrot and pepper sticks and crispbread
instructions: Finely chop the herbs and stir them into the quark with salt, pepper and 1 to 2 tbsp water until creamy.
Peel the kohlrabi and carrot, wash the pepper and cut everything into sticks.
Fill the herb quark into a small bowl and serve with the vegetable sticks and crispbread.

title: Quick win: avocado and egg plate with tomato, lime and crispbread
instructions: Place the eggs in boiling water, cook for 8 minutes until hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Cut the avocado into wedges and drizzle with lime juice.
Slice the tomato and arrange it with the halved eggs, the avocado and the crispbread.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Quick win: cottage cheese bowl with cherry tomatoes, cucumber, chickpeas and parsley
instructions: Rinse and drain the chickpeas.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the cucumber and chop the parsley.
Put the cottage cheese into a bowl and spread the vegetables and chickpeas on top.
Finish with olive oil, parsley, salt and pepper.

title: Quick win: mozzarella and tomato plate with egg, rocket and wholemeal bread
instructions: Place the egg in boiling water, cook for 8 minutes until hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Slice the tomato and light mozzarella and layer them alternately on a plate.
Add the rocket and the halved egg alongside and drizzle with olive oil.
Sprinkle with basil, salt and pepper and serve with the bread.

title: Quick win: smoked trout plate with egg, radishes, cucumber and crispbread
instructions: Place the egg in boiling water, cook for 8 minutes until hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Wash the radishes and cucumber and slice them.
Pull the smoked trout into pieces and arrange it with the halved egg, vegetables and crispbread.
Sprinkle with dill and pepper.

title: Quick win: egg white scramble with mushrooms, spinach and wholemeal toast
instructions: Slice the mushrooms and fry them in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes.
Whisk the egg and egg white with salt and pepper, pour into the pan and stir for 2 to 3 minutes until set.
Fold in the baby spinach until it wilts.
Toast the bread and serve with the scramble.

title: Quick win: tofu plate with cherry tomatoes, yellow pepper, rocket and pumpkin seeds
instructions: Pat the tofu dry, cut it into cubes and season with paprika, salt and pepper.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, cut the pepper into strips and wash the rocket.
Arrange everything on a plate and drizzle with lemon juice.
Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds.

title: Quick win: hummus and egg plate with cherry tomatoes, pepper, rocket and crispbread
instructions: Place the egg in boiling water, cook for 8 minutes until hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, cut the pepper into strips and wash the rocket.
Spread the hummus on the plate and dust with paprika.
Arrange the halved egg, the vegetables, the rocket and the crispbread alongside.

title: Quick win: turkey breast rolls with light cream cheese, rocket, pepper and radishes
instructions: Cut the pepper into long thin strips, wash the rocket and halve the radishes.
Spread the sliced turkey thinly with the light cream cheese.
Place a little rocket and a few pepper strips on each slice and roll them up.
Arrange the rolls with the radishes and the crispbread.

title: Quick win: savoury skyr and cucumber bowl with egg, dill and pumpernickel
instructions: Place the egg in boiling water, cook for 8 minutes until hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Finely dice the cucumber and chop the dill.
Stir the skyr with cucumber, dill, salt and pepper and put it into a bowl.
Quarter the egg, place it on the bowl and serve with the pumpernickel.

title: Quick win: scrambled eggs with peas, spring onion and radish cucumber salad
instructions: Heat the rapeseed oil and sauté the peas and spring onion for 2 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper, add them and stir for 3 minutes until set.
Slice the radishes and cucumber and salt them lightly.
Serve the scrambled eggs with the salad on a plate.

title: Quick win: bresaola plate with rocket, cherry tomatoes, egg and crispbread
instructions: Place the egg in boiling water, cook for 8 minutes until hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Wash the rocket and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Lay the bresaola on a plate, top with rocket and tomatoes and drizzle with lemon juice.
Add the halved egg and the crispbread and season with pepper.

title: Quick win: chicken breast and avocado plate with tomato, cress and wholemeal bread
instructions: Slice the avocado and drizzle with lemon juice.
Slice the tomato.
Arrange the sliced chicken, avocado, tomato and bread on a plate.
Sprinkle with cress, salt and pepper.

title: Quick win: tuna cottage cheese spread with cucumber, pepper, celery and crispbread
instructions: Mix the tuna with the cottage cheese, lemon juice, salt and pepper using a fork.
Cut the cucumber, pepper and celery into sticks.
Fill the spread into a small bowl and serve with the vegetable sticks and crispbread.

title: Quick win: egg and cottage cheese plate with lamb's lettuce, apple and walnuts
instructions: Place the egg in boiling water, cook for 8 minutes until hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Wash the lamb's lettuce and cut the apple into thin wedges.
Arrange the cottage cheese, lettuce, apple and the halved egg on a plate.
Roughly chop the walnuts and sprinkle them over, season with pepper and add the bread.

title: Quick win: fried eggs with white beans, tomato and baby spinach
instructions: Rinse the white beans and dice the tomato.
Heat the rapeseed oil in a pan, warm the beans and tomato for 2 minutes and push them to the side.
Crack the eggs into the pan and fry for 3 to 4 minutes, adding the baby spinach in the last minute.
Season with salt and pepper and serve right away on a plate.

title: Quick win: herb omelette with cottage cheese and tomato salad
instructions: Whisk the eggs with chopped herbs, salt and pepper.
Heat the rapeseed oil, pour in the egg mixture and let it set covered for 4 minutes.
Spoon the cottage cheese onto one half and fold the omelette.
Slice the tomato, cut the onion into thin rings, season with salt and pepper and serve with the omelette.

title: Quick win: smoked salmon plate with avocado, radishes, cucumber and crispbread
instructions: Slice the avocado and drizzle with lemon juice.
Cut the radishes and cucumber into thin slices.
Arrange the smoked salmon, avocado, vegetables and crispbread on a plate and season with pepper.

title: Quick win: stuffed avocado with cottage cheese, cherry tomatoes and cress
instructions: Halve the avocado and remove the stone.
Season the cottage cheese with salt and pepper and fill it into the avocado half.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, place them next to the avocado and sprinkle everything with cress.
Serve with the crispbread.

title: Quick win: scrambled eggs with turkey breast, courgette and cherry tomatoes
instructions: Dice the courgette small and cut the sliced turkey into strips.
Heat the rapeseed oil and fry the courgette for 3 minutes, then briefly fry the turkey strips with it.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper, add them and stir for 2 to 3 minutes until set.
Serve on a plate with halved cherry tomatoes.

title: Quick win: egg plate with beetroot, lamb's lettuce and pumpernickel
instructions: Place the eggs in boiling water, cook for 8 minutes until hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Slice the cooked beetroot and wash the lamb's lettuce.
Dress the lettuce and beetroot with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Halve the eggs and arrange them on a plate with the salad and the pumpernickel.

title: Quick win: chicken breast plate with cucumber yoghurt dip and wholemeal pita
instructions: Finely grate 40 g of the cucumber and squeeze it well, slice the rest.
Stir the yoghurt with the grated cucumber, crushed garlic, dill, salt and pepper.
Arrange the sliced chicken, cucumber slices, dip and pita on a plate.

title: Quick win: smoked tofu plate with avocado, cucumber, cherry tomatoes and pumpernickel
instructions: Cut the smoked tofu into thin slices.
Cut the avocado into wedges and drizzle with lime juice, slice the cucumber and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Arrange everything with the pumpernickel on a plate and season with salt and pepper.

title: Quick win: tuna and avocado plate with cherry tomatoes, lime and crispbread
instructions: Dice the avocado and mix with lime juice, salt and pepper.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and roughly flake the tuna.
Arrange the tuna, avocado and tomatoes on a plate, sprinkle with coriander and serve with the crispbread.

title: Quick win: light egg salad with skyr, chives, radishes, tomato and crispbread
instructions: Place the eggs in boiling water, cook for 8 minutes until hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Roughly chop the eggs and mix with skyr, chives, salt and pepper.
Slice the radishes and tomato.
Spoon the egg salad onto the crispbread and serve on a plate with the radishes and tomato.

title: Quick win: chickpea and cucumber plate with light feta, tomato and mint
instructions: Rinse and drain the chickpeas.
Dice the cucumber and tomato and roughly chop the mint.
Mix everything with olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper and arrange on a plate.
Crumble the light feta over the top.

title: Quick win: turkey breast and cottage cheese plate with tomato, chives and pumpernickel
instructions: Slice the tomato and finely cut the chives.
Season the cottage cheese with chives, salt and pepper.
Arrange the sliced turkey, cottage cheese, tomato and pumpernickel on a plate.

title: Quick win: hummus plate with edamame, carrot, cucumber and pepper
instructions: Heat the edamame in boiling water for 2 minutes, rinse in cold water and salt lightly.
Cut the carrot, cucumber and pepper into sticks.
Put the hummus into a small bowl and arrange with the edamame and vegetable sticks.

title: Quick win: smoked mackerel plate with apple, radishes, lamb's lettuce and crispbread
instructions: Remove skin and bones from the mackerel and pull it into pieces.
Cut the apple and radishes into thin slices, drizzle the apple with lemon juice and wash the lamb's lettuce.
Arrange everything with the crispbread on a plate and season with pepper.

title: Quick win: low-fat quark bowl with raspberries, hazelnuts and vanilla
instructions: Stir the quark with vanilla and 2 tbsp water until creamy and put it into a bowl.
Gently wash the raspberries and spread them over the quark.
Roughly chop the hazelnuts and sprinkle them over.

title: Quick win: cottage cheese bowl with peach, pumpkin seeds and cinnamon
instructions: Wash the peach, remove the stone and cut it into wedges.
Put the cottage cheese into a bowl and lay the peach wedges on top.
Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds and cinnamon.

title: Quick win: skyr bowl with mango, lime and hemp seeds
instructions: Peel and dice the mango and mix it with the lime juice.
Stir the skyr smooth and put it into a bowl.
Spread the mango cubes on top and sprinkle with hemp seeds.

title: Quick win: yoghurt bowl with blackberries, chia seeds and rolled oats
instructions: Stir the yoghurt with the chia seeds and let it swell for 2 minutes.
Wash and drain the blackberries.
Put the yoghurt into a bowl and top with the blackberries and oats.

title: Quick win: soy skyr bowl with blueberries, flaxseed and almonds
instructions: Stir the soy skyr smooth and put it into a bowl.
Wash the blueberries and spread them on top.
Sprinkle with ground flaxseed and chopped almonds.

title: Quick win: low-fat quark bowl with banana, cocoa and peanut butter
instructions: Stir the quark with cocoa powder and 2 tbsp water until creamy.
Slice the banana.
Put the cocoa quark into a bowl, top with banana slices and drizzle the peanut butter over it.

title: Quick win: cottage cheese bowl with kiwi, pomegranate and rolled oats
instructions: Peel the kiwi and cut it into slices or cubes.
Put the cottage cheese into a bowl and spread the kiwi on top.
Sprinkle with pomegranate seeds and oats.

title: Quick win: skyr bowl with strawberries, pistachios and basil
instructions: Wash and hull the strawberries and cut them into quarters.
Put the skyr into a bowl and spread the strawberries on top.
Chop the pistachios and sprinkle them over with finely cut basil.

title: Quick win: skyr bowl with cherries, cocoa nibs and rolled oats
instructions: Wash, pit and halve the cherries.
Stir the skyr smooth and put it into a bowl.
Spread the cherries on top and sprinkle with cocoa nibs and oats.

title: Quick win: yoghurt bowl with nectarine, rolled oats and walnuts
instructions: Wash the nectarine, remove the stone and cut it into wedges.
Put the yoghurt into a bowl and lay the nectarine wedges on top.
Sprinkle with the oats and roughly chopped walnuts.

title: Chicken lentil bowl with broccoli and yoghurt mint dip
instructions: Cook the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until tender, then drain.
Cut the broccoli into florets and steam it over the lentils for the last 5 minutes.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper, fry it in the olive oil for 5 minutes per side, then slice it.
Stir the yoghurt with chopped mint, lemon juice and a little salt.
Arrange the lentils, broccoli and chicken in a bowl and add the dip on top.

title: Air fryer chicken breast with chickpea pepper salad and rocket
instructions: Rub the chicken with half of the olive oil, paprika, salt and pepper.
Cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for about 14 minutes, turning once.
Dice the pepper, cut the onion into thin rings and mix with the chickpeas.
Dress the salad with lemon juice, the remaining olive oil, salt and pepper and fold in the rocket.
Let the chicken rest for 3 minutes, slice it and serve next to the salad.

title: Chicken lentil soup with leaf spinach, carrot and lemon
instructions: Chop the onion, dice the carrot and cut the chicken into small cubes.
Sweat the onion and carrot in the rapeseed oil in a pot for 3 minutes and stir in the turmeric.
Add the stock and lentils and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken cubes and let them cook gently for 8 minutes, then stir in the spinach.
Season with lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve sprinkled with parsley.

title: Chicken edamame stir-fry with pak choi, carrot and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet for about 25 minutes.
Cut the chicken into strips, the carrot into thin sticks and the pak choi into pieces, and grate the ginger.
Stir-fry the chicken in the sesame oil over high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the carrot, edamame and ginger for 3 minutes, then add the pak choi and fry for 2 more minutes.
Deglaze with soy sauce and serve with the rice.

title: Chicken bulgur salad with chickpeas, tomato and parsley
instructions: Pour boiling water over the bulgur and leave it covered to soak for 10 minutes.
Season the chicken and fry it in a non-stick pan with half of the oil for 5 minutes per side.
Dice the cucumber and tomato and finely chop the parsley.
Mix the bulgur with the vegetables, chickpeas, parsley, lemon juice and the remaining oil.
Slice the chicken and arrange it on the salad.

title: Oven-baked chicken with Brussels sprouts, sweet potato and mustard yoghurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, halve the Brussels sprouts and cut the sweet potato into cubes.
Toss the vegetables with the olive oil, salt and pepper and spread them on a tray.
Season the chicken with paprika and salt, add it to the tray and bake everything for 25 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard and a pinch of salt.
Slice the chicken and serve with the roasted vegetables and the mustard yoghurt.

title: Chicken wrap with black beans, red cabbage and avocado
instructions: Cut the chicken into strips, season with cumin, salt and pepper and fry in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes.
Rinse the beans and lightly mash them with a fork, finely shred the red cabbage.
Mash the avocado with lime juice and a little salt.
Warm the wrap briefly in the pan, fill with yoghurt, beans, cabbage, chicken, avocado and coriander, roll up and cut in half.

title: Chicken chickpea curry with leaf spinach
instructions: Dice the chicken, finely chop the onion and grate the ginger.
Brown the chicken in the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes, fry the onion and ginger with it for 2 minutes and dust with curry powder.
Add the coconut milk, tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts and season with salt.
Serve the curry in a bowl sprinkled with coriander.

title: Chicken buckwheat salad with green beans, cherry tomatoes and light feta
instructions: Simmer the buckwheat in twice the amount of salted water for 12 minutes and drain.
Trim the green beans, halve them and cook in salted water for 8 minutes, then rinse in cold water.
Season the chicken, fry it in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes per side and slice it.
Mix the buckwheat, beans and halved cherry tomatoes with lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Top with the chicken, crumble the feta over it and sprinkle with basil.

title: Air fryer chicken strips in oat crust with pea mint mash
instructions: Cut the chicken into 6 strips and season with salt, pepper and paprika.
Dip the strips first in the whisked egg white, then coat them in the oats and spray with the rapeseed oil.
Cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for about 12 minutes until crisp, turning halfway.
Boil the peas in salted water for 4 minutes, drain and roughly blend with mint, yoghurt, salt and pepper.
Serve the chicken strips with the pea mash.

title: Turkey sweet potato pan with pinto beans and baby spinach
instructions: Cut the sweet potato into small cubes, the turkey into strips and the onion into wedges.
Fry the sweet potato in half of the rapeseed oil covered for 8 minutes until almost soft.
Add the turkey and onion with the remaining oil and fry for 5 minutes, seasoning with paprika, cumin and salt.
Add the pinto beans, warm for 2 minutes and fold in the baby spinach.
Season with lime juice and pepper and serve.

title: Sliced turkey with kidney beans, pepper and courgette
instructions: Cut the turkey into thin strips and the pepper, courgette and onion into pieces.
Sear the turkey in the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes and remove it.
Fry the onion, pepper and courgette in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the passata, kidney beans, paprika and turkey and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Air fryer turkey patties with chickpea radish salad and dill yoghurt
instructions: Knead the minced turkey with oats, finely chopped onion, salt and pepper and shape 3 flat patties.
Cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for about 12 minutes, turning halfway.
Slice the cucumber and radishes and mix them with the chickpeas and lemon juice.
Stir the yoghurt with chopped dill and a pinch of salt.
Serve the patties with the salad and dill yoghurt.

title: Turkey breast with white bean tomato ragout and leaf spinach
instructions: Season the turkey breast and fry it in half of the olive oil for 5 minutes per side, then keep warm.
Chop the garlic and briefly sweat it in the remaining oil.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 8 minutes.
Fold in the spinach until wilted and season the ragout.
Slice the turkey, lay it on the ragout and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Air fryer turkey skewers with chickpea couscous and cucumber yoghurt
instructions: Cut the turkey, pepper and courgette into cubes, thread them alternately onto 3 skewers and brush with olive oil, paprika and salt.
Cook the skewers in the air fryer at 190 °C for about 12 minutes, turning halfway.
Pour the same amount of boiling water over the couscous, leave to swell for 5 minutes and mix in the chickpeas.
Grate the cucumber, squeeze it out and stir it into the yoghurt with salt and pepper.
Arrange the skewers on the couscous and serve the cucumber yoghurt alongside.

title: Turkey leek pan with peas and wholemeal penne
instructions: Cook the penne in salted water until al dente according to the packet.
Cut the turkey into strips, fry it in the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes, then remove it.
Halve the leek lengthways, wash it, slice into rings and sweat in the same pan for 4 minutes.
Stir in the stock, peas and cream cheese, return the turkey and simmer for 3 minutes.
Toss with the penne, season and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Turkey chickpea tagine with carrot, courgette and parsley
instructions: Cut the turkey into large cubes, the carrot into slices and the courgette into thick pieces, and chop the onion.
Brown the turkey in the olive oil in a casserole for 4 minutes, then fry the onion and ras el hanout with it for 2 minutes.
Add the carrot, tomatoes and 150 ml water and braise covered for 15 minutes.
Add the courgette and chickpeas and braise for another 8 minutes.
Season with lemon juice and salt and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Beef chilli with black beans and Hokkaido pumpkin
instructions: Cut the pumpkin with its skin into small cubes and chop the onion.
Fry the minced beef in the rapeseed oil until crumbly, then fry the onion with it for 2 minutes.
Briefly toast the cumin and chilli flakes, then add the pumpkin, tomatoes and 100 ml water.
Simmer covered for 15 minutes, then let the beans heat through for 5 minutes.
Season and serve sprinkled with coriander.

title: Ginger beef strips with broccoli, edamame and quinoa
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and cook it in twice the amount of water for 15 minutes.
Cut the steak across the grain into thin strips, divide the broccoli into small florets and chop the ginger and garlic.
Sear the beef strips in the sesame oil for 2 minutes and remove them.
Fry the broccoli, edamame, ginger and garlic with 3 tbsp water for 4 minutes.
Add the beef and soy sauce, toss briefly and serve with the quinoa.

title: Air fryer beef kofta with bulgur chickpea salad and yoghurt
instructions: Knead the minced beef with finely grated onion, cumin, half of the parsley, salt and pepper and shape 4 long koftas.
Cook the koftas in the air fryer at 200 °C for about 10 minutes, turning halfway.
Pour boiling water over the bulgur and leave to swell for 10 minutes.
Mix the bulgur with the chickpeas, diced tomato, remaining parsley, lemon juice, olive oil and salt.
Serve the koftas with the salad and the yoghurt.

title: Beef rump steak with white bean rocket salad and cherry tomatoes
instructions: Take the steak out of the fridge 20 minutes before frying and pat it dry.
Fry the steak in a very hot pan with half of the oil for 3 minutes per side, season and let it rest for 4 minutes.
Rinse the beans, halve the cherry tomatoes and cut the onion into thin rings.
Mix the beans, tomatoes, onion and rocket with lemon juice, the remaining oil, salt and pepper.
Slice the steak and serve it on the salad.

title: Beef strips with Brussels sprouts, mushrooms and chickpeas
instructions: Trim and halve the Brussels sprouts and precook them in salted water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Cut the steak into thin strips, the mushrooms into slices and the onion into strips.
Sear the beef strips in half of the oil for 2 minutes, salt them and remove.
Fry the Brussels sprouts, mushrooms and onion in the remaining oil for 6 minutes, then fry the chickpeas and thyme with them for 2 minutes.
Return the beef, season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Minced beef pointed cabbage pan with chickpeas and tomato
instructions: Quarter the pointed cabbage, remove the core and cut it into thin strips, then dice the onion.
Fry the minced beef in the rapeseed oil until crumbly, then fry the onion, paprika and cumin with it for 2 minutes.
Add the cabbage and fry for 6 minutes, turning, until soft.
Stir in the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Salmon with beluga lentil salad, baby spinach and radishes
instructions: Cook the beluga lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until al dente and drain.
Slice the radishes, halve the cherry tomatoes and finely dice the onion.
Mix the lentils with the vegetables, baby spinach, lemon juice, olive oil, dill, salt and pepper.
Salt the salmon and fry it skin side down in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes, turn and finish cooking for 2 minutes.
Serve the salmon on the lentil salad.

title: Air fryer redfish with peas, green beans and dill potatoes
instructions: Cut the potatoes into wedges and boil them in salted water for 15 minutes.
Brush the redfish with half of the olive oil, paprika and salt and cook in the air fryer at 180 °C for about 9 minutes.
Cook the green beans for 8 minutes and the peas for 3 minutes in salted water and drain.
Toss the potatoes with the remaining oil and chopped dill.
Arrange the fish with the vegetables and potatoes and drizzle with lemon juice.

title: Pollock with mustard lentils, carrot and leek
instructions: Cook the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until al dente and drain.
Finely dice the carrot, slice the leek into rings and sweat them in half of the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the lentils and stock, simmer for 3 minutes and stir in the mustard and yoghurt.
Salt the pollock and fry it in the remaining oil for 3 minutes per side.
Spread the mustard lentils on a plate, lay the fish on top and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Tuna borlotti salad with egg, cucumber, pepper and tomato
instructions: Hard-boil the egg for 9 minutes, cool it in cold water, peel and quarter it.
Rinse the beans, dice the cucumber, pepper and tomato and cut the onion into thin rings.
Whisk the lemon juice with olive oil, salt and pepper and toss with the beans, vegetables and chopped parsley.
Flake the tuna and arrange it with the egg quarters on the salad.

title: Prawn quinoa bowl with edamame, mango and red cabbage
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and cook it in twice the amount of water for 15 minutes.
Cook the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and drain.
Fry the prawns in half of the sesame oil for 3 minutes until pink.
Dice the mango and cucumber and finely shred the red cabbage.
Arrange everything side by side in a bowl and drizzle with lime juice, soy sauce and the remaining sesame oil.

title: Trout fillet on pea barley with dill yoghurt
instructions: Finely dice the onion and briefly toast it with the barley in a dry pot.
Pour in the stock and simmer the barley covered for 25 minutes, adding the peas for the last 4 minutes.
Salt the trout and fry it skin side down in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes, turn and finish for 1 minute.
Stir the yoghurt with chopped dill, lemon juice and salt.
Spread the pea barley on a plate, lay the trout on top and add the dill yoghurt.

title: Air fryer salmon with Hokkaido pumpkin, chickpeas and kale
instructions: Cut the pumpkin with its skin into wedges and toss with the chickpeas, half of the olive oil, paprika and salt.
Cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 12 minutes.
Salt the salmon, place it on the vegetables and cook for another 9 minutes.
Strip the kale from its stalks and wilt it in the remaining oil in a pan for 3 minutes.
Arrange everything and drizzle with lemon juice.

title: Cod in tomato chickpea sauce with leaf spinach
instructions: Chop the garlic, sweat it briefly in the olive oil in a wide pan and stir in the paprika.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 8 minutes.
Salt the cod, place it in the sauce and let it cook covered for 8 minutes.
Add the spinach to the sauce next to the fish and let it wilt.
Season with pepper and serve in a deep plate.

title: Prawn wholemeal spaghetti with broccoli, peas and cherry tomatoes
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente according to the packet, adding the broccoli florets and peas 4 minutes before the end.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and chop the garlic.
Fry the prawns in the olive oil for 2 minutes, add the garlic, tomatoes and chilli flakes and fry for 2 more minutes.
Drain the pasta and vegetables, toss them in the pan with lemon juice and season with salt and pepper.

title: Red lentil dal with carrot, leaf spinach and skyr
instructions: Chop the onion, grate the ginger and finely dice the carrot.
Sweat the onion, ginger and carrot in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes and briefly toast the curry powder.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and 300 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes until the lentils break down.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts and season with salt.
Serve the dal in a bowl with a dollop of skyr.

title: Oven frittata with broccoli, peas and cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 °C, divide the broccoli into small florets and blanch with the peas in salted water for 3 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with cottage cheese, salt and pepper and slice the spring onions into rings.
Brush a small ovenproof pan with the olive oil, spread the vegetables in it and pour over the egg mixture.
Bake in the oven for 18 minutes until the frittata is set and lightly browned.
Serve with halved cherry tomatoes.

title: Air fryer lentil cottage cheese patties with cucumber dill salad
instructions: Cook the lentils in water for 10 minutes until soft, drain well and let them cool.
Mix the lentils with cottage cheese, egg, oats, salt and pepper and shape 4 patties.
Cook the patties in the air fryer at 190 °C for about 14 minutes until golden, carefully turning halfway.
Thinly slice the cucumber and mix with the baby spinach, yoghurt, chopped dill, lemon juice and salt.
Serve the patties with the salad.

title: Black bean quinoa bowl with cottage cheese and tomato salsa
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and cook it in twice the amount of water for 15 minutes.
Rinse the beans and sweetcorn and warm them with the cumin in a small pot for 3 minutes.
Finely dice the tomato and pepper and mix with lime juice, chopped coriander and salt into a salsa.
Arrange the quinoa, beans with sweetcorn, salsa and cottage cheese side by side in a bowl.

title: Wholemeal fusilli with edamame basil cream and cherry tomatoes
instructions: Cook the fusilli in salted water until al dente according to the packet, adding the edamame for the last 4 minutes.
Blend a third of the edamame with basil, quark, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt and 3 tbsp pasta water until smooth.
Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Toss the pasta and remaining edamame with the cream, fold in the tomatoes and season with pepper.

title: Baked sweet potato with lentil spinach filling and lime skyr
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, wash the sweet potato, prick it several times and bake for 40 minutes until soft.
Cook the lentils in water for 20 minutes until tender, drain and mix with cumin, salt and the baby spinach until it wilts.
Stir the skyr with lime juice and a pinch of salt and cut the spring onions into rings.
Cut the sweet potato open lengthways, fill with the lentil spinach mixture, top with the lime skyr and sprinkle with feta and spring onions.

title: Beluga lentil salad with light feta, cucumber, pepper and mint skyr
instructions: Cook the beluga lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until al dente, drain and let them cool.
Dice the cucumber and pepper and finely chop the onion.
Mix the lentils with the vegetables, lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Stir the skyr with half of the chopped mint.
Serve the salad with crumbled feta, the remaining mint and the mint skyr.

title: Broccoli chickpea bowl with egg and tahini yoghurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, divide the broccoli into florets and roast with the chickpeas, paprika and salt on a tray for 20 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and halve them.
Finely shred the red cabbage.
Stir the yoghurt with tahini, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Arrange the broccoli, chickpeas, red cabbage and eggs in a bowl and spoon the tahini yoghurt over.

title: Air fryer ginger tofu with pointed cabbage carrot salad and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet for about 25 minutes.
Pat the tofu dry, dice it and toss with half of the soy sauce and the grated ginger.
Cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for about 15 minutes until crisp, shaking now and then.
Finely shred the pointed cabbage, grate the carrot and mix with lime juice, sesame oil, the remaining soy sauce and spring onions.
Arrange the rice, salad and tofu together in a bowl.

title: Tempeh chickpea pan with pepper and leaf spinach
instructions: Cut the tempeh into thin slices, the pepper into strips and the onion into wedges.
Fry the tempeh in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes per side until golden and deglaze with half of the soy sauce.
Add the onion and pepper and fry for 4 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, paprika and remaining soy sauce and fry for 2 minutes.
Fold in the spinach until wilted and season with pepper.

title: Green tofu pea curry with courgette and brown rice
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the packet for about 25 minutes.
Dice the tofu, cut the courgette into half moons and grate the ginger.
Toast the curry paste and ginger in a pot with 3 tbsp coconut milk for 1 minute.
Add the remaining coconut milk, 100 ml water, courgette and tofu and simmer for 8 minutes, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Season with salt, sprinkle with coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Stuffed courgettes with soy mince, white beans and tomato
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, pour 120 ml hot water over the soy mince and leave to soak for 10 minutes.
Halve the courgettes lengthways, scoop out the flesh with a spoon and chop it.
Fry the onion and courgette flesh in the olive oil for 3 minutes, add the squeezed soy mince, lightly mashed white beans, half of the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fill the courgette halves, place them in a dish with the remaining tomatoes and bake for 25 minutes.
Serve sprinkled with basil.

title: Cumin tofu on bulgur pilaf with chickpeas and cucumber soy yoghurt
instructions: Finely dice the onion and sweat it in half of the oil for 2 minutes, then add the diced tomato and bulgur.
Bring to the boil with 90 ml water and a little salt, add the chickpeas and leave covered on low heat for 12 minutes.
Dice the tofu, season with cumin, paprika and salt and fry in the remaining oil for 8 minutes until crisp all over.
Grate the cucumber and stir it into the soy yoghurt with chopped mint and salt.
Arrange the pilaf on a plate, top with the tofu and add the cucumber soy yoghurt.

title: Air fryer tempeh with millet tabbouleh, chickpeas and pomegranate
instructions: Rinse the millet with hot water, simmer it in twice the amount of salted water for 10 minutes, then leave to swell for 10 minutes.
Cut the tempeh into cubes, toss with soy sauce and cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for about 10 minutes until crisp.
Finely dice the cucumber and tomato and chop the parsley.
Mix the millet with the vegetables, chickpeas, parsley, lemon juice, olive oil and salt.
Serve the tabbouleh with the tempeh and sprinkle with pomegranate seeds.

title: Edamame chickpea salad with smoked tofu, carrot and sesame
instructions: Cook the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes, rinse in cold water and drain.
Dice the smoked tofu and cucumber, grate the carrot and cut the spring onions into rings.
Whisk the soy sauce, lime juice and sesame oil into a dressing.
Toss all the ingredients with the dressing and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

title: Tofu kidney bean stew with Swiss chard and sweet potato
instructions: Chop the onion and garlic, dice the sweet potato and cut the chard into strips, keeping stalks and leaves apart.
Sweat the onion, garlic and chard stalks in the olive oil for 3 minutes and stir in the paprika.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the tofu cubes, kidney beans and chard leaves and simmer for another 6 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Tofu Brussels sprouts pan with Hokkaido pumpkin and white beans
instructions: Halve the Brussels sprouts, cut the pumpkin with its skin into small cubes and precook both in salted water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Dice the tofu and fry it in half of the olive oil for 6 minutes until golden, deglaze with soy sauce and remove.
Fry the onion, Brussels sprouts and pumpkin in the remaining oil for 6 minutes until lightly browned.
Add the beans, thyme and tofu, fry for 2 minutes and season with salt and pepper.

title: Cauliflower chickpea soup with smoked tofu cubes
instructions: Chop the onion, sweat it in half of the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes and briefly toast the turmeric and cumin.
Add the cauliflower florets, chickpeas and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend the soup until smooth and season with salt and pepper.
Dice the smoked tofu and fry it in the remaining oil for 5 minutes until crisp.
Serve the soup with a dollop of soy yoghurt and the tofu cubes.
